v: Haton sb'i heb' yuninal winhaj Israel tik, heb' ajun yet' winh ayik sk'ochnak winh t'a Egipto yet' yal yuninal junjun heb':
Haton winhaj Rubén, winhaj Simeón, winhaj Leví, winhaj Judá,
winhaj Isacar, winhaj Zabulón, winhaj Benjamín,
winhaj Dan, winhaj Neftalí, winhaj Gad yet' winhaj Aser.
Ay 70 sb'isul heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob chi' t'a smasanil. Ha winhaj José, aytaxon ek' winh t'a Egipto chi'.
Ha winhaj José chi' yet' masanil heb' yuk'tak yet' heb' ajun yet' winhaj Jacob chi', junjunal ix laj chamel heb',
palta tzijtumto yinhtilal heb' ix elkani, ix te k'ib' sb'isul heb'. Yelxo wal te ay smay ix aj heb'. Ix b'ut'jiel masanil yol yik Egipto chi' yuj heb'.
Niwanxo tiempo ayek' heb' ta', haxo ix aji, ix och junxo winh rey t'a Egipto chi'. Manhxo yojtakok jab'ok yab'ixal winhaj José chi' winh. Ix yalan winh t'a smasanil heb' chonhab':
Tzam eyil tikne'ik te tzijtum ix aj juntzanh heb' israel tik, yelxo wal ay smay heb' t'a kichanh.

Ha tikne'ik yowalil sko na' tas tz'aj heb', yik wach' manh ol te k'ib' sb'isul heb', yujto talaj ay b'ak'inh ay mach skot ul yak' owal t'ayonh, syak'anoch sb'a heb' yet' heb' kajk'ol chi', haxo heb' winh smolan sb'a yak'an owal chi' ket'ok. Tzam elkan heb' libre t'a tik, xchi winh rey chi'.

Yuj chi', ix ak'jioch yilumal heb' israel chi', ix ak'jioch heb' t'a munlajel te ya. Ix chekji sb'o heb' juntzanh chonhab' te niwak, haton Pitón yet' Ramesés. Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi' ix smolb'ej ixim trigo winh rey.
Wach'chom te ya tzek' heb' israel yuj heb' aj Egipto chi', palta hanheja' ste k'ib' sb'isul heb', yuj chi' ix te xiw heb' aj Egipto chi' t'a heb'.
Ix ak'jioch heb' t'a munlajel te ya.

Yelxo te ya tz'utaj heb' winh t'a munlajel. Ix ak'chajoch heb' t'a tek'oj sok'om yet' b'o'oj xan. Manhoknhej chi', ay heb' smunlajpax t'a awoj trigo yet' juntzanhxo munlajel. Yelxo wal ilb'ajk'ol tz'utaj heb'.

Ay wal junxo ix utaj heb' yuj winh rey chi'. Ay jun cheknab'il ix yak' winh t'a ix Sifra yet' t'a ix Fúa, haton heb' ix wetz'wajum yaj t'a skal heb' ix hebrea (ma heb' ix israel), ix yalan winh icha tik:
--Ayik tzeyilan sb'o sk'ol heb' ix hebrea chi', tzanhej wal alji jun nene' unin chi', tzeyilani tato winak, tze mak'chamok. Tato ix, k'ib'okab'i, xchi winh.
Palta a heb' ix wetz'wajum chi', xiw heb' ix t'a Dios. Maj sk'anab'ajejlaj heb' ix icha ix yal winh rey chi', tonhej syiloch heb' ix ayik tz'alji heb' winak unin chi'.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' winh rey, ix awtaj heb' ix yuj winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' ix: --¿Tas yuj tonhej tzeyiloch juntzanh winak unin tz'alji chi'? xchi winh t'a heb' ix. Yuj chi' ix yalan heb' ix:
--Mamin, manh lajanok heb' ix hebrea yet' heb' ix ketchonhab'. Ha heb' ix hebrea chi' te ay yip sniwanil heb' ix, manto onh k'ochlaj, sb'o sk'ol heb' ix, xchi heb' ix.
Ha yuj jun tas ix sk'ulej heb' ix wetz'wajum chi', ix te k'ib' sb'isul heb' israel. Yelxo wal ay smay heb'.
Yujto ay yelk'och Dios t'a yol sat heb' ix wetz'wajum chi', yuj chi' ix yak' swach'k'olal Dios chi' t'a yib'anh heb' ix.

Ayik ix yilan winh rey to max yal-laj icha chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' yetchonhab' smasanil icha tik: Masanil heb' winak unin tz'alji t'a skal heb' hebreo tik, tzeyumkanb'at heb' t'a yol ha' Nilo. Tato ix unin jun, k'ib'okab'i, xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ay jun winh winak t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Leví, ix yik' jun ix ix winh, hanheja' yinhtilal pax ix winhaj Leví chi'. Ay chawanh yune' heb'.
Ix alji junxo swinak unin ix, ix yilan ix to te wach' yilji, oxe' ujal ix sk'ub'ejel ix.

Haxo yik majxo yal-laj sk'ub'anel jun nene' unin chi' ix jun, ix yik'ankot jun xu'uk ix, ix yak'anoch juntzanh asfalto ix t'ay icha tzataj yik snub'laj sb'a, yik wach' max ochlaj ha' t'a yo'ol. Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'anem winh nene' unin chi' ix t'a yo'ol, ix b'at yak'ankan ix t'a skal juntzanh te te' icha te' aj t'a sti' ha' niwan Nilo.
Haxo jun ix yanab' winh unin chi', najatto ix kan ix yik syilb'at ix tas ol aj winh.

Haxo ix aji, ix k'och ix yisil winh rey sb'ik sb'a t'a sti' ha' chi'. Yakb'an wan sb'eyek' heb' ix schekab' ix t'a stitak ha' chi', ix yilanb'at ix t'a skal juntzanh te' icha te' aj chi' to ayek' jun te' xu'uk ta', ix schekanb'at jun ix schekab' ix yik b'at yik'ankot jun xu'uk chi'.
Ayik ix sjakan te' ix, ix yilan ix to nene' unin jun ayem t'a yo'ol, wan yok'i, yuj chi' ix ok' sk'ol ix t'ay, ix yalan ix: --Yik am heb' ix hebrea jun unin tik, xchi ix.
Haxo ix yanab' winh unin chi', ix k'och ix t'a ix yisil winh rey chi', ix yalan ix: --¿Ma max yal a k'ol b'at wawtej junok ix hebrea yik wach' syak' chunok jun nene' unin tik ix t'ayach? xchi ix.
--Ixik, awtej junok ix, xchi ix t'a ix unin chi'. Yuj chi' ix b'at ix yal t'a ix snun. Haxo ix ja ix nunab'il chi', ix yalan ix yisil winh rey chi' icha tik:
--Ik'b'at jun nene' unin tik, tzilan k'ib'ok, ol ach in tupu', xchi ix. Ix yik'anb'at winh nene' unin chi' ix snun chi', ix sk'ib'tzitan winh ix.

Haxo yik wach'takxo winh, ix b'at ak'jikan winh yuj ix snun chi' t'a ix yisil winh rey chi'. Haxo ix yisil winh rey chi', icha wal yune' ix ix yutej winh. Moisés ix yak' ix sb'iok. Ix yalan ix icha tik: --Yujto ha t'a yol ha ha' ix wik'k'eta jun unin tik, yuj chi' Moisés ol sb'iej, xchi ix.

Ayik tek'anxo winhaj Moisés chi', ix b'at winh yil heb' yetisraelal chi', ix yilan winh to te ya munlajel b'aj ayoch heb'. Wan smak'jipax jun winh yetchonhab' winh yuj jun winh aj Egipto ix yilan winh.
Ix ek' k'elelok winh, malaj mach wan yilani. Yuj chi' ix smak'cham jun winh aj Egipto chi' winh, ix smukankanem winh t'a skal k'e'en arena.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u ix b'atxi winh yil heb' yetchonhab' chi', haxo ix yilan winh wan yak'an owal chawanh heb' winh yetchonhab' winh chi'. Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winh ix mak'waj chi': --¿Tas yuj tza mak' winh etchonhab' tik? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh chi': --¿Mach ix ach ak'anoch yajalil, ma juezal t'a ko kal tik? ¿Mato tza nib'ej tzin a mak'cham icha utej winh aj Egipto ewi? xchi winh. Ayik ix yab'an winh tas ix yal winh chi', ix xiw winh, yujto ix nachajel yuj winh to ix el spekal to ix smak'cham winh aj Egipto chi' winh.

Ha ix yab'an spekal jun chi' winh rey, ix yak'anb'at sayumal winhaj Moisés chi' winh yik smiljicham winh. Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Moisés chi' elelal t'a yol yik Madián. Ayik ix k'och winh t'a sti' jun ha' uk'b'ila', ix em k'ojan winh ta'.

Ay jun winh sacerdote skuchan Reuel kajan t'a jun lugar chi', ay ukwanh yisil winh. Ix xit'ek' heb' ix t'a ha' uk'b'ila' chi', yik syak'an b'ut'jok te' jukub' heb' ix yik syuk' ha' nok' skalnel winh smam heb' ix chi'.

Ix jawi juntzanh heb' winh tanhwum kalnel, ix spechanel heb' ix heb' winh ta'. Ix yilan winhaj Moisés, ix k'e juknaj winh, ix b'at winh skol heb' ix, ix yak'an ha' winh yuk' nok' skalnel heb' ix chi'.
Ayik ix k'ochxi heb' ix t'a winh smam chi', haton winhaj Reuel, ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' ix: --¿Tas yuj ix pet ex jax tikne'ik? xchi winh.
Haxo ix tak'wi heb' ix: --Ay jun winh aj Egipto ix onh kolan t'a heb' winh tanhwum kalnel, ix yik'ank'eta ha' winh yuk' nok' ko kalnel tik, xchi heb' ix.
--¿B'ajtil ix kan winh eyu'uj? ¿Tas yuj maj eyik'kot winh t'a tik? Ixikek elanhchamel eyawtejkot winh yik ol wa winh, xchi winh mamab'il chi'.
Icha chi' ix aj sk'ochkan winhaj Moisés t'a spat winhaj Jetro chi'. Ayik ix ek'b'at jab'ok tiempo, ix yak'an jun yisil winh yetb'eyumok winhaj Moisés chi', haton ix Séfora.
Ix alji jun yune' ix, Gersón ix yak' winhaj Moisés chi' sb'iej, ix yalan winh: Ch'ok chonhab'il waj t'a jun lugar tik, xchi winh.

Ayik ayxo tiempo yajek' winh t'a Madián chi', ix cham winh sreyal Egipto. Palta haxo heb' israel hanheja' yab'an sya'il heb' yujto chekab' yaj heb' ta'. Ichato chi' b'i'an, ix ab'ji skusk'olal heb' yet' syahelal yuj Dios.
Ix ab'ji yok' heb' yuj, ix sna'ankot strato yet' winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Jacob.
Yuj chi' ix ilji syahelal heb' yuj Dios, ix ok' sk'ol t'a heb'.

Ha winhaj Moisés chi' tanhwoj kalnel ix yak' winh yuj winh snhi', haton winhaj Jetro, sacerdote t'a heb' aj Madián. Ay jun k'u ix b'at winhaj Moisés chi' tanhwoj kalnel, ix k'axpajek' winh t'a tzinan lu'um masanto ix k'och winh t'a yich jun lum witz skuchan Horeb haton t'a jun lum witz chi' b'aj ix sch'ox sb'a Dios t'a winh.
Hata' ix sch'ox sb'a jun yángel Jehová t'a skal jun te' k'i'ix ayoch sk'ak'al. Wach'chom te ow sk'e tinhton sk'ak'al te', palta max tz'aemlaj te'.
Ix sna'an winhaj Moisés chi': Te satub'tak yilji jun tik, tas yuj max tz'aem jun te' k'i'ix chi'. Tekan b'at wila'', xchi winh.
Ayik ix yilan Jehová to wan snitzankot sb'a winh, ix awajelta t'a skal te' k'ak' chi': --Moisés, Moisés, xchi. --Oy, Mamin, xchi winh.
Ix yalan Jehová: --Manh a nitzkot a b'a t'a tik. Ik'el a xanhab' yujto a jun lugar tik wiko', a in ayinek' t'ay.

Ha in tik, sDiosal in a mam, sDiosal in pax heb' a mam icham, haton winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Jacob, xchi. Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Moisés icha chi', ix smakan sat winh, yujto ix xiw winh yoch k'elan t'a Dios chi'.

Ix yalan Jehová chi' t'a winh: --Swil wal to ilb'ajk'ol tz'utaj heb' in chonhab' t'a Egipto. Yelxo wal swab' yok' heb' yuj tas tz'utaj yuj heb' ayoch yilumalok. Wojtak to yelxo wal ilb'ajk'ol sk'ulej in chonhab' ta'.

Yuj chi' ix in emuli, tzin kolanel heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Egipto chi'. Ol wik'el heb' t'a jun lugar chi', ol wik'anb'at heb' t'a junxo lum lum yelxo te wach', lewan, te yax sat. Ha heb' kajan t'a sat jun lu'um chi', haton heb' cananeo, heb' hitita, heb' amorreo, heb' ferezeo, heb' heveo yet' pax heb' jebuseo.
Yelk'olal sk'e yaw heb' in chonhab' Israel stewi t'ayin, yujto te ya yaj heb' t'a chonhab' Egipto chi'.
Yuj chi', tzach b'at tikne'ik, tzach wak'b'at t'a yichanh winh sreyal Egipto chi', yik sb'at ach lolonok yet' b'at ik'anelta in chonhab' t'a Egipto chi', xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi': --¿Tas waj a in tik, yuj chi' ol yal b'at in lolon t'a yichanh winh rey chi', yik ol wik'anelta heb' wetchonhab' chi'? xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix tak'wixi Jehová icha tik: --Manh ak' pensar, a in ol in och het'ok. Tik swak' junok ch'oxnab'il t'ayach to a in tzach in chekb'ati: Ayik toxo ix ik'elta in chonhab' t'a Egipto chi', ol ex ja eyak'em he b'a t'ayin t'a jun witz tik, xchi.

Ix tak'wixi winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Ha ol aj jun tik, k'inalok b'at in lolon t'a heb' wetisraelal, ol walan t'a heb' to a ko Diosal yet' heb' ko mam kicham, a ix in chekankot t'ayex, ta xin chi t'a heb', axom ol yalan heb' t'ayin: ¿Tas sb'i jun mach tzal chi'? xcham heb' t'ayin. ¿Tas swutejpax tak'wok in b'a? xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winh: Ha IN TIK AYIN TAXON EK'I. Icha tik tzutej halan t'a heb' etchonhab' chi': Ha jun mach Ha IN TON TIK sb'i, ha' tzin chekankot t'ayex, xa chi, xchi Jehová chi'.

Ix yalanxi Jehová chi' t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Tzalpax t'a heb' etchonhab' chi' icha tik: Ha Jehová ko Diosal yet' heb' ko mam kicham, haton winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Jacob, ha' ix in chekankoti yik tzul in kolwaj t'ayex, xa chi t'a heb'. Ha jun in b'i tik ay t'a junelnhej, haton in b'i tik ol b'inaj yuj heb' eyinhtilal ayik ol b'eynhejb'atok.

Ixik, tza molb'an heb' yichamtak winakil Israel, tzalani: Ha Jehová ko Diosal yet' heb' ko mam kicham, haton winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Jacob, ha' ix sch'ox sb'a t'ayin, ix yalani to syila' tas tzex utaj t'a Egipto tik.

Ix yalan t'ayin to ol ex skolel t'a syahelal t'a tik, ol ex yik'anb'at t'a jun lum lum te wach', te ay syaxil sat, haton lum b'aj kajan heb' cananeo, heb' hitita, heb' amorreo, heb' ferezeo yet' heb' jebuseo, xa chi t'a heb'.

Ol scha yab' heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' chi' tas ol ala', ol b'at och heb' het'ok b'aj ay winh sreyal Egipto chi'. Ol halani: Ha Jehová ko Diosal a onh hebreo onh tik, ha' ix sch'ox sb'a t'ayonh. Yuj chi' tzonh a chab'at t'a tzinan lu'um yik skak' ko silab' t'a ko Diosal a onh tik.
Wach'chom tzin chek al jun tik, palta wojtak to manh ol ex chajiel-laj yuj jun rey chi'. Anhej t'a ak'b'il puralil ol aj ex scha'anel winh.
Yuj chi' ol in ch'ox wal wipalil t'a winh, ol wak' yahelal t'a yib'anh nación Egipto yuj tas satub'tak ol in k'ulej ta', haxo eyaktajelta chi' yuj winh b'i'an.

Yuj pax chi', a in ol wak'och t'a spensar heb' aj Egipto chi' yik niwan ol aj eyelk'och t'a yol sat heb'. Yuj chi' ayik ol ex el chi' niwan silab' heb' ol yak' t'ayex, manh tonhejok ol he much' he k'ab' ol ex b'atok.

Junjun heb' ix israel ol sk'an tastak ay t'a heb' ix aj Egipto kajan t'a slak'anil, ma yalnhej mach ixal kajan ta', yik syak' plata heb', ma oro, ma pichul yik tzeyak'och yet' eyuninal. Icha chi' ol aj eyik'anb'at sb'eyumal heb' aj Egipto chi', xchi Jehová chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés t'a Jehová: --Manh ol yak'ochlaj heb' t'a sk'o'ol, manh ol sk'anab'ajejlaj heb' tas ol wala', axom ol yutej heb' yalan t'ayin: Mato wal yel ix sch'ox sb'a Jehová chi' t'ayach mato ma'ay, scham heb' t'ayin, xchi winh.
--¿Tas jun het'nak chi'? xchi Jehová t'a winh. --Ha te' in k'okoch, xchi winh.
--Aktejem te' t'a sat lum chi', xchi Jehová chi'. Ix yaktanem te' sk'okoch winh chi' t'a sat lu'um, elanhchamel ix och te' chanil. Ayik ix yilan jun chi' winhaj Moisés chi', ix el lemnaj winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winh: --Yam snhe nok' chan chi', xchi. Ix syaman snhe nok' chi' winh, ix ochxi sk'okochok winh.

--Yuj tas toxo ix il tik, ol yak'och heb' t'a sk'ol to ix in ch'ox in b'a t'ayach, a in ton Jehová a Diosal in, sDiosal in pax heb' he mam eyicham, haton winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Jacob, xchi.

Ix yalanxi Jehová chi' t'a winh: --Ha tikne'ik, ak'em a k'ab' t'a snhi' a k'o'ol, xchi. Ix yak'anem sk'ab' winh chi' t'a snhi' sk'o'ol, haxo ix yik'anelta sk'ab' winh chi', ayxo och yab'il lepra t'ay, toxonhej sakwekinak yilji icha k'e'en che'ew.

Ix yalanxi Jehová chi': --Ak'xiem a k'ab' chi' t'a snhi' a k'o'ol, xchi. Ix yak'anxiem sk'ab' winhaj Moisés chi' t'a snhi' sk'ol chi', haxo ix yik'anxik'eta sk'ab' winh chi', te wach'xo icha wal sniwanil winh smasanil.
Ix yalan Jehová: --Tato max yak'och heb' anima chi' t'a sk'ol tas tzala', tato max sk'anab'ajej pax heb' yuj jun b'ab'el ch'oxnab'il tik, yuj jun schab'il ol yak'och heb' t'a sk'o'ol.

Palta tato max yak'och heb' t'a sk'o'ol, max scha'anpax heb' yab' yuj chab' ch'oxnab'il tik, tzik'k'eta jab'ok ha ha' t'a ha' niwan Nilo, tza sekanem ha' t'a sat lu'um, tzanhej wal em ha' t'a sat lum chi', tz'och ha' chik'al, xchi Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a Jehová icha tik: --Ay, ach Mamin Wajalil. Komonok manhok in tzin a chekb'ati, yujto yelxo wal max yal-laj in loloni, manhokto tzalan t'ayin tik swalani, palta toxonton in k'olb'al, tewelnhej syal in loloni, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi Jehová chi': --¿Mach yuj syal slolon heb' anima tza na'a? ¿Tom manh wujok slolon heb'? Hanhejtona' in swak' chakanhb'ok heb' yet' heb' max yal sloloni yet' heb' max yal yilani. Ha in swak' yil heb' wach' yilani.
Yuj chi, ixik, ol in ochnhej het'ok ayik ol ach lolonok. Hanheja' in ol wal tas ol ala', xchi Jehová chi'.
Ix tak'wixi winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalan winh: --Ay Mamin Wajalil, komonok manhok in tzin a chekb'ati. Wach' tza say junokxo mach, xchi winh.

Ix kot yowal Jehová t'a winh ix yalani: --Ha t'a Egipto chi', hata' ayek' winh uk'tak aj Aarón, yinhtilal winhaj Leví. Wojtak to b'ekan sk'o'ol winh sloloni. Ol kot winh ach scha'a. Ol te tzalaj winh ayik ol ach yilani.
Ha ach ol ach lolon t'a winh. Ol halani tas ol yutok winh sloloni. Ha inxo ol wal t'ayex ayik wan he lolon chi', ol wak'an he na'el masanil tas ol he k'ulej.
Ha ach tzach lolon t'a winhaj Aarón chi' in k'exulok, haxo winh ol lolon t'a heb' chonhab' a k'exulok.
Ik'b'at te' a k'okoch chi', yujto a te' ol ak'lab'ej ayik ol a ch'oxan juntzanh ch'oxnab'il ix wal t'ayach.

Ix meltzaj winhaj Moisés t'a spat winh snhi', haton winhaj Jetro, ix yalan winh: --Ol in meltzaj t'a Egipto yik sb'at wilan heb' ayto wuj in b'a yet'ok, yik swila' tato pitzanto heb', xchi winh. --Ixik, tzil wal a b'a t'a yoltak b'e, xchi winhaj Jetro chi'.
Ayik aytoek' winhaj Moisés t'a yol yik Madián chi', ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winh: --Ixik t'a Egipto, manh ach xiw a b'ati, yujto chamnakxo heb' snib'ej ach smilanchamok, xchi.

Ix yik'anb'at ix yetb'eyum winhaj Moisés yet' heb' yuninal, ix yak'ank'e heb' winh t'a yib'anh nok' b'uru, ix b'at heb' t'a Egipto chi'. Yet'nak te' sk'okoch winh, haton te' ix yal Dios to ol och yopisio yuj winh.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winh: --Ayik ol ach k'och t'a Egipto chi', na'annhej u'uj to ol a ch'ox juntzanh ch'oxnab'il te satub'tak t'a yichanh winh rey, haton juntzanh ix wak' a k'ulej. Palta a in ol wak' pitb'okel spensar winh, yuj chi' manh ol ex schael-laj winh.
Slajwi chi', ol halan t'a winh: Icha tik yalan Jehová: Ha jun chonhab' Israel tik, icha wal to sb'ab'el wuninal yaji.
Toxo ix wal t'ayach to tza chab'at heb' wuninal tik yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'ayin. Palta toxonton malaj a gana tzaktejeli, yuj chi' ol in milcham winh a b'ab'el unin, xchi Jehová, xa chi.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Moisés t'a Egipto chi'. Ha t'a yoltak b'e b'aj t'inhan sway winh yet' heb' ajun yet'ok, hata' ix sch'ox sb'a Jehová t'a winh, ijan ix miljicham winh yuj.

Elanhchamel ix yik'kot jun kuchilub' ix Séfora, nab'a komon k'e'en, ix spolanel stz'umal sjolom swinakil winh yune' ix, ix sjulanoch ix t'a yok winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalan ix: Yujto wetb'eyum ach, yuj chi' lokan in t'a jun chik' tz'el tik, xchi ix.
Ixlajwi chi' majxo miljichamlaj winh yuj Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Aarón: --Ixik b'at a cha winh uk'tak aj Moisés t'a tzinan lu'um, xchi t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix kot winhaj Aarón scha winhaj Moisés chi' t'a jun witz b'aj ix sch'ox sb'a Dios. Haxo yik ix schalan sb'a heb' winh, ix yak'lan stzatzil sk'ol heb' winh, ix stz'ub'lanelta sti' heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan winhaj Moisés yalan t'a winhaj Aarón chi' masanil tas ix schek Jehová yala' yet' juntzanh ch'oxnab'il ix chekchaj sch'ox winh.
Ix b'at heb' winh schawanhil, ix smolb'an heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' Israel heb' winh t'a Egipto chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan winhaj Aarón yalan t'a heb' smasanil tas ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi', ix sch'oxanpax juntzanh ch'oxnab'il winh yil heb' chonhab' chi'.
Yuj chi', ix yak'och heb' t'a sk'o'ol tas ix yal heb' winh. Ayik ix yab'an heb' to ix iljikot heb' yuj Jehová, yujto te ilb'ajk'ol tz'utaj heb', yuj chi' ix em nhojan heb' ejmelal t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ayik ix lajwi yek'kanb'at juntzanh chi', ix b'at lolon winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón t'a yichanh winh sreyal Egipto chi', ix yalan heb' winh: --Mamin rey, icha wal tik yalan Jehová ko Diosal a onh hebreo onh tik t'ayach: Chab'at in chonhab' t'a tzinan lu'um yik tzin yik'ancha'anh heb' yet' junok k'inh, xchi Jehová, xchi heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi winh rey chi': --Manh wojtakok jun Jehová tzeyal chi'. ¿Tas yuj tzin k'anab'ajej tas syala', tzin cha'anb'at jun chonhab' Israel tik? Max in chab'at-laj heb', xchi winh.

Ix yalan heb' winh: --Ha ko Diosal a onh hebreo onh tik, ix sch'ox sb'a t'ayonh. Yuj chi' chaonhb'at t'a tzinan lu'um yik b'at kak'an ko silab' t'a Jehová ko Diosal, oxe' k'uhal stek'nab'il b'aj ol onh b'at chi'. Tato max onh b'ati, haxo talaj tz'aji tzonh yak'ancham ko Diosal chi' yuj junok yahelal, ma yuj owal, xchi heb' winh t'a winh rey chi'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winh: --¿Tas yuj tzeyik'ek' tiempo t'a juntzanh eyetchonhab' tik t'a smunlajel? Ha ex pax tik, ixikek t'a he munlajel.
¿Tom max heyila' to tzijtum heb' eyetchonhab' t'a yol chonhab' Egipto tik? ¿Tas yuj tzeyamoch wa'an heb' t'a smunlajel? xchi winh.
Hanhejtona' t'a jun k'uhal chi' ix yalb'at winh rey t'a heb' winh yajal munlajel yet' pax t'a heb' winh caporal icha tik:
--Manhxo eyak' anh ak yik sb'at t'a skal lum sok'om t'a heb' winh israel chi', ichataxon tz'aji, palta to haxo heb' winh ol b'at sayan yiko'.
Palta hanheja' sb'isul lum xan chi' sb'o heb' winh ichataxoni. Yujto sjaraganail heb' winh tz'ik'ani, yuj chi' tzijtum yawaj heb' icha tik: To tzonh b'at kak' ko silab' t'a ko Diosal, xchi heb'.
Hak'ekoch más munlajel t'a yib'anh heb', yik wach' manhxalaj stiempo heb' yab'an juntzanh esal lolonel tz'alchaj chi', xchib'at winh rey chi'.
Yuj chi' ix yal heb' winh aj Egipto ayoch yajal munlajel t'a heb' israel ayoch caporalil yik syal heb' t'a heb' munlajwum chi' icha tik: --Toxo ix yal winh rey to manhxo ol ak'chaj anh ak t'ayex.
Ha tikne'ik a exxo ol b'at he say heyik ol he k'ana', palta hanheja' sb'isul lum xan ol he b'o'o, xchi heb' winh.
Icha chi' ix aj saklem heb' winh israel t'a masanil yol yik Egipto sayoj yok trigo yik sk'an heb' winh sk'exulok anh ak chi'.
Wach'chom icha chi' ix aji, palta a heb' yajalil heb' caporal chi', syal heb' to hanheja' sb'isul lum xan yowalil sb'o heb', icha sb'o heb' ayik tz'ak'chaj anh ak t'a heb'.

Slaj mak'ji heb' israel ayoch t'a caporalil yuj heb' ayoch yajalilal t'a yib'anh heb' yuj winh rey. Syalan heb' winh icha tik t'a heb': ¿Tas yuj manh tz'akanok he b'o lum he xan ewi yet' tikne'ik ichataxon he b'oan lu'um? xchi heb' winh yajalil heb' chi'.
Ix b'at heb' winh caporal yal t'a winh rey icha tik: --Mamin rey ¿tas yuj ob'iltakxonhej tzonh utej a onh a chekab' onh tik?

Maxtzak ak'jilaj anh ak t'ayonh yik tz'och skalok lum ko xan sko b'o'o, tob' yowalil tz'akan sko b'opax lu'um icha t'a yalanhtaxo, tzonh mak'ji. Ha onh tik malaj ko mul, palta a heb' winh a chekab' ay smul, xchi heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi winh rey chi': --Ha ex tik yuj he jaraganail icha chi' tzeyala'. Tzonh b'at kak' ko silab' t'a Jehová, xe chi.
Ixikek munlajel, wach'chom a ex tze say anh ak tzeyak'och t'a skal lum xan chi', hanheja' icha sb'isul lum tze b'o'o, xchi winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh.
Yuj chi' a heb' winh israel ayoch t'a caporalil chi', yelxo wal ix chab'ax sk'ol heb' winh, yujto ix alchaj t'a heb' winh to hanheja' sb'isul lum xan chi' sb'o heb' winh t'a junjun k'u.
Ayik ix elta heb' winh caporal chi' t'a yol sdespacho winh rey chi', ix schalan sb'a heb' winh yet' winhaj Moisés yet' pax winhaj Aarón, wan stanhwaj heb' winh yuj heb' winh.

Ix yalan heb' winh caporal chi': --Olxom yil Jehová tas ol ex yutok, yujto a ex ay he mul, yuj chi' a winh rey yet' heb' winh ay yopisio yet' winh, tzonh syaj wal heb' tikne'ik. Ichato a ex ix eyak' k'e'en espada t'a heb' winh yik tzonh smilancham heb' winh, xchi heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Moisés t'a slesal: --Mamin Jehová, ¿tas wal yuj te ya tzutej heb' a chonhab' tik? ¿Tas yuj ix in a chekkoti?
Atax in xit'nak lolonel t'a winh rey chi' u'uj, yelxo wal ilb'ajk'ol tz'utaj heb' a chonhab' tik yuj winh, maxto ach kolwajlaj jab'ok, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix tak'wi Jehová: --Olto wal ila' tas ol wutok winh sreyal Egipto tik. Yet' wipal ol ex yaktanel winh. Ha in ol wak' pural winh, ol ex spechanel winh t'a yol schonhab' tik, xchi.
Ix lolonxi Jehová yet' winhaj Moisés, ix yalani: --Ha inton Jehová in.
In ch'oxnak in b'a t'a winhaj Abraham, t'a winhaj Isaac yet' t'a winhaj Jacob, t'a in b'i, Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil. Palta a in b'i JEHOVÁ, maj wak'laj yojtakejel heb' winh tas syalelk'ochi.
In b'onak in trato yet' heb' winh, wak'annak in ti' wak'an lum Canaán t'a heb' winh, haton lum b'aj ek'lejnak kajan heb' winh.

Ha tikne'ik, toxo ix wila'' to te ilb'ajk'ol tz'utaj heb' in chonhab' t'a Egipto tik, yelxo wal tz'ixtaj heb' t'a munlajel yuj heb' aj Egipto tik. Yuj chi', ix in nakot in trato yet' heb' he mam eyicham chi'.

Ha tikne'ik, b'at al t'a heb' etisraelal chi': Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha in Jehová in, ol ex in kolel b'aj ayex och chekab'ok tik, b'aj ilb'aj ex k'ol yuj munlajel t'a Egipto tik. Ol in ch'ox wal wipalil, ol wak'anoch niwak yahelal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik. Icha wal chi' ol aj ex in kolanel t'a yol sk'ab' jun chonhab' tik.

Ol ex och in chonhab'ok, a inxo ol in och he Diosalok. Icha chi' ol aj eyojtakaneli to a in Jehová he Diosal in tzex in kolel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Egipto tik b'aj ayex och t'a syahelal yuj munlajel.

Ol ex wik'anb'at t'a sat lum lum b'aj wak'nak in ti' wak'an t'a winhaj Abraham, t'a winhaj Isaac yet' t'a winhaj Jacob. Ha inxo Jehová in tik swalpax t'ayex to heyik ol aj lu'um, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Masanil tas ix yal Jehová, ha' ix yal winhaj Moisés t'a heb' yetisraelal chi', palta maj schalaj yab' heb', yujto te somchajnakel sk'ol heb' yuj sya'il munlajel.
Ixlajwi chi, ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':
--Ixik al t'a winh sreyal Egipto chi' to tzex yaktejel winh t'a sat slu'um tik, xchi Jehová.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi' t'ay: --Ina max schalaj yab' heb' wetchonhab' tas swala', okxom wal winh rey, tom ol scha yab' winh, ina to max wal yal-laj in loloni, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix chekjib'at winh yet' winhaj Aarón yuj Jehová yik b'at lolon heb' winh t'a heb' yetisraelal yet' t'a winh rey, yujto alb'ilxo t'a heb' to ol yik'elta heb' yetchonhab' heb' t'a Egipto chi'.

Haton sb'i heb' yajal t'a junjun makanhil heb' yinhtilal Israel t'a stzolal: Ha winhaj Rubén sb'ab'el yuninal winhaj Israel. Haxo heb' yuninal winh, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Hanoc, winhaj Falú, winhaj Ezrón yet' winhaj Carmi. Haton heb' tik yajal yaj t'a skal junjun makan yinhtilal winhaj Rubén chi'.

Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Simeón, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Jemuel, winhaj Jamín, winhaj Ohad, winhaj Jaquín, winhaj Zohar yet' winhaj Saúl yune' jun ix aj Canaán. Haton heb' tik yajal yaj t'a skal junjun makan yinhtilal winhaj Simeón chi'.
Ha winhaj Leví, 137 ab'il ix ek' winh. Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winh t'a stzolal haton heb' tik: Winhaj Gersón, winhaj Coat yet' winhaj Merari.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Gersón, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Libni yet' winhaj Simei. Haton heb' tik yajal yaj t'a junjun makan.
Ha winhaj Coat chi', 133 ab'il ix ek' winh. Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winh, haton tik: Winhaj Amram, winhaj Izhar, winhaj Hebrón yet' winhaj Uziel.
Eb' yuninal winhaj Merari, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Mahli yet' winhaj Musi. Haton heb' tik yajal yaj t'a junjun makan yinhtilal winhaj Leví yet' yuninal heb'.
Ha winhaj Amram ix yik'laj sb'a winh yet' ix Jocabed yanab' winh smam winh, haton heb' ay yik winhaj Aarón yet' winhaj Moisés. Ha winhaj Amram chi' 137 ab'il ix yil winh, ix cham winh.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Izhar, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Coré, winhaj Nefeg yet' winhaj Zicri.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Uziel, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Misael, winhaj Elzafán yet' winhaj Sitri.
Ha winhaj Aarón ix yik' sb'a winh yet' ix Elisabet, yisil winhaj Aminadab, yanab' winhaj Naasón. Haxo yuninal heb', haton heb' tik: Winhaj Nadab, winhaj Abiú, winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar.
Eb' yuninal winhaj Coré, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Asir, winhaj Elcana yet' winhaj Abiasaf. Haton heb' tik yajal yaj t'a junjun makan heb' yinhtilal winhaj Coré.

Haxo winhaj Eleazar yuninal winhaj Aarón, ix yik' sb'a winh yet' ix yisil winhaj Futiel. Ix alji jun yune' ix, haton winhaj Finees. Haton heb' tik yajal yaj t'a junjun makan heb' yinhtilal winhaj Leví.
Haxo winhaj Aarón yet' winhaj Moisés sb'inaj t'a jun lista tik, haton t'a heb' winh tik ix yal Jehová to a heb' winh ol ik'anelta heb' israel t'a Egipto t'a stzolal.
Haton heb' winh ix xit'ek' lolonel yet' winh sreyal Egipto yik wach' syaktejelta heb' chonhab' israel chi' winh.
Ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés t'a Egipto, ix yalani:
--Ha in ton Jehová in. Al t'a winh sreyal Egipto masanil tastak swal tik t'ayach, xchi t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Mamin, yelxo wal max yal-laj in loloni, ¿tas wal ol aj yab'an winh rey tas ol wala'? xchi winh.
Ix yalan Jehová chi' t'a winh: --Manh ak' pensar, a ach tzach och t'a yichanh jun winh rey chi' in k'exulok, haxo winh uk'tak aj Aarón ol lolon a k'exulok.
Masanil tas tzin chek ala', al t'a winh uk'tak chi', haxo winh ol lolon t'a yichanh winh rey chi' yik tzex yaktanel winh t'a smakb'en tik.
Ha inxo ol wak' pitb'okel spensar winh rey chi' yik ol stek'b'ej sb'a winh. Yuj chi' tzijtum tas satub'tak ol in ch'ox t'a Egipto tik.
Yujto manh ol schalaj yab' winh rey chi' tas ol eyala', yuj chi', a in ol in ch'ox wal wipalil wak'an yahelal t'a Egipto tik. Icha chi' ol aj ex wik'anelta t'a stzolal a ex in chonhab' Israel ex tik.
Ayik toxo ix in ch'ox wipalil chi', ayik toxo pax ex wik'elta, ichato chi' ol nachajel yuj heb' aj Egipto tik to a in ton Jehová in, xchi t'a winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón tas ix yal Jehová.
Ha winhaj Moisés chi', 80 ab'il sk'inal winh, haxo winhaj Aarón chi', 83 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix lolon heb' winh t'a yichanh winh sreyal Egipto chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón chi' icha tik:
--Tato sk'an winh rey chi' yil junok ch'oxnab'il, tzalan t'a winhaj Aarón tik to syaktejem te' sk'okoch winh t'a sat lu'um t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ol och te' chanil, xchi t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atxi heb' winh schawanhil t'a winh rey chi', ix sk'anab'ajan heb' winh sk'ulan icha ix yal Jehová. Ix yaktanem te' sk'okoch winhaj Aarón t'a yichanh winh rey yet' t'a yichanh masanil heb' ay yopisio yet' winh, elanhchamel ix och te' chanil.
Ayik ix yilan winh rey icha chi', ix schek winh awtaj heb' winh aj Egipto, heb' winh jelan yet' juntzanh yik yajb'alil, ix sk'ulan heb' winh icha ix sk'ulej winhaj Aarón chi'.
Ix yaktejpaxem sk'okoch heb' winh t'a sat lu'um, ix ochpax chanil, palta ix turjib'at sk'okoch heb' winh chi' yuj yik winhaj Aarón chi'.
Wach'chom icha chi' ix aji, palta manh jab'ok ix scha yab' winh rey chi'. Ix yak'nhej pitb'okel spensar winh icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ix pitb'iel spensar winh rey chi', maj aktajel heb' in chonhab' Israel yuj winh.
Ayik sakb'inaj k'ik'an, tzex b'at t'a sti' ha' niwan Nilo, tze tanhwan sk'och winh achanwel ta'. Tzeyik'anb'at te' k'okoch ix och chanil.

Hata' tzeyal t'a winh icha tik: Ha Jehová ko Diosal a onh hebreo onh tik, a chekannak onh kot ul kal t'ayach to tzonh aktejel a onh schonhab' onh tik, yik b'at onh och ejmelal t'ay t'a tzinan lu'um. Palta masanto tikne'ik manh jab'ok tza cha ab'i.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi to ay tas ol sch'ox ila' yik tzojtakejeli to a Jehová chi' anhejton Dios Aytaxonek'i. Ayik ol in mak'an sat ha ha' tik yet' te' in k'okoch yamb'ilk'e wuj tik, ol och ha' chik'al.
Masanil nok' chay ol chamok, ol k'e sjab' ha', manhxo ol yal-laj eyuk'an jab'ok ha' tik, xa chi t'a winh rey chi'.

--Tzalpax t'a winhaj Aarón to syak'b'at te' sk'okoch winh t'a yib'anhtak sjaj ha ha' t'a Egipto tik: T'a yib'anh ha' kotak yet' ha' niwak melem yet' t'a yib'anh ha' nhajab' tonhej molan. Masanil ha ha' ay t'a yol yik Egipto tik ol laj och ha' chik'al yet' masanil ha' ayem t'a yol yet'tal yet' t'a yoltak jukub', xchi Jehová.

Icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová chi', icha chi' ix yutej winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón chi'. Ix yik'ank'e te' sk'okoch winhaj Aarón chi', ix smak'an sat ha ha' winh t'a yichanh winh rey yet' t'a yichanh masanil heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet' winh. T'a wal jun rato chi' ix och ha' chik'al.
Masanil nok' chay ay t'a yol ha' Nilo chi', ix laj cham nok'. Ix k'e sjab' ha', majxo yal-laj yuk'an ha' heb' aj Egipto chi'. Masanil ha ha' ay ta', chik'xonhej ix aj ha'.

Icha pax chi' ix yutej heb' winh ay t'a yol yik Egipto chi', yujto ay tas tzuji yuj heb' winh yuj tas k'ayb'ab'il yuj. Icha chi' ix aj spitanxi sb'a winh rey icha ix aj yalan Jehová. Maj schalaj yab' winh tas ix yal winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón chi'.
Malaj wal jab'ok yelk'och tas ix yal heb' winh chi' t'a yol sat winh rey chi', ix meltzaj winh t'a sdespacho.
Masanil heb' anima t'a Egipto chi', ix sjoy ha ha' heb' yik syuk'ej t'a stitak ha ha' chi', yujto masanil ha ha' chi' maxtzak yal-laj yuk'ji.
Yukub'ixial yoch ha' chik'al,
ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés icha tik: --Ixik, b'at il winh rey chi', tzalan t'a winh icha tik: Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Aktejel heb' in chonhab' yik b'at och heb' ejmelal t'ayin.
Tato manh ol aktejel in chonhab' tik, ol wak'och yahelal t'a ib'anh, ol wak' pitzwokk'e nok' pajtza' t'a masanil a makb'en tik.

Ol wak' pitzwok nok' t'a yol ha ha' smasanil, ol laj och nok' t'a yol a despacho yet' b'aj tzach wayi. Ol laj k'e nok' t'a sat a ch'at. Ol laj och nok' t'a yoltak spat heb' ay yopisio het'ok, t'a yoltak spat masanil anima, t'a yoltak horno b'aj sb'o ixim pan tza wa''a yet' t'a sattak ak'ante' b'aj syotz'chaj ixim pan chi'.
Ol laj k'e nok' t'a ib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh heb' ay yopisio het'ok yet' t'a yib'anh masanil heb' etchonhab', xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a winh rey chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Al t'a winhaj Aarón to syak'b'at te' sk'okoch winh t'a yib'anh smasanil ha ha': Ha kotak ha' yet' a niwak nhajab', yik sk'eta b'ulnaj nok' pajtza'. Ol majel yol yik Egipto tik yuj nok', xchi Jehová chi'.
Ix yak'anb'at te' sk'okoch winhaj Aarón chi' t'a yib'anh ha ha' chi'. Ix k'eul b'ulnaj nok' pajtza' chi', ix majel masanil yoltak chonhab' chi' yuj nok'.
Hanheja' icha chi' ix yutejpax heb' winh ay tas tzuji yuj yet' tas k'ayb'ab'il yuj heb', ix japax nok' t'a yol chonhab' chi' yuj heb'.

Ix laj te pukax nok', yuj chi' ix awtaj heb' winh chawanh chi' yuj winh rey chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --k'anek t'a Jehová, yik ol yik'el nok' pajtza' tik t'a ko kal, ol waktanel he chonhab' tik, yik sb'at heb' yak' silab' t'ay, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés t'a winh: --Ha ach ol ala' b'ak'inh tzin lesalwi t'a Jehová yik syik'anel nok' pajtza' tik t'ayach yet' t'a heb' ay yopisio het'ok yet' t'a skal masanil anima yet' t'a yoltak he pat. Haxonhej t'a yol ha' Nilo ol kan nok', xchi winh.
--K'ik'an, xchi winh rey chi'. Ix yalanxi winhaj Moisés chi': --Icha chi' ol ajok, yik ol ojtakejeli to malaj junokxo lajan spoder icha Jehová ko Diosal a onh tik.
Icha chi' ol aj yel nok' t'a a despacho yet' t'a yol spat heb' ayoch yajalil het'ok yet' t'a skal masanil anima. Ol kannhej nok' t'a yol ha' Nilo, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi, ix elta heb' winh chawanh chi' t'a yichanh winh rey chi'. Ix sk'anan winhaj Moisés t'a Jehová to tz'el nok' pajtza' chi'.
Ix sk'anab'ajej Jehová tas ix sk'an winh chi'. Ichato chi' ix laj och ijan scham masanil nok' pajtza' t'a yoltak pat, t'a amak' yet' t'a kaltak te'.
Haxo heb' anima ix laj molb'an nok' chamnak pajtza' chi' t'a junjun b'ulanh, chuklaj ix aj sjab' yuj nok'.

Ayik ix yilan winh rey to manhxalaj yahelal ayoch t'a yib'anh winh, ix yak'anxi pitb'okel spensar winh, icha wal ix yutej Jehová yalani, maj sk'anab'ajejlaj winh tas ix yal t'a heb' winh chawanh chi'.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Al t'a winhaj Aarón to syik'cha'anh te' sk'okoch winh, smak'an spokokal lum lum winh yet' te' yik smeltzajoch lum pokok chi' kotak usal t'a masanil yol yik Egipto tik, xchi.

Ichaton chi' ix yutej winhaj Aarón chi'. Ix smak'k'e wa'an lum pokok chi' winh yet' te' sk'okoch, yuj chi' masanil lum pokok ay t'a yol yik Egipto chi', ix laj och lum kotak usal, ix och nok' t'a anima yet' t'a nok' nok'.

Hanheja' heb' winh ay tas tzuji yuj yalani, icha ix yutej winhaj Aarón chi' icha chi' ix yutejpax heb' winh sna'ani. Ix snib'ej heb' winh ix och lum pokok chi' kotak usal, palta maj yal-laj yuj heb' winh. Ix chiji heb' anima yet' nok' nok' yuj nok' us chi'.

Yuj chi', ix yal heb' winh ay tas tzuji yuj yalani t'a winh rey chi': --Ha jun tik, ha Dios tz'utani, xchi heb' winh. Palta ix pitb'iel spensar winh rey chi', icha wal ix yutej Jehová yalani. Maj schalaj yab' winh tas ix yal winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón chi'.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Ha k'ik'an t'a sakb'inaji, sb'at winh rey chi' t'a sti' ha ha', yuj chi' pet ex k'e wa'an, b'at eyalan t'a winh: Icha tik yalan Jehová: Aktejel heb' in chonhab' yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'ayin.

Palta tato manh ol aktejel heb', ol wak'kot junok umanh nok' kach icha tab' t'a ib'anh, t'a yib'anh masanil heb' ay yopisio het'ok yet' pax t'a yib'anh masanil a chonhab'. Ol b'ut'jokel masanil yol he pat yet' masanil sat lu'um yuj nok'.

Ayik ol ujok juntzanh chi', manhxalaj junok nok' kach chi' ol ek' t'a yol yik Gosén b'aj ayek' heb' in chonhab'. Icha wal chi' ol aj ojtakaneli to a in Jehová in, Dios in t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Hata' ol ojtakejeli to ch'ok yel in chonhab' tik t'a yichanh a chonhab' chi' t'a yol in sat. Ha k'ik'an, max ek'b'atlaj saklemb'at nok' kach, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a winh rey chi'.

Icha chi' ix yutej Jehová. Ichaxo wal tab' yek' nok' kach chi', ix ochk'och nok' t'a yol sdespacho winh rey yet' t'a yoltak spat heb' ay yopisio yet' winh yet' masanil t'a yol smakb'en Egipto. Junelnhej ix yixtejb'at yol chonhab' chi' nok'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix awtajxikot heb' winh chawanh chi' yuj winh rey chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --Ixikek, ix ak'ek he silab' t'a he Diosal chi', palta manh ex el t'a yol yik Egipto tik, xchi winh.

Haxo ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi': --Max yal-laj icha chi', yujto a nok' nok' skak' t'a silab'il t'a Jehová ko Diosal chi', niwan yelk'och nok' t'a yol sat heb' etchonhab' tik. Yuj chi, tato syil heb' anima chi' ko milancham nok' a onh tik, wal yel tzam onh sjulk'enej heb'.
Yuj chi', yowalil tzonh b'at t'a tzinan lu'um, oxe' k'uhal stek'nab'il b'aj tzonh b'at chi'. Hato ta' b'at kak' ko silab' t'a Jehová ko Diosal, icha ix yutej yalani, xchi winh.

Ix yalanpax winh rey chi': --Syal he b'at t'a tzinan lum chi', yik b'at eyak' he silab' t'a Jehová he Diosal chi', anhej tato yel manh najatok tzex b'ati, tze k'anan t'a he Diosal chi' wuj a in tik, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a winh: --Anhej wal tzin el t'a tik, tzin k'anan t'a Jehová to a k'ik'an tz'el nok' kach tik t'ayach, t'a heb' ay yopisio het'ok yet' t'a masanil a makb'en tik. Palta manhxo'okab' onh ixtej, manhxaokab'pax tas ol al t'ayonh ayik ol b'at kak'an ko silab' t'a Jehová chi', xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ixnhej wal elta winhaj Moisés t'a yol sdespacho winh rey chi', ix sk'anan winh t'a Jehová.
Ix yab'an Jehová tas ix sk'an winh chi', ix yik'anel nok' kach t'a winh rey chi' yet' t'a heb' ay yopisio yet' winh yet' t'a masanil heb' anima. Manhxa junok nok' ix kani.
Palta hanheja' ix spitejxi sb'a winh rey chi', maj chajiel-laj heb' israel chi' yuj winh.

Ixlajwi chi, ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ixik t'a winh rey chi', tzalan t'a winh: Icha wal tik yalan Jehová ko Diosal a onh hebreo onh tik: Chab'at in chonhab' tik yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'ayin.
Tato manh ol a chab'at heb', tato ol a yamnhejoch wa'an heb',
ol kot wowal, ol wak'anelta yab'il t'a nok' he molb'etzal nok', ol cham nok' yuj yab'il chi', haton nok' chej, nok' wakax, nok' camello, nok' b'uru, nok' kalnel yet' nok' chiwa.
Palta ol in ch'oxo' to ch'ok yel heb' israel t'a wichanh, yuj chi' malaj junok nok' snok' heb' ol chamok, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a winh.
Ix yalankan sk'uhal Jehová chi', ix yalani: --Ha k'ik'an swak'kot jun yahelal chi', xchi.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u chi', ix yak'ankot yab'il Jehová t'a nok' nok' chi'. Tzijtum nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' aj Egipto chi' ix chami, haxo pax heb' aj israel, malaj junok nok' yik heb' ix chami.

T'a elanhchamel ix b'at schekan iljok winh rey tato malaj nok' yik heb' israel chi' ix chami. Wach'chom malaj junok nok' ix chami, palta ix spitejxi spensar winh rey chi', maj aktajel heb' israel chi' yuj winh.

Ixlajwi chi, ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón: --Ixikek, ik'ekkot junok wotz k'e'en tik'ak'il ta'anh t'a yol junok horno. Ha ach tik ach Moisés tza tzipk'e k'e'en t'a cha'anh t'a yichanh winh rey chi'.
Icha chi', ol saklemkanb'at k'e'en icha pokok t'a masanil yol smakb'en Egipto, yuj k'e'en ol k'e yab'il yaxk'a t'a masanil anima chi' yet' t'a nok' nok', xchi Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi, ix b'at winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón yik'kot k'e'en ta'anh t'a junok horno, ix b'at heb' winh yil winh rey chi'. Ayik ix k'och heb' winh t'a yichanh winh, ix stzipank'e k'e'en winhaj Moisés t'a cha'anh. Ixlajwi chi', ix pitzwik'e yab'il yaxk'a t'a masanil anima chi' yet' t'a masanil nok' nok'.
Haxo heb' ay tas tzuji yuj yalani, majxo yal-laj sch'oxan sb'a heb' t'a yichanh winhaj Moisés chi', yujto ya ay heb' yuj yab'il yaxk'a icha yaj masanil heb' anima t'a Egipto chi'.
Ix pitb'ixiel spensar winh rey chi' yuj Jehová, maj schalaj yab' winh tas ix yal heb' winh chawanh chi', icha ix yutej yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés: --Spet ex k'e wa'an k'ik'an, b'at ex lolon t'a winh rey chi', tzeyalan t'a winh: Icha wal tik yalan Jehová ko Diosal a onh hebreo onh tik: Aktejel heb' in chonhab' yik b'at och heb' ejmelal t'ayin.

Ha t'a jun pekti' tik ol wak'kot juntzanh yahelal tik t'a ib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh heb' ay yopisio het'ok yet' t'a yib'anh heb' a chonhab', yik wach' tzojtakejeli to manhxa junok mach lajan spoder icha in tik t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Tato syal in k'o'ol, tzin ch'ox wipalil t'ayach, swak'anoch yahelal t'a ib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh masanil heb' anima t'a a makb'en tik. Syal tzex in satel t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Okxo, manto ol ach in satel-laj, yujto ix ach wak'och t'a opisio yuj in ch'oxanel in poder yuj tas ol ach wutok, yik te niwan ol aj in b'inaj t'a skal masanil anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Wach'chom tzijtum yahelal tzin ch'ox ila', palta tza pitejnhej a b'a, hanheja' max aktejel-laj in chonhab' tik.

Yuj chi, a k'ik'an yab' wal icha hora tik, swak'anem k'e'en sakb'at t'a yib'anh chonhab' tik. Mantalaj b'aj tz'em k'e'en sakb'at yelxo wal niwak icha k'e'en tz'em chi' yiktax ix el yich chonhab' Egipto tik.

Yuj chi', al t'a heb' winh a chekab' to a masanil nok' molb'etzal nok' yet' masanil tas ay t'a skal a munlajel to tz'ochkan t'a yoltak lechpat, yujto ayik ol ja k'e'en niwak sakb'at chi', masanil nok' nok' yet' masanil anima malaj yenhul, ol cham yuj k'e'en, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a winh.

Ay heb' winh ay yopisio yet' winh rey, ix xiwkank'ei ayik ix yab'an heb' yuj tas ix yal Jehová. Yuj chi, ix yak'k'e yenhul nok' smolb'etzal snok' heb' winh. Ix ochpaxkan masanil schekab' heb' winh t'a yoltak lechpat chi'.
Ay juntzanhxo heb' maj yak'och t'a sk'ol tas ix yal Jehová chi', ix kan nok' smolb'etzal nok' yet' heb' schekab' heb' t'a ichnhejta'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés: --Ik'cha'anh a k'ab' yik tz'em k'e'en niwak sakb'at t'a yib'anh masanil anima, t'a yib'anh masanil nok' nok' yet' t'a yib'anh masanil tas awab'il ay t'a yol smakb'en Egipto tik, xchi.
Yuj chi' ix yik'ancha'anh sk'okoch winhaj Moisés chi', ix mak'waj k'u, ix ek' kopoljok lheb'lon, ix kot k'e'en niwak sakb'at t'a masanil sat lum t'a yol yik Egipto chi' yuj Jehová.

Maxtzak ochlaj wa'an yem k'e'en sakb'at yet' smak'waj k'u yet' yek' kopoljok lheb'lon. Malaj ton b'aj ix b'inaj yak'an junelok sakb'at t'a yol yik Egipto t'a yalanhtaxo icha jun owal sakb'at ix yak' chi'.

Masanil tastak ay t'a Egipto chi', ix ixtaxb'at yuj k'e'en niwak sakb'at ix yak' chi'. Ix cham heb' anima yet' nok' nok' aykan t'a spatiktak pat yet' masanil tastak ay t'a skaltak munlajel ix lajwikanel yuj k'e'en, yet' masanil te te' ix laj ixtaxkanb'at te'.
Haxonhej t'a yol yik Gosén b'aj ayek' heb' israel, malaj wal junok k'otanh k'e'en sakb'at chi' ix emi.
Yuj chi' ix schekan winh rey awtajxikot heb' winh chawanh chi', ix yalan winh: --Toxo ix nachajel wu'uj tikne'ik to a in ay in mul yet' in chonhab' tik. Palta a Jehová, te tojolnhej syutej.

Toxo ix ek' yib'anh smak'waj k'u yet' yem k'e'en niwak sakb'at. Yuj chi', manhxo ol wik'ek' he tiempo, syal he b'at b'aj syal he k'o'ol, anhej jun, komonok tz'el t'a he k'ol tze k'an t'a Jehová yik syik'el jun yahelal tik, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a winh: --Anhej wal tzin elkan t'a yol chonhab' tik, tzin mojb'an in k'ab' in lesalwi t'a Jehová, tzin k'anan t'ay yik syaktan yak'ankot k'e'en sakb'at tik, yik manhxo ol mak'waj k'u, yik wach' snachajel u'uj to yik Jehová yaj masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Palta wojtak sik'lab'il to a ach tik yet' heb' ay yopisio het'ok, manta yelk'och Jehová Dios t'a yol he sat, xchi winh.
Ha jantak tas awab'il, icha anh lino yet' ixim cebada, masanil ix ixtaxkanb'ati, yujto a ixim cebada ayxo sat ixim, hanheja' anh lino ayxo xumakil anh.
Haxo pax ixim trigo yet' ixim centeno, malaj tas ix ik'an ixim, yujto tzak'anxo tz'elul ixim.

Ayik ix lajwi slolon winhaj Moisés yet' winh rey chi', ix el winh t'a yol chonhab' chi', ix yik'ancha'anh sk'ab' winh, ix lesalwi winh t'a Jehová. Ha wal t'a jun rato chi', ix wanaj yem k'e'en sakb'at yet' nhab' yet' smak'waj k'u.
Haxo ix yilan winh rey to maxtzak emlaj nhab', maxtzak emlaj k'e'en sakb'at, manhxalaj k'u sk'anhi, hanheja' ix ochxi smul winh, ix pitb'ixiel spensar winh yet' heb' ay yopisio yet'ok.
Yuj chi', majxo aktajel-laj chonhab' Israel chi' yuj winh, icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Ixik il winh rey chi', ix wak' pitb'okel spensar winh yet' heb' ay yopisio yet'ok, yik wach' tzin ch'ox juntzanh tas satub'tak tik t'a skal heb',

yik wach' syal eyalan t'a heb' eyuninal yet' t'a heb' eyi he chikin masanil tastak ix aj wixtan heb' aj Egipto tik yet' juntzanh satub'tak ix in k'ulej t'a skal heb'. Icha wal chi' tz'aj eyojtakkaneli to a in ton Jehová in, xchi t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atxi winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón chi' yilxi winh rey chi', ix yalan heb' winh t'a winh: --Icha wal tik yalan Jehová ko Diosal a onh hebreo onh tik: ¿Jantakto wal tiempo ol a pitej a b'a, yik max ik'em a b'a t'a wichanh? Aktejel in chonhab' yik b'at och heb' ejmelal t'ayin.
Tato manto ol a chab'at in chonhab' tik, a k'ik'an swik'ankot nok' k'ulub' t'a yib'anh a chonhab' tik.
Ol majel sat lum tik smasanil yuj nok'. Manhxa jab'ok lu'um ol cheklajok. Ol swach' k'uxejb'at nok' jantakto maj lajwokkanel yuj k'e'en sakb'at chi' yet' masanil te te' satani ol sk'uxpaxb'at nok'.

Ol b'ut'jokkanel yol a despacho yuj nok' yet' yoltak spat heb' ay yopisio het'ok yet' masanil yoltak pat t'a yol yik Egipto tik. Malaj b'aj ix yil heb' he mam eyicham junok icha tik yiktax ix ja kajan heb' t'a jun lugar tik, xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'. Ayik ix lajwi yalan juntzanh tik winh, ix elixta heb' t'a yol sdespacho winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan heb' winh ay yopisio yet' winh rey chi': --¿B'ak'inh ol yaktej juntzanh winak tik onh stzuntzani? ¿Tas yuj max aktejel jun chonhab' chi' yik sb'at och heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová sDiosal chi'? ¿Tom max nachajwalel jab'ok u'uj, ina toxo ix juwikanb'at ko chonhab' tik? xchi heb'.
Yuj chi', ix awtajxikot heb' chawanh chi' yuj winh rey chi': --Ixikek yik b'at ex och ejmelal t'a Jehová he Diosal chi', palta tzeyalkan t'ayin machtak ex ol ex b'at chi', xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi': --Ko masanil ol onh b'atok. Ol kik'b'at heb' kotak unin yet' heb' icham anima, heb' winh kuninal yet' heb' ix kisil. Masanil nok' ko kalnel, nok' ko wakax yet' nok' chiwa, masanil nok' ko molb'etzal nok' ol kik'b'ati, yujto te niwan k'inh ol kutej kik'ancha'anh Jehová ko Diosal, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi winh rey chi': --Wach'chom ayoch Jehová he Diosal chi' heyet'ok, ¿tzam he nalaj to ol ex in chab'at yet' eyetb'eyum yet' eyuninal? Manh wal jab'ok. Tob'an chuk tas tze na'a.
Ha exnhej winak ex tik b'at ex och ejmelal t'a he Diosal chi', ina to a jun chi' tze k'ana', xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix pechjielta winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón chi' t'a yichanh winh rey chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ik'cha'anh a k'ab' t'a yib'anh chonhab' Egipto tik, yik sjawi nok' k'ulub' ul sk'uxb'at masanil tastak ixto kan yuj k'e'en sakb'at chi', xchi.

Icha chi' ix aj yik'ancha'anh sk'okoch winhaj Moisés chi' t'a yib'anh Egipto chi', ix yak'ankot jun niwan owal ik' Jehová, ix kot t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Jun wal k'u yet' jun ak'wal ix yak' jun owal ik' chi', haxo t'a junxo k'uhal, a jun ik' chi' ix ik'ankot nok' k'ulub' chi'.
Masanil yol yik Egipto chi' ix majel yuj nok'. Malaj b'aj ix uji junelok yiktax yalanhtaxo, manhxa b'aj olto ujok icha junel tik.

Ix te majel sat lum yuj nok'. Manhxo chekelok jab'ok lu'um. Ha jantakto tas ix kan yuj k'e'en sakb'at, ix lajwiel yuj nok'. Manhxa jab'ok tas ya'ax yilji ix kan yuj nok' t'a yol yik Egipto chi', manhxa pax sat te te' yet' schontak te'. Pilan ix lajwiel smasanil, haxonhej ste'al ix kani.
T'a elanhchamel ix awtajxikot heb' winh chawanh chi' yuj winh rey chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ix och in mul t'a sat Jehová he Diosal yet' t'ayex.

Tzin tewi t'ayex to tzeyak' niwank'olal t'a in patik yuj in mul tik, haxonhej t'a junel tik. Tze k'anan t'a Jehová he Diosal, yik tz'el jun yahelal to et'jinak chamel ayek' t'a yol in makb'en tik, xchi winh.
Ha wal yik ix elta winhaj Moisés t'a sdespacho winh rey chi', ix lesalwi winh t'a Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'ankot jun ik' Jehová te ow. Ha b'aj sb'at k'u, hata' ix kot jun ik' chi'. Ix b'atkan nok' k'ulub' chi' t'a yol ha' Chakchak Mar yuj, manhxa junok nok' ix kan t'a yol yik Egipto chi'.
Ix pitb'ixiel spensar winh rey chi' yuj Jehová, maj aktajel-laj chonhab' Israel yuj winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha tikne'ik, ik'cha'anh a k'ab', yik wach' sk'ik'b'ik'inal t'a masanil yol yik Egipto tik. Yelxo wal to k'ik' k'inal ol ajok, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yik'ancha'anh sk'ab' winh chi', ix ja jun niwan k'ik' k'inal t'a masanil yol yik Egipto chi'.
Oxe' k'uhal ix k'ik'b'i, manhxa junok heb' syal yilanoch heb' kajan t'a slak'anil, maxtzak yal-laj sb'eyek' heb'. Palta haxo b'aj kajan heb' israel sakk'inal.

Yuj chi', ix awtajxikot winhaj Moisés yuj winh rey chi', ix yalan winh: --Syal b'at eyoch ejmelal t'a Jehová, ik'ekb'at eyetb'eyum yet' eyuninal. Anhej to tzeyaktejkan masanil nok' he molb'etzal nok', xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi': Yowalil tzonh a chab'at yet' nok' ko molb'etzal nok' chi', yujto a nok' ko nok' chi' ol kak' ko silab'ok t'a Jehová ko Diosal.

Masanil nok' ko nok' chi' ol kik'b'at ket'ok, manhxo junok nok' ol kaktejkani, yujto t'a skal nok' ol ko sik'el nok' ol kak' ko silab'ok t'a Jehová ko Diosal. Ayik manto onh k'ochlaj ta', maxto nachajel-laj ku'uj mach nok' ol kak' ko silab'ok chi', xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Hanheja' ix pitb'ixiel spensar winh rey chi' yuj Jehová, yik max aktajel heb' chonhab' israel yuj winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalanxi winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Elanh t'a wichanh. Manhxo a na'a to swil a sat junelxo t'a tik, yujto ta tzach jawi junelxo t'a wichanh tik, ha t'a jun k'uhal chi' tzach chamxonhej, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Ichaton wal tzal chi', manhxa b'ak'inh ol wil a sat junelxo, xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Ol wak'kot junokxo yahelal t'a yib'anh winh rey tik yet' t'a yib'anh masanil anima t'a yol yik Egipto tik. Ol lajwok yek' jun tik, manh tonhejok ol ex aktajel yuj winh rey tik, palta to a wal lak'an winh ol ex pechanel t'a tik t'a junelnhej.
Yuj chi' al t'a masanil heb' israel, heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix to sk'an k'e'en oro heb' yet' k'e'en plata t'a heb' aj Egipto kajan t'a slak'anil, xchi.

(Haxo Jehová ix lolon t'a spensar heb' anima aj Egipto chi', yik syak'an swach'k'olal heb' t'a heb' israel. Hanheja' heb' winh ay yopisio yet' winh rey, ix yalan heb' winh to niwan yelk'och winhaj Moisés t'a yol sat heb' winh. Hanheja' icha chi' ix aj yalan masanil heb' anima t'a Egipto chi'.)
Ayik manto eltalaj winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalanxikan winh t'a winh rey chi': --Icha tik yalan Jehová: Ayik ol och chimilak'wal, ol in ek' t'a masanil yol yik Egipto tik,

yik swak'ancham masanil heb' b'ab'el unin t'a junjun patil heb' aj Egipto. Ol schael yich t'a winh a b'ab'el uninal, winh t'inhan yochkan a k'exulok t'a a despacho tik, masanto schampax sb'ab'el unin heb' ix a chekab' wan scheni t'a k'e'en cha'. Ol champax nok' sb'ab'el yune' nok' nok'.
Ha t'a masanil yol yik Egipto tik, manhxo jantakok ok'el ol ujok, malaj b'aj ix uji t'a yalanhtaxo, manhxa pax b'aj olto ujok.

Haxo heb' israel malaj tas ol ik'an heb', malaj pax tas ol ik'an nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb', yik tzeyojtakejeli to ch'ok yel heb' israel t'a yichanh heb' a chonhab' t'a yol in sat a in Jehová in tik, xchi Jehová.

Ichato wal chi' ol jawok juntzanh heb' winh ay yopisio het'ok yik ol ul in yilani, ol em kuman heb', ol yalan heb' t'ayin: Ixik yet' masanil mach tzak'anoch u'uj, xcham heb'. Yuj chi', hato ta' ol onh b'atok, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'. Yelxo wal te yowal winh ayik ix elixta winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi'.
Yalnakpax Jehová t'a winh: --Manhton wal ol schalaj yab' winh rey tas ol eyala'. Yuj chi' tzijtumto tas satub'tak ol in k'ulej t'a Egipto tik, xchinakkani.

Ha winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón ix laj sk'ulejnhej heb' masanil tastak ix laj alchaj tik to satub'tak t'a yichanh winh rey, palta toton wal a Jehová ix ak'annhej pitb'okel spensar winh rey chi', yuj chi' maj aktajel heb' israel yuj winh t'a yol smakb'en chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón t'a Egipto icha tik:
Ha jun uj tik niwanokab' yelk'och t'ayex, b'ab'el uj t'a yol junjun ab'il tz'ajkani.

Alek jun cheknab'il tik t'a masanil heb' eyetisraelal: Ha t'a slajunhil k'uhal yoch jun uj tik, junjun winak ol yik'kot junok nok' yune' kalnel, ma junok nok' yune' chiwa yik schi'an yet' masanil heb' kajan yet'ok. Ha nok' nok' chi' junjun ab'il okab' sk'inal nok', mokab'a jab'ok spalta'il nok', anhej to smam nok'. Tato manh tzijtumok anima t'a yol spat, max tzak'wan heb' schi'an nok', syal yawtan winh aj pat chi' mach kajan t'a slak'anil yik skolwaj heb' schi'an nok' yet'ok, to spukchajek' nok' hato syala' jantak sb'isul anima, ma jantak schi junjun heb'.
Tze sik'kanel nok' masanto t'a 14 yoch jun uj tik. Tze milcham nok' t'a yemk'uhalil t'a jun k'u chi'.
Junjun heb' aj pat chi' sb'onhoch schik'il nok' t'a smarcoal spuerta'il spat b'aj ol chijok nok' chi', t'a te' yib'anh yet' t'a stz'eytak te'.
Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi' ol schi nok' chib'ej chi' heb' anima, palta tonhej ol b'olchaj nok', ol schi anh itaj heb' k'a' yet' nok', haxo ixim pan malaj yich ayb'at ol swa heb'.
Malaj jab'ok nok' tze chi t'a yaxto, mato tz'anhb'il. Masanil nok' sb'olchaji. Ha sjolom nok', yok nok' yet' yol sk'ol nok', b'olb'ilnhej tz'aji, tze chi'ani.
Manhxo eyak'kan jab'okxo nok' t'a junxo k'u. Tato ayto nok' max lajwi eyuj jun, tze nhuskantz'a nok'.

Ayik ol ex wa chi', tzek'b'ilokab' he nanhal, ayokab'och he xanhab', yamb'ilokab'k'e he k'okoch eyu'uj, t'a elanhchamel ol aj he chi'an nok'. Haton ta' tzeyak'och k'inh, yik tzin eyik'ancha'anh a in Jehová in tik, yujto ol in ek' t'a stitak he pat.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to a wal t'a jun ak'wal chi' ol in ek' t'a yol yik Egipto smasanil, yik tzin mak'ancham masanil b'ab'el unin t'a junjun pat yet' nok' sb'ab'el yune' nok' nok'. Ol wak' cheklajelok to malaj yelk'och masanil sdiosal heb' aj Egipto chi'.

Ha schik'il nok' nok' chi', tze b'onhoch t'a spuerta'il sti' he pat b'aj kajan ex ek' chi'. A' ol ch'oxanok to ayik ol in ek' in mak'cham masanil heb' b'ab'el unin yik heb' aj Egipto chi', malaj junok ex ol ex chamok. Ayik ol wilanoch chik' chi', b'enhej ol in ek'b'atok.

Haton wal jun k'uhal chi' niwan ol ajkan yelk'och t'ayex, tzeyak'anoch junok niwan k'inh yik tzin eyik'ancha'anh a in Jehová in tik. Masanil tiempo tze nakoti. Yet' heb' eyuninal ol snakot jun tik heb'. Ley tz'ajkan jun tik t'a he kal t'a masanil tiempo.

Ha ixim pan tze wa t'a uke' k'u, mokab'a yich ayb'at t'a skal ixim. Yuj chi' ha t'a sb'ab'el k'uhal tzeyik'elta masanil yanhal yich pan t'a he pat junjun ex. Tato ay junok mach swa'an ixim pan ay yich t'a juntzanh k'uhal chi', tze satel t'a he kal.

Ha t'a b'ab'el k'u tze molb'ej he b'a tzex och ejmelal t'ayin. Icha pax chi' tzeyutej t'a yukil k'uhal, hanheja' tze molb'ejpax he b'a. Ha t'a chab' k'uhal chi' malaj mach smunlaji, anhej he b'oan wa he b'a syala'.

Yowalil tze k'anab'ajej jun k'inh yik ixim pan malaj yich, yujto ha t'a jun k'uhal chi', stzolal ol ex wik'elta he masanil t'a yol yik Egipto tik. Junjun ab'il tzeyak'och jun k'inh chi'. Ley ol ajkanok, yowalil sk'anab'ajej heb' eyinhtilal yik ol b'eynhejb'atok.
Tz'el yich he wa'an ixim pan malaj yich chi' t'a 14 yoch b'ab'el uj t'a yemk'uhalil masanto t'a 21 yoch jun uj chi' t'a yemk'uhalil.

Ha t'a uke' k'uhal chi' malaj junok mach ayek' yich pan t'a spat. Tato ay junok mach swa'an ixim pan to ay yich t'a juntzanh k'uhal chi', tze satel t'a he kal, wach'chom junok ch'ok chonhab'il kajanek' t'a he kal, ma junok ex israel ex, satjieli.
Yuj chi' manh he wa tastak ayb'at yich b'aj kajan ex ek'i, anhej ixim pan malaj yich tze wa''a, xa chi, xchi t'a winh.

Ix awtaj heb' winh yajalil chonhab' t'a skal heb' yetisraelal yuj winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalan winh: Ixikek, tzeyik'elta junjunok nok' kelemtak kalnel, ma nok' chiwa yik tze chi yet' heb' kajan heyet'ok t'a yol he pat. Tze milcham nok', ol he chi'an nok' t'a jun niwan k'inh ol ochok.

Tze cha'an schik'il nok' t'a yol junok palangana. Tzeyik'ankot junok tob'anh te k'ab'tak hisopo, tze lab'anem t'a skal schik'il nok' chi', tze b'onhanoch t'a smarcoal yib'anh he puerta yet' t'a stz'eytak. Malaj junok ex tzex elta t'a yol spuerta'il he pat t'ak'walil.

Ayik ol ek' Jehová t'ak'walil chi', yik smak'ancham heb' b'ab'el yuninal heb' aj Egipto, ol yilanoch chik' t'a spuerta'il he pat chi', b'enhej ol ek'b'atok, manh ol schaochlaj jun ángel ol mak'ancham heb' b'ab'el unin t'a yol he pat.
Ha jun cheknab'il tik ol he k'anab'ajejnhej, ol sk'anab'ajejnhej heb' eyinhtilal, icha ley tz'ajkan t'a junelnhej.
Wach'chom ayik ayexxo ek' t'a lum lum ix yak' sti' Jehová yak'an t'ayex, yowalil ol eyak'och jun k'inh tik.
Ayik ol sk'anb'an heb' eyuninal t'ayex: ¿Tas syalelk'och jun k'inh tik? tato xchi heb'.

Ha exxo tik ol eyal t'a heb' icha tik: Ha jun nok' kalnel sko milcham tik, yik sk'inhal yik sko na'ankot sk'uhal ayik b'enhej ix ek' Jehová t'a sti' ko pat ayik ix smak'ancham heb' b'ab'el yuninal heb' aj Egipto, haxo t'a stitak ko pat, b'enhej ix ek'b'ati. Icha wal chi' ix yutej skolankanel kuninal Jehová t'a jun pekti' chi', xe cham t'a heb', xchi winhaj Moisés chi'. Ayik ix lajwi yalan juntzanh tik winh, ix em kumuljok heb' israel ejmelal t'a yichanh Jehová.
Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix sk'anab'ajan heb' icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' yet' t'a winhaj Aarón.

Ha t'a chimilak'wal, ix ek' Jehová smak'cham heb' b'ab'el unin t'a Egipto t'a junjun patil. Syalelk'ochi to ix cham jun sb'ab'el unin winh rey, winh t'inhan yochkan sk'exulok winh t'a sdespacho, masanto ix champax sb'ab'el yuninal heb' winh ayoch t'a preso. Hanheja' icha chi' ix aj schampax sb'ab'el yune' nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.
Masanil heb' anima t'a Egipto ix k'e wa'an t'a jun ak'wal chi'. Tz'ok' winh rey yet' heb' ay yopisio yet'ok yet' heb' anima smasanil, yujto manhxa junok pat b'aj malaj chamnak.

Ha wal t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix awtaj winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón yuj winh rey chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --Ha tikne'ik ixikek, ik'ekb'at masanil heb' eyetchonhab', b'esekel he b'a t'a skal heb' wetchonhab' tik, sb'at eyak'anem he b'a t'a Jehová icha eyalan chi'.
Ik'ekb'at masanil nok' he molb'etzal nok': Nok' kalnel, nok' wakax yet' nok' chiwa, icha ix aj eyalan chi'. Ixikek, tzex tewipax t'a Jehová wu'uj, xchi winh rey chi'.
Ajun heb' aj Egipto chi' ix chekanel heb' israel, yik tz'el heb' t'a elanhchamel t'a yol schonhab' heb' chi', yujto ix sna heb' talaj scham heb' smasanil.
Ha ixim harina ayxo och yalil, ayem t'a yol yet'tal, manto somchajb'atlaj yich pan t'a skal, toxonhej ix spichoch heb' t'a yol sábana yet' skajonal, ix yik'anb'at heb' t'a sjenhjab'.
Ix sk'anan k'e'en oro, k'e'en plata heb' israel chi' yet' pichul t'a heb' aj Egipto icha yalnak winhaj Moisés t'a heb'.

Ha Jehová ix k'exan spensar heb' aj Egipto chi', yuj chi' wach'xonhej ix yutej sk'ol heb' t'a heb' israel chi'. Masanil tastak ix sk'an heb' israel chi' ix yak' heb'. Icha wal chi' ix aj yik'anek' heb' israel tastak ay t'a heb'.
Ix el heb' israel t'a Ramesés, ix k'och heb' t'a Sucot. Ay am 600 milok heb' winh stiempo wal yoch t'a soldado'al, max ochlaj heb' ix ix yet' heb' kotak unin sb'isulok.
Tzijtum nok' skalnel heb' ix yik'b'ati, nok' chiwa yet' nok' wakax. Tzijtum pax anima ch'ok chonhab'il ix b'at yet' heb'.
Manhxalaj tiempo yik ix sb'o'an swa'el heb', yujto elanhchamel ix pechjiel heb' yuj heb' aj Egipto chi', yuj chi' toxonhej ix sb'ol ixim pan heb', haton ixim malaj yich yet'nak heb'.
Ha heb' israel schonhab' Jehová chi', 430 ab'il ek'nak heb' t'a Egipto chi'. Ha wal t'a jun k'u yik ix tz'akwi 430 ab'ilxo yajek' heb' ta' ix el heb'.
Ha wal t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix munlaj Jehová yik syik'anelta schonhab'. Yuj chi' ha t'a jun ak'wal chi' t'a junjun ab'il, pitzan masanil heb' israel yik syik'ancha'anh Jehová heb' t'a masanil tiempo.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón: Ha sleyal k'inh yik tze na'ankoti, ayik b'enhej ix in ek' t'a sti' he pat, haton swalkan t'ayex tik: Malaj junok heb' ch'ok chonhab'il syal schi'an nok' silab'.
Ha heb' he chekab' manb'il eyu'uj, syal schi'an nok' heb', anhej tato ak'b'ilxo circuncidar heb'.
Ha pax junok heb' anima ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal, paxyalwum, ma munlajel syak' t'a he kal, max yal-laj schi'an nok' heb'.
Anhej t'a yol pat b'aj sb'oji nok', anhej ta' syal schiji nok'. Max yal-laj yik'jib'at nok' t'a junokxo pat, max yalpaxlaj smak'jipoj sb'akil nok'.
Ha jun ley tik masanil heb' israel ol k'anab'ajanok.

Talaj ay junok ch'ok chonhab'il snib'ej syak'och jun k'inh chi' t'a he kal yik tzin yik'ancha'anh, b'ab'el tz'ak'ji circuncidar heb' winh winak t'a jun patil anima chi'. Ichato chi' syal schi'an nok' yik jun k'inh chi' heb'. Ichato eyetchonhab' yaj heb'. Ha pax junok winh to manto ak'b'ilok circuncidar jun, max yal-laj schi'an nok' silab' chi' winh.
Ha jun ley tik, yowalil sk'anab'ajej heb' anima tz'alji t'a he kal yet' heb' anima ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal, xchi Jehová.
Masanil tas ix chekji yal winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón chi', ix sk'anab'ajej heb' anima chi'.
Ha wal t'a jun k'uhal chi', t'a stzolal ix aj yelta heb' israel yuj Jehová t'a yol smakb'en Egipto chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':

Ch'ok tzeyik'el heb' b'ab'el winak t'a he kal yik tzin yak' serwil heb', yujto wik yaj heb' b'ab'el unin t'a skal heb' etchonhab'. Hanheja' pax sb'ab'el yune' nok' he molb'etzal nok', wik yaji, xchi t'a winh.

Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Moisés t'a masanil heb' yetchonhab': Yowalil sko naekkot jun k'inh tik t'a junjun ab'il, yuj ko na'ankoti to a Jehová ix onh ik'anelta yet' yipalil t'a yol yik Egipto, b'aj ayonh och t'a chekab'ok. Mokab' ko wa ixim pan ayb'at yich t'a skal.
Ha tikne'ik, t'a jun uj Abib tik ix onh el t'a Egipto tik.

Ayik ol onh k'och yuj Jehová t'a lum lum yax sat, haton lum b'aj kajan heb' cananeo, heb' hitita, heb' amorreo, heb' heveo yet' heb' jebuseo, haton lum yalnak Jehová t'a heb' ko mam kicham to ol yak' t'ayonh, hanheja' t'a jun uj tik ol kak'och k'inh yik sko na'ankoti.
T'a uke' k'uhal ol ko wa ixim pan malaj yich. Haxo t'a yukil k'uhal chi', haton ta' tzonh och ejmelal yuj kik'ancha'anh Jehová.
Ha t'a uke' k'uhal chi', malaj ixim pan ayb'at yich ol ko wa''a. Manh ol ilchaj yich pan t'a ko pat, manh ol ilchajpaxlaj t'a masanil yol ko makb'en.
Ha t'a juntzanh k'uhal chi', ol kal t'a heb' kuninal: Ha jun k'inh tik yik sko nakoti tas ix yutej Jehová sch'oxan swach'k'olal t'ayonh, ayik ix onh yik'anelta t'a Egipto, xko chama.

Ha jun k'inh tik ol ch'oxanelok to ch'ok keli, ichato ayoch junok kechel t'a ko k'ab', ma t'a snanhal ko sat. Ha yuj jun k'inh tik ol ko nakoti to a Jehová ix onh ik'anelta t'a Egipto yuj spoder, yuj chi' ol kalnhej sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová, ol ko k'anab'ajanpaxi.
Yuj chi' junjun ab'il ol kak'och jun k'inh tik t'a jun uj tik.
Ayik ol onh k'och yuj Jehová t'a lum slu'um heb' cananeo, lum yak'nak sti' yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham yet' t'ayonh,
hata' ol ko sik'kanel heb' ko b'ab'el winak unin yet' nok' winak sb'ab'el yune' nok' ko molb'etzal nok' yik skak' t'a Jehová.

Hanhejtona' ayik tz'alji sb'ab'el yune' nok' b'uru, tato winak nok', syal yoch junok nok' yune' kalnel, ma junok nok' yune' chiwa sk'exulok nok'. Palta tato max ak'ji nok' kalnel chi', smak'ji kanhchaj sjaj nok' yune' b'uru chi'. Haxo pax yuj heb' b'ab'el winak unin, yowalil tz'ak'chaj junok nok' yune' kalnel sk'exulok heb'.
Ayik ol sk'anb'an heb' eyuninal t'a b'ak'inh tas syalelk'och juntzanh tik, tzeyalani: Sch'oxnab'il yaj b'aj yik'nakonhelta Jehová yet' spoder t'a Egipto b'aj ayonh och chekab'ok.

Ha wal yik ix pitb'iel spensar winh rey, maj yal sk'ol winh ix onh yaktejeli, haxo Jehová ix mak'ancham sb'ab'el unin heb' aj Egipto yet' sb'ab'el yune' nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'. Yuj chi' a nok' sb'ab'el yune' nok' ko molb'etzal nok' tik, sko milcham nok' silab'ok t'a Jehová. Skak'anpax junjun nok' sk'exulok heb' ko b'ab'el unin, xe chi t'a heb'.
Ha jun tik ol ch'oxanelok to ch'ok keli ichato ayoch junok kechel t'a ko k'ab', ma t'a snanhal ko sat. Ha yuj ol ko nakoti to a Jehová ix onh ik'anelta t'a Egipto yuj spoder, xchi winhaj Moisés.

Ha ix yaktanel heb' chonhab' israel winh rey t'a yol smakb'en Egipto, maj ik'jib'atlaj heb' yuj Dios t'a sb'e heb' winh filisteo, wach'chom t'inhan jun b'e chi', yujto ix sna'a to manh wach'ok syak' owal heb' israel yet' heb', talaj sna meltzaj sb'a heb' t'a Egipto ayik ol yilan heb' to ay owal.
Yuj wal chi', ix ek'nhej oyoyok heb' yuj Jehová t'a tzinan lu'um yet' t'a stitak ha' Chakchak Mar. Ayik ix el heb' t'a yol yik Egipto chi', yet'nak syamk'ab' heb' yik owal.

Ix yalan winhaj Moisés to tz'ik'chajb'at sniwanil winhaj José, yujto ayik pitzanto winh yalannak winh t'a heb' yetchonhab' to syak' sti' heb' to ol sk'ulej heb' t'a icha chi'. Yalnakkan winh t'a heb': Wal yel ha Dios ol kolwaj heyet'ok. Yuj chi', ayik ol ujok jun tik, ol eyik'b'at in niwanil heyet'ok, xchinakkan winh.
Ix el heb' israel chi' t'a chonhab' Sucot, ix k'och heb' t'a chonhab' Etam t'a stitak takinh lu'um.

Ha t'a k'uhalil, b'ab'el Jehová t'a yichanh heb', sch'oxan sb'a t'a jun topanh asun, ha' sch'oxan b'e t'a heb'. Haxo t'ak'walil, hanheja' t'a jun asun chi' b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová, ayoch sk'ak'al jun asun chi' yik syak'an sakil k'inal t'a heb' anima chi', yik wach' syal sb'ey heb' t'a k'uhalil ma t'ak'walil.
Ha jun asun chi', b'ab'elnhej sb'at t'a yichanh heb' israel t'a k'uhalil, haxo t'ak'walil ayoch sk'ak'al. Manh wal jab'ok ix el t'a yichanh heb'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés:

Al t'a heb' etchonhab' tik to smeltzaj jab'ok heb' t'a spatik, sk'och heb' t'a Pi-hahirot, t'a skal Migdol yet' ha' mar, t'a yichanh Baal-zefón. Ha t'a slak'anil sti' ha' mar chi' tze b'o he campamento.
Ol sna'an winh sreyal Egipto icha tik: Ha heb' israel manh yojtakok heb' b'ajtil sb'ati, ix b'atkan makan heb' t'a takinh lu'um, xcham winh.

Yuj chi', ol wak'xi pitb'okel spensar winh, ol tzak'laj winh t'a he patik. Yuj tas ol wutok winh rey yet' heb' soldado chi', ol cheklajok to te' niwan welk'ochi. Ol yojtakejpaxel heb' anima t'a Egipto chi' to a in Jehová in tik, a innhej Dios in, xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'. Yuj chi' ix meltzaj jab'ok heb' israel t'a spatik.

Haxo ix k'och spekal t'a winh rey to toxo ix el heb' israel chi', ix sna'anxi sb'a sk'ol winh yet' heb' ay yopisio yet'ok, ix yalan heb': Manhxo jantakok ko kistalil, yuj chi' ix ko chab'at heb' israel kak'umal serwil, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' t'a elanhchamel ix schek winh rey chi' to sb'ochaj scarruaje winh yik owal yet' heb' soldado.
Masanil carruaje yik Egipto ix yik'kot winh yet' 600 carruaje wach' t'a skal juntzanh chi', ajun heb' capitán yet' junjun scarruaje.

Ix pitb'i spensar winh rey chi' yuj Jehová, yuj chi' ix tzak'laj winh t'a spatik heb' israel chi'. Palta haxo heb' israel chi', ayik ix elta heb' t'a yol smakb'en Egipto chi' ix yik' wal cha'anh sb'a heb'.

Ix tzak'laj heb' aj Egipto t'a spatik heb' israel chi': Eb' soldado yet' nok' chej stok'an carruaje yet' jantak anima ayoch t'a yol carruaje chi'. Ijan ix yamchaj heb' yuj heb' aj Egipto chi' t'a sti' ha' mar t'a slak'anil Pi-hahirot, t'a yichanhkot Baal-zefón yujto hata' ay scampamento heb' israel chi'.
Haxo ix yilanb'at heb' israel to tzak'anxo'och winh rey yet' heb' soldado t'a spatik heb', ix xiwk'e heb', ix k'e yaw heb' t'a Jehová.
Ix yalan heb' t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --¿Tom malaj kampusante t'a Egipto, yuj chi' ha t'a jun lum takinh lu'um tik ix onh ik'koti yik tzonh cham t'a tik? ¿Tas wal yuj ix onh ik'elta t'a Egipto?

Ixto kal t'ayach ayik ayonhto ek' ta' to manh ik'ek' tiempo t'ayonh. B'ekan ko k'ol ko munlaj t'a heb' aj Egipto chi'. Yelxo wal wach' to t'a heb' aj Egipto chi' tzonh munlajnhej, t'a yichanh pax to t'a lum tzinan lum tik tzul onh chamok, xchi heb'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés t'a heb' anima chi': --Manh ex xiwok, tek'b'ejek he b'a. Ol eyilnab'i tas ol yutok Jehová skolwaj ket'ok tikne'ik. Manhxa b'aj ol eyil juntzanh heb' aj Egipto tik, haxonhej tikne'ik tzeyil heb'.
Mokab' eyak' somchaj he pensar, yujto a Jehová ol ak'an owal eyu'uj, xchi winh.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --¿Tas yuj tzach awaj t'ayin? Al t'a heb' etisraelal chi' to sb'eynhejb'at heb' t'a yichanh.
Ha tzex k'och t'a sti' ha' mar chi', tzik'ancha'anh te' a k'okoch, tzak'anb'at te' t'a yib'anh ha', ol spojan sb'a ha', ol cheklajk'e stak'inhal lu'um b'aj ol ex ek' t'a yol ha' chi'.

Ol wak'an pitb'okel spensar heb' aj Egipto chi'. Ol tzak'laj heb' t'a he patik yalani. Yuj tas ol wutok winh rey yet' heb' soldado chi', heb' soldado yet' jantak carruaje yet' masanil chej yet'nakkot winh yet' heb' anima ajun yet' heb' chi', ol cheklajok to te niwan welk'ochi.
Ayik ol wak'an ganar heb' chi' smasanil, ichato wal chi' ol yojtakanel heb' anima aj Egipto to a in Jehová in tik, a innhej Dios in, xchi Jehová.
Ha t'a jun rato chi', a Yángel Jehová yet' jun niwan topanh asun b'ab'el t'a yichanh heb' israel chi', ix meltzaj t'a spatik heb', ix och t'a skal heb' yet' heb' aj Egipto chi'.

Yuj chi' yelxo wal k'ik'k 'inal ix aj t'a yichanh heb' aj Egipto chi', haxo pax t'a skal heb' israel chi', yelxo wal sakk'inal smasanil. Yuj chi' maj yamchajlaj heb' israel chi' yuj heb' aj Egipto t'a jun ak'wal chi'.

Ix yak'anb'at sk'ab' winhaj Moisés t'a yib'anh ha' mar chi'. Haxo Jehová ix ak'ankot jun niwan ik' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Masanil t'a jun ak'wal chi' te ow ik', yuj chi' ix poj snanhal ha' mar yuj, ix cheklaj stak'inhal lum lum t'a snanhal ha'.

Te takinh jun b'e b'aj ix ek' heb' israel t'a yol ha' mar chi'. Ha t'a skal b'aj cha makan ix aj ha' chi', hata' ix ek' heb', icha tz'alk'e'en ix aj yochkan wa'an ha' t'a stz'eytak jun b'e t'a snanhal ha' chi'.
Haxo heb' aj Egipto yet' scarruaje winh rey yet' masanil heb' yet'nakkot scarruaje chi', ix kot heb' t'a spatik heb' israel t'a yol ha' chi', masanto t'a snanhal ha' ix ochk'och heb'.
Ayik toxo sakb'i, ha t'a skal k'ak' yet' t'a skal asun ix iljiemta heb' aj Egipto chi' yuj Jehová, ix ak'ji somchajb'at heb' yuj.
Ix elta srueda'il scarruaje heb', maxtzak yal-laj sb'ey heb', yuj chi' ix yalan heb': --Elokonhek lemnaj t'a heb' israel tik, yujto a Jehová tz'ak'an owal ket'ok yuj heb', xchi heb'.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ak'xib'at a k'ab' t'a yib'anh ha' mar yik syil-lajxi sb'a ha' t'a yib'anh masanil heb' aj Egipto chi', t'a yib'anh scarruaje heb' yet' t'a yib'anh heb' et'jinak nok' schej, yik smukchajkan yuj ha', xchi Jehová.

Ix yak'anxib'at sk'ab' winhaj Moisés chi' t'a yib'anh ha' mar chi'. Ayik ix sakb'i, ix yil-lajxi sb'a ha' ichataxon yaji. Ha ix meltzaj heb' winh aj Egipto chi' yalani, toxo pax ix yil-lajxi sb'a ha' t'a yichanh heb', yuj chi' ix mukchajkanem heb' t'a yol ha' yuj Jehová.

Icha chi' ix aj yil-lanxi sb'a ha' ichataxon yaji. Yuj chi' a scarruaje heb' winh yet' heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej yet' masanil heb' soldado winh rey ix b'at tzak'an yuj heb' israel chi', ix mukchajkan heb' t'a yol ha'. Manhxo junok ix kani.
Haxo pax masanil heb' israel jun, te wach'nhej ix aj yek' heb' t'a yol jun b'e takinh t'a yol ha' chi'. Ha t'a stz'eytak jun b'e chi', icha tz'alk'e'en ix aj yochkan wa'an ha'.
Haton t'a jun k'uhal chi' ix kolji heb' israel yuj Jehová t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Egipto chi'. Jantak heb' soldado aj Egipto ix cham chi', ix ilji heb' yuj heb' israel t'a sti' ha' mar chi'.

Icha wal chi' ix aj yilan heb' israel jantak spoder Jehová ix sch'ox yuj satanel heb' aj Egipto chi', yuj chi' ix xiw heb', ix yak'an wal och Jehová chi' heb' yipok sk'o'ol, ix yak'anpaxoch winhaj Moisés heb' t'a sk'o'ol to schekab' Dios yaj winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sb'itan jun b'it winhaj Moisés chi' yet' masanil heb' israel t'a yichanh Jehová, ix yalani: Sko b'itej sb'i Jehová, yujto te satub'tak ix aj yak'an ganar owal. Ix mukchajkan nok' chej t'a yol ha' mar yet' heb' winh et'jinak nok'.
Ha jun ko b'it tik yik Jehová, yujto a ko Kolumal yaji, yuj chi' skik'cha'anh. Ol kal wach' lolonel t'a ko Diosal, sDiosal pax heb' ko mam kicham, yuj chi' smoj wal kik'ancha'anh.
Te jelan yak'an owal, Jehová ton wal sb'i.
Ix mukchajkanem scarruaje winh sreyal Egipto yet' heb' soldado t'a yol ha' yuj Jehová. Yet' heb' capitán niwan yelk'ochi, ix b'atkan heb' t'a yich ha' Chakchak Mar.
Icha wal k'e'en k'e'en ix aj sb'atkan heb' t'a yich ha', ix mukchajkanem heb'.
Mamin Jehová, yelxo wal ay a poder. Ix ak' ganar heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayonh.
Ha yet' a niwan poder ix a mak' telwok heb' snib'ej syak' owal het'ok. Ayik ix kot owal, icha wal stz'ab'at anh ak, icha chi' ix aj slajwikanel heb' u'uj.
Yet' ipalil ix a pu'anb'at ik', yuj chi' ix spojb'at sb'a ha' mar. Icha tz'alk'e'en ix ajkan ha' t'a junjun stitak jun b'e takinh chi', icha wal to tzatzxonhej ix ajkan ha'.

Ix yalan heb' ajk'ol chi' icha tik: Ol onh tzak'laj t'a spatik heb' masanto ol yal syamchaj heb' ku'uj. Ol kik'anek' tastak ay t'a heb', ol ko pukanek'i, ichato ol kak' b'ut'jok ko k'o'ol yuj. Ol kik'ank'eta k'e'en kespada t'a yol yatut, ol ko satanel heb', xchi heb'.
Ayik ix a pu'anb'at ik' t'a yib'anh ha' mar, ix mukchajkan heb' winh yuj ha', ix b'atkan heb' winh t'a yich ha' icha k'e'en plomo.
Mamin Jehová, malaj junok Dios syal slajb'an sb'a het'ok. Niwan elk'ochi, yujto a achxonhej ochi. Manhxa junokxo mach syal sch'oxan milagro yet' tas satub'tak icha tza k'ulej.
Ix a ch'ox a poder, ichato ix turjib'at heb' yuj ha' mar.
Yuj a niwan wach'k'olal tzonh a kuchb'an a onh a chonhab' onh ix a kolkanel tik. Yet' a poder tzonh ik'anb'at t'a a kajnub' to iktaxon yaji.
Ayik ol yab'an jun tik juntzanhxo nación, ol ib'xokk'e heb' yuj xiwelal, ol xiwkank'e heb' filisteo.
Ha heb' yajalil heb' aj Edom, ol satkanb'at sk'ol heb'. Ha heb' yajal t'a Moab, ol luklonkan heb' yuj xiwelal. Icha pax chi' heb' cananeo, ol laj sk'ub'ejel sb'a heb',
yujto ol te xiwkank'e heb', ol sikb'okkanel heb'. Mamin Jehová, icha k'e'en k'e'en ol ajkan heb' yuj a poder, masanto ol onh ek'b'at a onh a chonhab' onh kolb'ilel uj tik.
Mamin Jehová, ol onh ik'b'at a onh a chonhab' onh tik het'ok t'a jun witz to ik yaji, jun lugar to a ach ix a sik'kaneli b'aj ol ach ajok, haton jun a kajnub' to a nanakkani.
Ach Jehová, Rey ach t'a masanil tiempo, xchi heb' israel t'a sb'it.

Ayik ix kot scarruaje winh sreyal Egipto yet' juntzanh heb' et'jinak nok' chej t'a yol ha' mar, ix mukjikanem heb' t'a yol ha' yuj spoder Jehová. Haxo pax heb' israel jun, yelxo wal wach' ix aj yek' heb' t'a yol jun b'e takinh t'a snanhal ha'.
Yuj chi', a ix María schekab' Dios, yanab' winhaj Aarón, ix yik'k'e jun spandereta ix. Masanil heb' ix yetisraelal ix yet'nakk'e spandereta heb' ix, ix k'e cheneljok heb' ix yet' ix.
Ix b'itan ix María t'a yichanh heb' ix icha tik: Ko b'itejek sb'i Jehová, yujto te satub'tak ix aj yak'an ganar owal. Ix mukchajkan nok' chej t'a yol ha' mar yet' heb' winh et'jinak nok', xchi ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anel heb' israel winhaj Moisés t'a sti' ha' Chakchak Mar chi', ix kot heb' t'a takinh lu'um yik Shur. Oxe' k'uhal ix b'ey heb', malaj b'aj ix ilchaj ha ha' yuj heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix jawi heb' t'a jun skuch Mara. Ay jun ha' ta', palta maj yal-laj yuk'an ha' heb' yujto yelxo wal te k'a' ha', yuj chi' Mara ix sb'iejkan jun lugar chi' yuj heb'.
Ix och ijan heb' anima chi' schichon sk'ol t'a spatik winhaj Moisés chi', ix laj yalan heb': ¿Tas ol kuk' tikne'ik? xchi heb'.

Yuj chi', ix sk'anan skolwal Jehová winhaj Moisés chi'. Haxo Jehová chi' ix ch'oxan jun te te' t'a winh, ix yak'anem te' winh t'a yol ha', ix b'o ha' yuj te'. Hata' ix yak' jun sley Jehová t'a heb' israel, yik syila' tato sk'anab'ajej heb'.

Ix yalan Jehová: Tato tze k'anab'ajej tas swal a in Jehová in tik, tze k'ulan tas syal in cheknab'il yet' masanil in k'ayb'ub'al, manh ol wak'kotlaj ilya t'a eyib'anh icha juntzanh ix wak'kot t'a yib'anh heb' aj Egipto, yujto a in Jehová in tzex wanhtej, xchi.
Ixlajwi chi', ix jawi heb' t'a Elim b'aj ay lajchawe' sjaj ha ha' yet' 70 te' palma. Hata' ix sb'ok'e scampamento heb' t'a stitak ha ha' chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix el heb' israel t'a Elim chi', ix jawi heb' t'a tzinan lum yik Sin, t'a skal Elim yet' Sinaí. Ha t'a jun k'u chi' nanhal schab'il ujalxo yelta heb' t'a Egipto.
Ayik ayek' heb' ta', masanil heb' ix alub'tanhan t'a spatik winhaj Moisés yet' t'a spatik winhaj Aarón.

Ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Komonok ix el t'a sk'ol Dios to ha t'a Egipto onh chamkani. Hata' tzonh em k'ojan t'a stz'ey lum chenal chib'ej, tzonh wa'i, masanto tzonh te b'ut'ji. Palta a exxo tik ix onh eyik'kot t'a takinh lu'um tik yik tzonh cham ko masanil yuj wejel, xchi heb'.

Yuj chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha t'a satcha'anh ol wak'kot tas ol he wa''a. Junjun k'u ol b'at he molank'e tas ol he wa''a, yuj chi' ol wila'' tato ol he k'anab'ajej in cheknab'il, mato ma'ay.
Haxo t'a swakil k'uhal, tze molankank'e yik chab'ok k'uhal, tze b'oankan yik jun k'u chi' yet' yik yukil k'uhal, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón chi' t'a heb' chonhab': --Ha t'a jun yemk'uhalil tik ol eyojtakejeli to yel a Jehová ix ex ik'anelta t'a Egipto.
Haxo t'a k'inhib'alil ol eyilan stzikikial, yujto ix yab'i tas ix eyutej he lolon t'a spatik. Palta a onh tik, ¿tok ay kelk'ochi, yuj chi' tzeyal ko pekal? xchi heb' winh.

Ix yalanpax winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha t'a yemk'uhalil tik ol yak' nok' chib'ej Jehová he chi'a. Haxo t'a junjun k'inhib'alil, ol yak'an he wa'el hato syala' jantak tze wa''a, yujto ix yab'i tas tzeyalub'tanhej t'a spatik. Wach'chom t'a ko patik tzeyalub'tanhej eyalani, palta malaj kelk'och a onh tik. Wal yel ha t'a spatik Jehová tzeyalub'tanhej, xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun rato chi' ix yal winhaj Moisés chi' t'a winhaj Aarón: --Al t'a heb' smasanil to snitzkot sb'a heb' t'a yichanh Jehová, yujto ix yab'i tas ix yalub'tanhej heb', xchi winh.
Ha wal yik wan slolon winhaj Aarón t'a heb' yetisraelal chi', ix yilanb'at heb' t'a tzinan lu'um, ix sch'oxank'e sb'a stzikikial Jehová t'a skal jun topanh asun.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':

--Ix wab' wal tas ix yal heb' israel tik t'a in patik. Yuj chi' al t'a heb' to a tikne'ik t'a k'ik'b'alil, ol wak' nok' schib'ej heb', haxo sk'inhib'i k'ik'an swak' tas swa heb', masanto sb'ut'ji wal sk'ol heb'. Icha chi' ol aj yojtakanel heb' to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in, xchi Jehová.
Ha t'a jun yemk'uhalil chi', ix jawi nhilnaj nok' ub', ix majel b'aj ay scampamento heb' yuj nok'. Haxo t'a k'inhib'alil t'a junxo k'u, ix em yal ak'wal t'a spatiktak scampamento heb' chi'.
Ayik ix takji yal ak'wal chi', ay juntzanh tas te kotak ix kan t'a sat lu'um, icha k'e'en che'ew yilji.
Manh yojtakok juntzanh chi' heb'. Ayik ix yilanoch heb', ix yal-lan heb' t'ay junjun: ¿Tastaxlaj juntzanh tik? xchi heb'. Ix yalan winhaj Moisés: --Haton he wa'el syak' Jehová tik.
Haton jun cheknab'il ix yak' tik: Syal he molancha'anh t'a junjun k'u, icha jantak tz'och eyuj yuj jaywanh ex t'a yol he pat. Ik'ekk'e junjunok echlab' yik junjun anima, xchi winh.
Ichaton chi' ix yutej heb' anima chi'. Ay mach niwan ix molank'ei, ay pax mach kennhej.
Hato a yechlab'il ix ak'chaji, maj yak' sobre t'a heb' niwan ix molank'ei, hanheja' k'okb'il ix yab'pax t'a heb' kennhej ix molank'ei. Junjun mach ix smolk'e jantak swa t'a junjun k'u.
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés t'a heb': --Max yal-laj he molankan yik he k'ik'an, xchi winh.

Ay mach maj k'anab'ajanlaj tas ix yal winh, ix smolankan jab'okxo yik swa heb' k'ik'an yalani. Ha tas ix smolkan heb' chi', ix och ha'ayaxok, ix k'e sjab' t'a junxo k'u, yuj chi' ix kot yowal winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb' maj k'anab'ajan chi'.
Junjun k'inhib'alil smolank'e heb' jantak swa t'a jun k'u chi', haxo yik sja yok k'u tz'ulaxb'ati.

Haxo t'a swakil k'uhal, junjunto echlab' sobre'al syik'k'e heb' yik swa junjun heb', syalelk'ochi to chab'chab' echlab' yik junjun heb'. Haxo heb' ayoch yajalil t'a skal heb' anima chi', ix b'at yal heb' t'a winhaj Moisés.
