Yuj chi' ix yalan winh: --Ha jun chi' a Jehová ix halani, yujto a k'ik'an sk'uhal ik'oj ip. Ha jun ik'oj ip chi' sk'uhal yik tz'ik'jicha'anh Jehová. Tze tz'anhkan tas stz'anhchaji yik tze wa k'ik'an, tze mayankan tas smaychaji, tze sik'ankan yik he k'ik'an chi', xchi winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajan heb' anima tas ix yal winhaj Moisés chi'. Ix sik'ankanb'at masanil tas swa heb' t'a junxo k'u. Maj ixtaxb'atok, maj ochpax ha'ayaxok.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi': --Waek he wa'el kan eyuj ewi, yujto sk'uhal ik'oj ip tikne'ik, tze k'anab'ajej eyik'ancha'anh Jehová. Ha t'a jun k'uhal tik, malaj jab'ok tas tze wa chi' tz'ilchaj eyuj t'a spatiktak campamento tik.
Yujto anhej t'a wake' k'u t'a yol semana syal he molan tas tze wa''a, haxo t'a yukil k'uhal, manhxalaj tas sjawi, yujto sk'uhal ik'oj ip, xchi winh.
Palta ay heb' ix b'at sayan yik t'a yukil k'uhal chi', palta malaj jab'ok tas ix ilchaj yuj heb'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Yelxo wal max he k'anab'ajej, ¿tom ol ex ochnhej ijan he tenanek' in cheknab'il yet' in k'ayb'ub'al?

Naek wal sik'lab'il, a in Jehová in swala' to yowalil tze k'anab'ajej sk'uhal ik'oj ip. Yuj chi' ha t'a swakil k'uhal, swak' wa'el t'a chab' k'uhal, yuj chi' ha t'a jun k'uhal chi', wach'nhej eyajek' t'a yol b'ajtak ayex, malaj mach sb'at munlajel, xchi t'a winh.
Ichaton chi' ix aji, ix yik'an yip heb' anima t'a yukil k'uhal chi'.
Maná ix yak' heb' israel skuch juntzanh wa'el ix smol chi'. Saksak yilji icha wal sat anh culantro. Te chi' swaji, icha ixim k'oxox pan ayoch yalchab' t'ay.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Moisés: --Ix yal Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Sik'ekb'at junok echlab' maná, yik ol yil heb' eyuninal t'a b'ak'inh. Ol yil he wa'el heb' ix wak' he wa t'a lum tzinan lu'um tik, ayik ix ex wik'anelta t'a Egipto, xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.

Yuj chi', ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Aarón: --Ik'kot junok chen, tzak'anem junok echlab' maná t'a yo'ol icha yalan Jehová. Slajwi chi', tza sik'ankanb'at t'a yichanh Jehová chi', yik wach' ol yil heb' kinhtilal, xchi winh.
Icha ix yutej Jehová yalan t'a winhaj Moisés chi', icha chi' ix yutej winhaj Aarón, ix sik'ankanb'at winh t'a stz'ey k'e'en k'e'en b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan strato Jehová.
T'a 40 ab'il ix swa maná heb' israel, masanto ix k'och heb' t'a lum kajnub'al t'a smojonal Canaán.
Ha jun echlab' chi', Gomer sb'i, ay am nanhalok yoxil litro ha ha' tz'em t'a yo'ol.
Masanil heb' israel ix el t'a lum tzinan lu'um yik Sin, k'ojank'olal ix aj sb'ey heb', hato syal tas tz'aj sch'oxan Jehová. Ixlajwi chi', ix jawi heb' t'a Refidim, palta malaj ha ha' ta'.
Yuj chi' ix kotxi yowal heb' t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha tikne'ik, ak' ha ha' kuk'ej, xchi heb'. --¿Tas yuj skot eyowal t'ayin? ¿Tas yuj tzeyak' prowal Jehová? xchi winh.

Palta haxo heb' chonhab' yelk'olal scham heb' yuj takinhtial, yuj chi' ix k'e yaw heb' t'a winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalan heb': --¿Tas yuj ix onh ik'elta t'a Egipto? ¿Tom yuj ko cham yuj takinhtial yet' heb' kuninal yet' pax nok' ko molb'etzal nok'? xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix tewi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a Jehová icha tik: --Mamin, ¿tas wal swutej heb' anima tik? Ijan wal tzin sjulk'enej heb', xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winh: --Ha tikne'ik, b'ab'lajanh t'a yichanh heb' anima chi', tzik'anb'at jaywanhok heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' chi' het'ok. Tzik'anpaxb'at te' a k'okoch, te' ak'lab'ejnak a mak'an sat ha' Nilo.

Ha in ol in b'ab'laj t'a ichanh t'a k'e'en tenam t'a Horeb, haxo ol ach k'och ta', tza mak'an sat k'e'en yet' te' a k'okoch chi', ol elul ha' t'a sat k'e'en, ol yuk'an ha' heb' anima chi', xchi t'a winh. Icha chi' ix yutej winhaj Moisés chi' t'a yichanh heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' Israel.

Meriba ix yak' winh sb'iej jun lugar chi', yujto chuk ix yal heb' t'a spatik winh. Masah pax ix yak' winh sb'iej, yujto ix yak' prowal Jehová heb', ix yalan heb': Mato wal ayek' Jehová t'a ko kal, mato ma'ay, xchi heb'.
Ayik ayek' heb' israel t'a Refidim chi', hata' ix k'och heb' amalecita yak' owal yet' heb'.

Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Moisés t'a winhaj Josué: --Sik'el jantakok heb' ko soldado yik sb'at heb' yak' owal yet' heb' amalecita. Ha k'ik'an tzin b'at t'a chon tzalan, wet'nak te' k'okoch, te' syak'lab'ej Dios, xchi winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajan winhaj Josué chi', ix b'at yak'an owal winh yet' heb' amalecita chi'. Haxo winhaj Moisés chi' yet' winhaj Aarón yet' pax winhaj Hur, ix b'at heb' winh t'a chon tzalan chi'.
Ha syik'ank'e sk'ab' winhaj Moisés t'a cha'anh, skan heb' amalecita t'a yalanh yuj heb' israel. Haxo syik'anxiem sk'ab' winh, ijan skan heb' winh israel t'a yalanh.

Palta ste k'unb'i sk'ab' winh sb'at jekan, yuj chi' ix say jun k'e'en k'e'en winhaj Aarón yet' winhaj Hur chi'. Ha t'a yib'anh k'e'en ix em k'ojan winhaj Moisés chi', haxo heb' winh ix yamank'e sk'ab' winh chi', junjun heb' winh t'a stz'eytak winh masanto ix b'at k'u.
Icha chi' ix aj yak'an lajwok heb' amalecita winhaj Josué chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Tz'ib'chajokab'kan jun ab'ix tik yik ol nachajkotok. Tzalanpax t'a winhaj Josué chi' to a in ol in satel masanil heb' amalecita t'a junelnhej, manhxa b'aj ol nachajkot heb', xchi t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sb'oank'e jun altar winhaj Moisés chi', ix yak'an winh sb'iej icha tik: Ha Jehová b'ab'el ku'uj t'a owal.
Ix yalan winh icha tik: Yujto ix yik'cha'anh sk'ab' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Amalec yak'an owal yet' Jehová, yuj chi' ol yak'nhej owal Jehová yet' heb' aj Amalec t'a masanil tiempo, xchi winh.
Ha winhaj Jetro, snhi' winhaj Moisés, sacerdote yaj t'a Madián. Ix yab' winh jantak tas ix sk'ulej Dios yet' winhaj Moisés yet' pax chonhab' Israel, ayik ix ik'jielta heb' yuj t'a Egipto.
Ha winhaj Moisés chi', yak'nak meltzaj ix yetb'eyum winh, haton ix Séfora yet' chawanh yuninal winh t'a winhaj Jetro chi'. Ix chaji heb' yuj winhaj Jetro chi'.
(Ha winh sb'ab'el unin winhaj Moisés chi', Gersón sb'i winh, yujto ix yal winh: Tonhej tzin b'eyek' t'a skal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, xchi winh.
Haxo winh schab'il skuch Eliezer, yujto ix yal winh: Aynhejoch sDiosal in mam wet'ok, a ix in kolanel t'a k'e'en yespada winh sreyal Egipto, xchi winh.)

Haxo ix yab'an winhaj Jetro to ha t'a tzinan lu'um ay scampamento winhaj Moisés chi', t'a yich witz b'aj sch'ox sb'a Dios. Hata' ix b'at winhaj Jetro chi' yil winh yet'nak ix Séfora yetb'eyum winhaj Moisés chi' winh. Yet'nakpax heb' yuninal winhaj Moisés chi' winh.
Ix yalanb'at winh t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha in Jetro a nhi' in tik, wan in k'och ach wila'', ajun ix etb'eyum wet'ok yet' pax heb' winh eyuninal schawanhil, xchib'at winh.

T'a elanhchamel ix elta winhaj Moisés scha winh snhi' chi', ix em nhojan winh t'a yichanh winh, ix stz'ub'anelta sti' winh. Ixlajwi yak'lan stzatzil sk'ol heb', ix och heb' t'a yol smantiado winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a winh snhi' chi' tas ix utaj winh sreyal Egipto yet' masanil heb' aj Egipto yuj Jehová ayik ix skolanel heb' chonhab' israel. Ix yalanpax winh yuj jantak yahelal ix yil yet' heb' anima chi' t'a yoltak b'e yet' tas ix aj skolji heb' yuj Jehová.
Ix te tzalaj sk'ol winhaj Jetro chi', a ix yab'an skolwal Dios winh t'a chonhab' Israel, ayik ix skolanelta heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Egipto.
Ix yalan winh: --Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, haton ix ex kolanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Egipto yet' t'a yol sk'ab' winh rey, ix ex yik'anelta t'a yalanh smandar heb'.

Ha tikne'ik sik'lab'il wal snachajel wu'uj to a Jehová yelxo wal ek'al t'a yib'anh juntzanhxo Dios, yujto ix ex koljiel yuj t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Egipto, wach'chom ix ste ik'ejcha'anh sb'a heb' t'a yichanh, xchi winhaj Jetro chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix snhusan jun nok' silab' winhaj Jetro chi' t'a Dios, ix yak'anpax juntzanhxo silab' winh t'ay. Ix ja winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' b'aj ayek' winh snhi' winhaj Moisés chi', ix wa heb' t'a yichanh Jehová.
Haxo t'a junxo k'uhal, ix em k'ojan winhaj Moisés, ix och ijan winh sch'olb'itan tastak yaj yowal heb' chonhab'. Pilan k'u ayek' heb' anima chi' t'a yichanh winh.

Ayik ix yilan winhaj Jetro yuj tas syutej winhaj Moisés sb'o'an yaj yowal heb' anima chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj icha chi' tzutej heb' anima tik? ¿Tas yuj a achnhej tza b'o yaj yowal heb' smasanil? Ay heb' tonhej tzek' tiempo t'ay, pilan k'u stanhwej heb', xchi winhaj Jetro chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi': --Sjawi heb' anima tik t'ayin yik tzin k'anb'an t'a Dios yuj heb'.
Ayik syak'an owal heb' sjawipax heb' t'ayin, tzin ch'olb'itan mach tzek' t'a yib'anh yet' mach yel syala', slajwi chi' swalan scheknab'il yet' sk'ayb'ub'al Dios t'a heb', xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh snhi' winh chi': --Manh wach'ok icha tzutej chi'.
Tzach te k'unb'i, ste k'unb'ipax heb' anima tik. Yelxo tzek' yib'anh a munlaji, hanhejtona' manh ol ach tzak'wanpaxlaj a ch'okoj.
Ab' tas ol wal t'ayach, ha Dios ol kolwaj het'ok. Ha ach tzach och t'a yichanh Dios yuj heb' anima, tzalan t'ay yuj tastak sk'ulej heb'.
Wach' to tza k'ayb'ej heb' t'a sley Jehová, tzalani tas ol aj sb'eyb'at heb' yet' tas ol sk'ulej heb'.

Ha jun tas wach' tza k'ulej tikne'ik to tza sik'el jaywanhok heb' winh ay xiwk'olal t'a Dios, heb' winh jelan spensar, heb' winh tojol spensar, heb' winh manh komonok sk'ananel tumin t'a anima. Tzak'anoch yopisio heb' winh t'a yib'anh junjunok makan anima. Ay heb' winh tzak'och yajalilok t'a junok mil anima, ay pax heb' winh tzak'och yajalilok t'a junok cien, ay pax heb' winh anhej t'a junok 50 b'aj tzak'ochi, ay pax heb' winh anhej t'a lajunhwanhok b'aj tzak'ochi.

Ha heb' winh tik ol b'oan yaj yowal heb' anima. Tato kennhej yaj yowal anima chi', sb'o'okab' yaj heb' winh. Tato niwan yaj jun, yik'okab'kot heb' t'a ichanh. Tato icha chi' ol utej, ol kolwaj jab'ok heb' yik'anel jun munlajel tik t'a ib'anh.

Tato tza k'anab'ajej a k'ulan jun tik, tato schapax sk'ol Dios to icha chi' ol ajok, icha chi' ol aj stechaj u'uj. Hanhejtona' heb' anima tik ol meltzaj heb' t'a tzalajk'olal t'a yet'tal junjun, xchi winhaj Jetro chi'.
Ix sk'anab'ajan winhaj Moisés tas ix yal winh snhi' chi'.

Yuj chi' ix sik'anel heb' te ay spensar winh, heb' jelan t'a skal heb' yetchonhab', ix yak'anoch yopisio heb' winh t'a yib'anh junjun mil anima, t'a yib'anh cien, t'a yib'anh 50 yet' t'a yib'anh lajunhwa'anh.
Ha heb' winh chi' aynhejoch t'a yib'anh sch'olb'itan yaj heb' anima. Ha owal te niwan yaji, tz'ik'chajb'at t'a yichanh winhaj Moisés chi'. Haxo pax owal kennhej yaj jun, a heb' winh sb'o'an yaji.
Ix stak'lankan sb'a winhaj Jetro yet' winhaj Moisés chi', ix pax winh t'a schonhab'.
Ha wal stz'akwi yoxil ujal yel heb' israel t'a Egipto, ix ja heb' t'a takinh lu'um b'aj ay lum Sinaí,
spetoj heb' t'a Refidim. Ha ix ja heb' ta' ix sb'o'an scampamento heb' t'a yich witz Sinaí.
Ix awtajk'e winhaj Moisés yuj Jehová Dios t'a jolom witz chi' yik slolon yet' winh. Ix yalan icha tik: --Al juntzanh lolonel tik t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob, haton heb' etisraelal:
Scham wal eyilan tas ix wutej heb' anima t'a Egipto yet' tas ix wutej ex wik'anelta, ayik ex wik'ankot b'aj ayex ek' tik. Ichato yib'anh sk'axil nok' niwak ch'akb'a ayexk'ei ayik ix ex ja t'a tik.
Tato te k'anab'ajum tzeyutej he b'a t'ayin, tze k'anab'ajan in trato, in chonhab' ex toni, sik'b'il ex el wuj t'a skal juntzanhxo chonhab'. Wik jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik smasanil,
palta a exxo tik, jun chonhab'il sacerdote tzex ajkani yik tzin eyak'an serwil, jun chonhab' anima to wiknhej yaji, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix emixta winhaj Moisés t'a jolom witz Sinaí chi', ix yawtankot heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' winh. Ix och ijan winh yalan tas ix yal Jehová chi'.
Masanil heb' israel ix tak'wi icha tik: --Masanil tas schek Jehová ko k'ulej, ol ko k'ulejnhej, xchi heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at yalanxi winhaj Moisés t'a Jehová tas ix yal heb' chonhab' chi'.

Ix yalanxi Jehová chi' t'a winh: --Ha tikne'ik, ol in ch'ox in b'a t'ayach t'a skal jun niwan k'ik'al asun, ol in lolon het'ok, yik wach' ol yab' heb' anima, ol ach yak'anoch heb' t'a sk'o'ol t'a masanil tiempo, xchi. Ix yalanxi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a Jehová tas ix yutej yalan heb' chonhab' chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová: --Ixik, tzal t'a heb' anima to sakb'itej sb'a heb' tikne'ik yet' k'ik'an, sjuk'anel spichul heb' yujto ol och heb' ejmelal t'a wichanh.
Haxo chab'ej tzin emuli, tzin ch'oxan in b'a t'a masanil chonhab' t'a jolom witz Sinaí.

Tzak'em yechel t'a yichtak witz tik, tzalan t'a heb' to niwanokab' yelk'och jun witz tik t'a yol sat heb'. Max yal-laj sk'eta heb' t'ay, max yal ste jawi heb' t'a stz'ey, tato ay junok mach sjawi t'a stz'ey, yowalil schami.

Malaj mach syal smak'ancham jun anima chi' yet' sk'ab'. Sjulk'enaj chami, ma sjuljicham yet' jul-lab'. Taxonhej anima ma junok nok' nok', tojolnhej schami. Hato ol puchaj sch'a'ak nok' kalnel, ichato chi' syal snitzankot sb'a heb' anima t'a slak'anil lum witz tik, xchi Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi', ix paxta winhaj Moisés t'a jolom witz chi', ix ul yalan winh t'a heb' israel chi' to sakb'itej sb'a heb', sjuk'anpaxel spichul heb'.
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb': --Ha tikne'ik sakb'itejek he b'a, yujto tzex och ejmelal t'a Jehová chab'ej. Manhxo ex way yet' heb' ix eyetb'eyum t'a chab' k'uhal tik, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Haxo ix sakb'i t'a schab'jial, ix ek' kopnaj lheb'lon, ix mak'waj k'u, ay jun niwan asun k'ik' t'a jolom witz chi'. Ixlajwi chi, ix yab'an heb' anima te cha'anh ix ok' jun k'e'en trompeta t'a jolom witz chi'. Masanil heb' anima ayek' t'a yol campamento chi', ix xiwk'e heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anb'at masanil heb' anima winhaj Moisés chi' t'a spatikel campamento chi', ix b'at scha'an Dios heb', ix kan hoyan heb' t'a slak'anil yich lum witz chi'.
Ix te k'e stab'il lum witzal Sinaí chi', ix emul Jehová t'a skal jun niwan k'ak'. Icha wal sk'e stab'il junok horno, icha wal chi' sk'e stab'il, ix te ib'xik'e jun witz chi'.
Haxo k'e'en trompeta chi', juntak el spuji k'e'en, ste k'echa'anh sjaj k'e'en. Haton ta' ix lolon winhaj Moisés yet' Jehová. Te cha'anh syutej tak'wok sb'a Jehová chi' t'a winh.
Ha wal t'a scha'anhil sjolom lum witz chi', hata' ix emul Jehová, ix yalan t'a winhaj Moisés chi' to sk'e winh b'aj ayek' chi', yuj chi' ix k'e winh.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winh: --Ha tikne'ik emanh t'a yich witz chi', b'at halan t'a heb' anima to max ek'ta heb' in yil b'aj aykanem jun yechel, haxo talaj tz'aji, tzijtum heb' schami.
Hanheja' heb' sacerdote tz'ochtaxon t'a in lak'anil, yowalil sakb'itej sb'a heb'. Tato ma'ay, haxo talaj tz'aji, swach' satel heb', xchi t'a winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi' t'ay: --Ha heb' chonhab' chi', max yal-laj sk'eta heb' t'a lum witz tik, yujto a ach ix ala' to tz'em yechel b'aj syal sjawi heb' yuj sch'oxani to niwan yelk'ochi, xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winh icha tik: --Emanhxi, haxo tzach k'euli et'nakokab' winhaj Aarón. Haxo heb' sacerdote yet' masanil heb' chonhab', max k'axpajek'talaj heb' b'aj aykanem yechel chi' u'uj, yik max jawi heb' b'aj ayinek' tik, tato ma'ay, xim miltachamlaj heb', xchi Jehová.
Ix emta winhaj Moisés chi', ix ul yalan winh t'a heb' chonhab' tas ix yal Jehová chi'.
Ix lolon Dios t'a heb' israel, ix yalan t'a heb' icha tik:
Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in, ix ex wik'elta t'a yol yik Egipto b'aj ayex och chekab'ok, b'aj manh eyikok he b'a.
Malajokab' junokxo Dios b'aj tzex och ejmelal, palta anhejokab' t'ayin.
Manh he b'o yechel junok tas he diosalok, junok tas ay t'a satcha'anh, tas ay t'a sat lu'um tik, ma tastak ay t'a yoltak ha ha'.

Manh ex em nhojan t'ay, manh eyak'paxem he b'a t'ay, yujto a in Jehová he Diosal in, ste kot wowal t'ayex tato tzex och ejmelal t'a junokxo tasi. Ol wak'och syahelal heb' mamab'il malaj welk'och t'ay. Ol wak'anpax yahelal t'a yib'anh yuninal heb', yixchikin heb' yet' yinhtilal heb'.
Haxo heb' tzin xajanani, heb' sk'anab'ajan in cheknab'il, ol in xajanej heb' yet' heb' yinhtilal heb' yik ol b'eynhejb'atok.
Manh komonok tze lok in b'i a in Jehová he Diosal in tik, ma tzeyak' b'inaj in b'i t'a junok tas t'a ichnhej ta', yujto ol wak' yahelal t'a mach icha chi' sk'ulej.
Niwanokab' yelk'och sk'uhal ik'oj ip t'ayex yuj in eyik'ancha'anh.
Wake' k'uhal tzex munlaj t'a he munlajel,

haxo t'a yukil k'uhal, sk'uhal ik'oj ip. Ha jun k'u chi' wik yaji. Manh ex munlaj t'a jun k'u chi' yet' heb' eyuninal, heb' eyisil, ma heb' winh he chekab', ma heb' ix he chekab', ma nok' he molb'etzal nok', nok' smunlaji, ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal, mokab' munlaj heb'.

Yujto a in Jehová in tik, t'a wake' k'uhal ix in b'o satcha'anh yet' sat lu'um yet' ha' mar yet' masanil tastak ay t'ay. Haxo t'a yukil k'uhal, ix och wa'an in munlaji, yuj chi' a jun yukil k'uhal chi' wik yaji, yuj yochpax he wach'ilok.
Ayokab' yelk'och he mam he nun t'a he sat, yik wach' snajatb'i he k 'inal t'a sat lum lum ol wak' t'ayex.
Manh he milcham heb' eyetanima'il.
Manh ex em ajmulal t'a yol sk'ab' eyetb'eyum junjun ex.
Manh ex elk'anok.
Manh he nak'e lolonel t'a spatik heb' eyetanima'il.

Manh he nib'ejoch spat heb' eyetanima'il. Manh he nib'ejpaxoch ix yetb'eyum heb', winh schekab' heb', ma ix schekab' heb', nok' swakax heb', nok' sb'uru heb', ma junokxo tas ay t'a heb' eyetanima'il chi', manh he nib'ejochi, xchi Jehová.

Masanil heb' israel ix yab' wal heb' smak'waj k'u. Ix yilan heb' yek' kopoljok k'ak', ix yab'anpax heb' te cha'anh ix puji jun k'e'en trompeta. Ix yilan wal heb' sk'e stab'il lum witzal Sinaí, ix ib'xik'e heb' yuj xiwelal, ix snitzanel sb'a heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yal heb' t'a winhaj Moisés: --Ha ach tzach lolon t'ayonh. Ol ko k'anab'ajan tas ol yal Jehová Dios chi' t'ayach. Mokxob' lolon t'ayonh, tato ma'ay, ol onh chamok, xchi heb' anima chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi': --Manh ex xiwok, tonhej tzulek' Dios chi' yik tzex yak'an prowal, yik wach' aynhej he xiwk'olal t'ay, yik manh ol ochnhej he mul, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' a heb' chonhab' chi', najat ayel heb', haxo winhaj Moisés chi' ix snitzb'at sb'a winh t'a slak'anil jun asun k'ik' b'aj ayek' Dios chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': Al juntzanh lolonel tik smasanil t'a heb' etisraelal: Ha ex tik ix heyila' chajtil ix wutej in lolonemta t'ayex t'a satcha'anh.
Manh he b'o k'e'en oro ma k'e'en plata he diosalok yik b'aj tzex och ejmelal, icha tz'aj eyak'anem he b'a t'ayin.

B'o'ek junok altar t'ayin, nab'a lu'um tzeyak'och t'ay, yik b'aj tze nhustz'a nok' kalnel, ma nok' wakax tzeyak' silab'il t'ayin, ma b'aj tze nhustz'a ofrenda yik he junk'olal wet'ok. Yalnhej b'aj ol in ch'ox t'ayex yik tzex och ejmelal t'ayin, hata' ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'a eyib'anh.
Tato a k'e'en k'e'en tzeyak'och t'a junok altar chi', manh he tzeylaj k'e'en, tato tzeyak'och k'e'en tzeyb'il chi', manh wach'ok t'a yol in sat.
Ha jun altar tze b'o chi', manh eyak'och sk'o'ochal b'aj tzex k'e'i, yik wach' max ilji he niwanil, xa chi t'a heb', xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': Ha juntzanh ley tik ol al t'a heb' etchonhab' yik sk'anab'ajej heb':

Tato ay junok winh eyetchonhab' tze mana' yik tz'och he chekab'ok, anhej wake' ab'il smunlaj winh heyet'ok, haxo t'a yukil ab'il tzeyak'anel winh t'a libre, yikxo sb'a winh. Malaj tumin syak' winh yik tzeyak'anel winh t'a libre chi'.
Tato sch'okojilnhej winh k'ochnak t'ayex, hanheja' sch'okojil winh sb'ati. Tato ay ix yetb'eyum winh yet'nak jun, hanheja' syik'b'at ix winh yet'ok.
Tato a ex ix he man winh chi', a ex ix eyak'och yetb'eyum winh, skan ix ix chi' yet' heb' unin heyet'ok, sch'okoj winh sb'ati.
Tato syal winh chekab' chi' jun: Malaj in gana tzin el t'a libre yujto xajan winh in patrón yet' ix wetb'eyum yet' pax heb' wuninal wu'uj, tato xchi winh,

tzeyik'b'at winh t'a yichanh heb' yajal. Tz'och linhan winh t'a smarcoal spuerta'il sdespacho heb' winh yajal chi', tzeyolan schikin winh t'a k'e'en ol-lab', tz'ochkan yechel winh to skan winh heyet'ok t'a junelnhej.
Tato ay junok mach schonhel yisil t'a chekab'ok, max yal-laj yak'jiel heb' ix t'a libre ichok heb' winh winak.

Tato a winh spatrón ix chi' maj cha'anlaj sk'ol yoch ix yetb'eyumok icha yaj strato heb' yujto malaj snib'ej winh t'a ix, syal smanjixiel ix yuj junok sk'ab'yok. Wach'chom malaj snib'ej winh patrón chi' syik'laj sb'a yet' ix, palta max yal-laj schonhan ix winh t'a junok ch'ok chonhab'il.
Tato a winh patrón chi' smanan ix yik tz'och ix yetb'eyumok junok yuninal, ichaokab' yisil syutej ix.
Palta tato a winh spatrón ix chi' tz'ik'an ix yetb'eyumok, syik'an junokxo ix winh, mokab' emnakil tz'aj ix b'ab'el chi', palta yowalil syak' swa'el ix winh yet' spichul ix, swaypax winh yet' ix.
Tato max sk'anab'ajej winh yak'an oxe' tastak tik, tz'aktajel ix, manhxa pax tas stup ix yik tz'aktajeli.
Ha mach smilancham junok anima, yowalil smiljipaxchamok.
Palta tato manh sk'anok sk'ol ix milwaji, tato stiempo'alxo scham jun anima chi', a in Jehová in ol wal t'ayex b'aj ol b'at sk'ub'ejel sb'a jun mach ix milancham anima chi'.
Palta a mach scham wal sna'ani smilancham yetanima'il, wach'chom b'aj ay waltar sb'at skol sb'a, tz'ik'chajelta, smiljichamok.
Ha mach smak'an smam ma snun, yowalil schami.
Tato ay mach tz'elk'anb'at junok anima, tato toxo ix schonhb'ati, ma aytoek' yet'ok, ayik syamchaj jun elk'um anima chi', yowalil schami.
Ha mach sb'ajan smam snun, mak'jokab' chamok.
Tato ay chawanhok syak' owal, tato ay junok winh slajwi yuj junxo winh chi', taxonhej k'e'en syak'lab'ej winh, ma yet' sk'ab', anhejto max chami, palta te niwan ix aj yab'an sya'il,
haxo t'a jaye'ok k'uhal tzaxo yal yek'xi yet' sk'okoch. Ha winh smak'waj chi', yowalil stup winh b'aj tz'anhtaj winh slajwi chi' yet' pax sk'u winh, palta max ak'jiochlaj chamel t'a yib'anh winh.
Tato ay junok winh patrón smak'an schekab' yet' te te', taxonhej winak ma ix, haxo tz'aji schami, yowalil tz'och chamel t'a yib'anh winh.
Palta tato tzato ek' jun chekab' chi' chab' oxeokxo k'uhal, ichato chi' schami, maxtzak ak'jiochlaj chamel t'a yib'anh winh patrón chi', yujto yik yaj jun schekab' chi'.

Tato ay chawanhok winak wan yak'an owal, syamchajk'och junok ix ix to yab'ixxo t'a skal owal chi' yuj heb', tz'el unin chi' t'a spatik ix, palta malaj jab'ok tz'ik'an ix, a winh tz'och smul chi' stupan jantak sk'an winh yetb'eyum ix, anhejton pax ha', hato syala' tas tz'aj sch'olb'itaj yuj heb' winh juez.
Palta tato ay tas tz'ik'an ix jun, hato syala' tas tz'ik'an ix chi', icha pax chi' tz'utajpax winh tz'och smul chi'. Tato scham ix, schampax winh.
Tato tz'ixtax yol sat ix, ma k'e'en ye ix, ma sk'ab' ix, ma yok ix,
ta stz'a ix, ma slajwi ix, ma tonhej syaxla' sniwanil ix, hanheja' icha wal tz'utaj ix chi', icha wal chi' tz'utajpax winh winak chi'.
Tato ay junok mach smak'anpoj yol sat junok winh schekab', ma junok ix schekab', tz'aktajel winh chekab' ma ix chekab' sk'exulok jun yol sat ix poj chi'.
Tato ay junok mach smak'anel k'e'en ye junok schekab', tz'aktajel jun chekab' chi' sk'exulok k'e'en ye chi'.
Tato ay junok nok' toro stekancham junok anima, yowalil sjuljicham nok', max chijilaj schib'ejal nok', palta malaj tas tz'och t'a yib'anh winh yajal nok' chi'.
Palta tato yojtak winh yajal nok' chi' to owtaxon nok' t'a anima, max yetzb'anpax nok' winh, tato stekjicham junok anima yuj nok', yowalil sjuljicham nok', schampax winh yajal nok' chi'.
Tato schaji tupchaj jun chamel chi', stup winh yajal nok' chi', hato syala' jantak sk'an heb' aj chamnak chi', tato icha chi' maxtzak chamlaj winh.
Haton wal juntzanh ley tik tz'och yopisio tato ay junok uninab'il ma isilab'il stekjicham yuj nok' wakax.
Tato a junok winh chekab', ma junok ix chekab' stekjicham yuj nok', yowalil tz'ak'chaj 30 siclo k'e'en plata t'a winh spatrón jun chekab' chi', sjuljipaxcham nok' wakax chi'.
K'inalok ay junok mach max smakchej sti' ha' yuk'lab' ha', ma sjoy junok olan, max smakchejpax sti', sb'at junok nok' wakax, ma junok nok' b'uru t'a yo'ol,
yowalil stup winh ay yik jun olan chi' t'a winh aj nok' chi', skan nok' ix cham chi' t'a winh ay yik olan chi'.

Tato ay junok nok' storo junok mach stekancham nok' storo junokxo, yowalil schonhjiel nok' ix tekwaj chi', spukanek' k'e'en stojol nok' chi' heb' t'a spatik. Hanheja' spukpaxek' nok' ix tekjicham chi' heb'.
Tato yojtakxo winh ay yik nok' ix tekwaj chi' to toxonton ow nok', max stanhwanpax nok' winh, yowalil syak' junokxo nok' winh sk'exulok nok' ix cham chi', skan nok' chamnak chi' t'a winh.

Tato ay junok mach tz'elk'an junok nok' wakax, ma junok nok' kalnel, yik smilcham nok', ma yik schonhb'at nok', tato syamchaj winh t'a yelk'al chi', owanhxo sk'exul nok' wakax chi' syak' winh. Tato kalnel nok' jun, chanhwanhxo pax sk'exul nok' syak' winh.

Ha junok mach tz'elk'ani, yowalil stup tas syelk'ej chi'. Tato malaj stumin jun elk'um chi', yowalil schonhchajeli, haxo t'a stojol b'aj schonhchaj chi', hata' stup tas syelk'ej chi'. Tato tz'ilchaj nok' nok' elk'ab'il chi', yowalil stupchaj nok', chawanhxo tz'aj stupchaj nok', taxonhej junok nok' wakax, ma junok nok' b'uru, ma junok nok' kalnel. Tato tz'ilchaj junok elk'um t'ak'walil, wan yoch t'a junok pat yik syelk'an junok tas, tato smak'jicham yuj winh aj pat chi', malaj tz'aji. Max ochlaj t'a spatik winh smilwaj chi'. Tato t'a k'uhalil tzuji jun, tz'och t'a spatik winh smilwaj chi'.

Tato ay junok mach stanhwan wa nok' smolb'etzal nok' t'a slu'um, palta haxo t'a skal yawb'en te' junokxo mach sk'och nok' wa'el chi', yowalil syak' sk'exul mach ay yik nok' chi'. Ha wal sat yawb'en te wach' syak' sk'exulok.

Tato ay junok mach wan snhusan spatan, tz'el k'ak' yuj, stz'ab'at strigo junok mach, wach'chom molb'ab'ilxo ixim, mato manto jochchajlaj ixim, a mach tz'aktanel k'ak' chi', yowalil stup smasanil tas tz'ab'at chi'.

Tato ay junok mach syak'b'at stumin, ma junokxo tas ay stojol sik'b'at junokxo, haxo tz'aji tz'elk'ajelta t'a yol spat winh sik'jinak chi', tato tz'ilchaj winh elk'um chi', cha makanhxo tz'aj yak'an sk'exul winh.

Tato max yamchaj winh elk'um chi' jun, tz'ik'chajb'at winh aj pat chi' t'a yichanh winh juez yik tz'ilji tato manhok winh ix yaman k'e'en tumin chi', ma juntzanh tastak tz'ak'ji sik'kanb'at winh chi'.

Tato ay junok anima smakk'e junok tas yikok: Nok' wakax, nok' kalnel, nok' b'uru, ma junok pichul, ma junokxo tas tonhej satb'ati, syalan junokxo to yiko', tz'ik'chajb'at heb' chawanh chi' t'a yichanh heb' juez. Ha jun mach tz'esan chi', yowalil chab' tz'aj yak'an sk'exul t'a mach ay yik chi'.

Tato ay junok mach tonhej syak'kan ab'enal junok nok' b'uru, ma junok nok' wakax, ma junok nok' kalnel, ma yalnhej tas molb'etzal nok' t'a junokxo mach, haxo tz'aji, a nok' nok' chi' scham nok', ma slajwi nok', ma tz'elk'ajb'at nok'. Tato malaj mach tz'ilani,

syak' sti' winh anima chi' t'a yichanh Jehová yet' t'a yichanh winh ay yik nok' nok' chi' to manhok winh ix yaman nok'. Haxo winh ay yik nok' chi' scha'an yab' tas ix yal winh chi', yuj chi' max stuplaj nok' winh.
Palta tato k'elanoch winh tz'elk'ajb'at nok', yowalil stup winh t'a winh yajal nok' chi'.
Tato schijib'at nok' yuj nok' choj, ma yuj nok' okes, yowalil syik'kot jab'okxo nok' winh, yik wach' syil winh yajal nok' chi'. Tato icha chi', max stuplaj nok' winh.
Tato ay junok mach sk'anan junok nok' nok' smajnej: Nok' chej, nok' wakax, talaj scham nok', ma slajwi nok', palta max yil-laj winh yajal nok' chi', yowalil stup nok' mach ix majnan chi'.
Palta tato k'elanoch winh yajal nok' chi' scham nok', max stuplaj nok' winh smajnan nok' chi', yujto strato heb' yaji, anhej smajananub'al nok' syak' winh.

K'inalok ay junok winak tz'ak'an musansatil junok ix kob'es mantalaj b'aj ay strato, sway winh yet' ix, yowalil syak' k'e'en tumin winh yik stojolok ix t'a smam ix, ichataxon b'eyb'al. Yowalil syik' ix winh.
Tato max yal sk'ol smam ix to syik' jun winh chi' ix, palta yowalil syak' k'e'en tumin winh t'a smam ix ix chi', ichataxon sb'eyb'al heb' anima a smojk'aj heb' ix kob'estak.
Masanil heb' ajb'a'al, yowalil scham heb'.
Tato ay mach smulan yet' nok' nok', yowalil schami.
Tato ay mach syak' silab' t'a komon Dios, to manhok t'ayin a in Jehová in tik syak'a', yowalil smak'jichamok.
Manh eyixtej heb' anima ch'ok chonhab'il tonhej ayek' t'a he kal, yujto ex ek'pax t'a ch'ok chonhab'il t'a Egipto.
Manh eyixtej heb' ix chamnakxo yetb'eyum, ma heb' unin manhxalaj smam.
Tato tzeyixtej heb', a t'ayin ol yal sb'a heb', ol wab' tas syal heb' chi' t'ayin.
Ol kot wowal t'ayex, ol ex wik'anb'at t'a junok owal. Icha chi' ol aj ex wak'anchamok. Yuj wal chi', a heb' ix eyetb'eyum skan heb' ix t'a manh etb'eyumal, skanpax heb' eyuninal t'a mheb'ail.
Tato tzeyak' k'e'en tumin majanil t'a junok eyetchonhab' meb'a' anima, manh he k'an yune' k'e'en t'ay icha syutej sb'a heb' tz'ak'antaxon k'e'en majanil.
Tato syak'kan junok spichul, yujto smajnej k'e'en tumin chi', tzeyak' meltzaj t'ay a tz'emxikan k'u,
talaj anhej jun spichul chi' syak'och yuj si'ik, anhej syak'och t'ak'walil. Yuj chi', tato syal sb'a t'ayin, t'a elanhchamel tzin kolwaj t'ay, yujto a in tik elanhchamel tz'ok' in k'ol t'a anima.
Manh eyal chukal lolonel t'a spatik heb' juez, ma t'a spatik winh yajal he chonhab'.
Mokab' najtilax eyik'ankot eyofrenda t'ayin, haton sb'ab'el sat eyawb'en. Ha heb' he b'ab'el winak unin tzeyak' heb' t'ayin.
Icha chi' tz'ajpax nok' b'ab'el yune' nok' he wakax yet' nok' he kalnel. Skan ukeok k'uhal nok' yet' snun, haxo t'a swajxakil k'uhal yalji nok', tzeyak'an nok' t'ayin.
Wik heyaj a ex tik. Yuj chi' manh he chi' schib'ejal nok' nok' milb'ilcham yuj nok' k'ultakil nok', palta ha t'a nok' tz'i' tzeyak' nok'.
Manh eyal esal lolonel t'a spatik heb' eyetanima'il. Manh junnhejok tzeyutej he b'a yet' junok mach chuk spensar yik tzeyak'anoch he b'a testigo'al t'a tas manh yelok.
Manh eyak'och he b'a yet' heb' sk'ulan chukal. Manh eyak'och he b'a testigo'al t'a es yet' heb' anima sk'ulan chukal.
Wach'chom meb'a' junok anima, palta tato ay smul, manh eyak' och he b'a yet'ok.
Tato a junok winh ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex ay junok nok' swakax, ma nok' sb'uru satnakb'ati, tz'ilchaj nok' eyu'uj, ik'ekb'at nok' t'a winh.
Yowalil tzex kolwaj t'a mach schichonoch sk'ol t'ayex. Tato tzeyila' to stelwi nok' sb'uru t'a yalanh yikatz, tzeyik'k'e wa'an nok' yet'ok.
Tato ay junok anima meb'a' snib'ej sch'olb'itaj yaj yowal, manh he tenek' t'ay.
Manh he cha junok esal lolonel t'a spatik junok anima. Manh eyak'och chamel t'a yib'anh junok anima malaj smul, yujto a in ol wak' spak t'a mach icha chi' sk'ulej.
Manh he cha k'e'en tumin t'a elk'altak yik tze b'oan yaj junok owal, yujto a yuj k'e'en tumin chi' tzeyak' musansatil he b'a, tze k'exankan tas tojol t'a tas manh tojolok.
Manh eyixtej anima ch'ok chonhab'il, yujto a ex tik najtil ix ex ek' t'a ch'ok chonhab'il t'a Egipto. Eyojtakxo syahelal tz'utaj anima t'a ch'ok chonhab'il.
Wake' ab'il tzex munlaj t'a sat lum lum, tze molank'e sat tas tzeyawej.

Haxo t'a yukil ab'il, tzeyaktankan lu'um. Ha jantakto tastak sk'ib'k'e t'a sat lu'um, yikxo heb' meb'a' ayek' t'a yol he chonhab' chi' yet' nok' k'ultakil nok'. Wach'chom te' eyuwa ma te' eyolivo, manhxo he mesa'.

Wake' k'uhalnhej tzex munlaji, haxo t'a yukil k'uhal tzeyik'an eyip. Yet' pax nok' he wakax, nok' he b'uru yet' heb' he chekab' tz'alji t'a yol he cuenta yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il smunlaj heyet'ok syik'pax yip.
k'anab'ajejek masanil tas ix wal tik t'ayex. Manh eyal he b'a t'a juntzanh komon Dios, manh he lokpax sb'i.
Oxel tzeyak'och k'inh t'a yol junjun ab'il yik tzin eyik'ancha'anh.

Ha t'a uj Abib tzeyak'och sk'inhal ixim pan malaj yich, icha ix wutej walan t'ayex. T'a uke' k'uhal tze wa ixim pan malaj yich, yujto ha t'a jun uj chi' ix ex elta t'a Egipto. Malajokab' junok mach sja t'a wichanh tato malaj jab'ok yofrenda yet'nak.
Tzeyak'anpaxoch k'inh ayik tz'elul sb'ab'el sat tas tzeyawej. Hanheja' tzeyak'anpaxoch junxo k'inh ayik slajwikank'e masanil sat tastak tzeyawej chi'.
Ha in Jehová he Yajalil in tik swala' to ha t'a oxe' k'inh chi' yowalil sjawi masanil heb' winh winak t'a wichanh.
Ayik tzeyak'an nok' nok' silab'il t'ayin, manh eyak'laj schik'il nok' yet' ixim pan ayb'at yich. Manh he sik'b'at xepu'al nok' silab' chi' t'a junokxo k'uhal.
Ha wal sb'ab'el sat eyawb'en wach' tz'el t'a sat lum lum, ha' tzeyik'b'at t'a in kajnub', a in Jehová he Diosal in swala'. Manh he tz'anh nok' yunetak chiwa t'a skal yal yim snun.
Ol in chekb'at jun wángel t'a eyichanh yik wach' tzex tanhwaj yuj t'a yoltak b'e, ol ex yik'anb'at t'a jun lugar b'aj wach'xo yaj wu'uj, b'aj ol ex ajok.
Scham wal heyilani, manh he pitej he b'a t'ay, palta tze k'anab'ajej tas syala'. Ichato ha' ol munlaj in k'exulok, manh ol ex yak'laj niwank'olal tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej t'ay.
Tato tze k'anab'ajej t'ay, tze k'ulan tas syal t'a in k'exulok, ol in och ajk'olal t'a mach ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex. Ol in och tek'tek' t'a yichanh mach snib'ej stek'b'ej sb'a t'a eyichanh.
Ha jun wángel chi' ol b'ab'laj t'a eyichanh. Ol ex yik'anb'at t'a sat lum slu'um heb' amorreo, heb' hitita, heb' ferezeo, heb' cananeo, heb' heveo yet' heb' jebuseo. Junelnhej ol in satkanel heb'.

Manh ex em nhojan t'a yichanh sdiosal juntzanh chonhab' chi'. Manh ex empax kuman t'ay, manh he b'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al heb' chonhab' chi' t'a eyik'ancha'anh sdiosal heb'. Ha tas smoj tze k'ulej, to tze mak'poj sdiosal heb' chi' yet' masanil k'e'en k'e'en ayoch t'ay.
Ha innhej Jehová he Diosal in b'aj tzeyak'em he b'a. Tato icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a, ol wak' tas tze wa''a yet' tas tzeyuk'ej. Najat pax ol wik'el ilya t'a he kal.
Najat pax ol wutok he k 'inal. Ha t'a yol junjun he chonhab'il chi', malaj junok ix ix tonhej ol el yune', manh junok heb' ix to manh ol unewok.
Ol wak' xiwk'e sk'ol heb' anima tzex chakani. Ol wak' somchaj spensar heb' chonhab' tzeyak' owal yet'ok yet' masanil heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex, ol el lemnaj heb' t'ayex.
Ol wak' somchaj sk'ol heb' eyajk'o'ol yuj xiwelal ayik manto ex k'ochlaj, yuj chi' ol el lemnaj heb' heveo, heb' cananeo yet' pax heb' hitita t'ayex.
Manh junoknhej ab'il ol aj wik'anel heb' t'a eyichanh, yik wach' max ixtaxb'at lum lum yik manh ol te k'ib'pax sb'isul nok' k'ultakil nok' tz'ak'an chukal t'ayex.
k'ojank'olalnhej ol aj wik'anel heb' anima chi' t'a sat lu'um, masanto ayik ol k'ib' he b'isul, yik tze makan lum masanil.

Toxo ix wak'kanem stz'akanhil b'aj ol ek' lum he lu'um chi'. Schael yich b'aj ay ha' Chakchak Mar, masanto sk'och t'a ha' Éufrates, sb'atxonhej t'a ha' mar Mediterráneo, masanto t'a takinh lu'um. Ol wak'anoch heb' kajan t'a sat lu'um chi' t'a yol he k'ab'. Ha exxo ol he pechel heb' t'a sat lu'um chi'.
Manh wal he b'o junok he trato yet' heb', manh ex ochpax ejmelal t'a sdiosal heb'.

Manhxo pax he chakan heb' t'a yol he chonhab', yik wach' max ex skuchb'ej heb' he k'ulan chukal t'ayin. Tato tzeyak'em he b'a t'a sdiosal heb' chi', a ex wal tzeyixtejb'at he b'a syal chi', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Tzach k'eta t'a lum witz b'aj ayinek' tik yet' winhaj Aarón, winhaj Nadab yet' winhaj Abiú yet' pax 70-ok heb' yichamtak winakil he chonhab'. Ha heb' chi' najatto skan heb' yak'em sb'a t'ayin.
Ha achxonhej syal a k'eul t'a in tz'ey, haxo pax heb' winh chi', max yal-laj sk'eta heb' winh yet' pax heb' chonhab' max yal-laj sk'eta heb' het'ok, xchi t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix emixta winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' anima tas leyal ix yak' Jehová yet' tas ix yutej yalani. Haxo masanil heb' anima chi', junnhej ix aj stak'wi heb'. --Masanil tas ix yal Jehová chi', ol ko k'anab'ajej, xchi heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix stz'ib'an winhaj Moisés masanil tas ix yal Jehová. Haxo ix sakb'inaj t'a junxo k'u, ix k'e wa'an winh, ix sb'o'an jun altar winh t'a yich witz chi', ix yak'ank'e linhan lajchawe' k'e'en k'e'en winh. Ha junjun k'e'en k'e'en chi', junjun makan yinhtilal Israel sch'ox k'e'en.

T'a elanhchamel ix schekan juntzanh heb' winh kelemtak winak winhaj Moisés chi' yik smilan nok' toro heb' silab'ok yik stz'a t'a smasanil yet' juntzanhxo silab' yik sch'oxan sjunk'olal heb' yet' Jehová.
Haxo winhaj Moisés chi' ix cha'an nanhal schik'il nok', ix yak'anem winh t'a yol juntzanh yet'tal, haxo nanhalxo, ix stzikanoch winh t'a altar chi'.

Ix yik'ank'e winh b'aj tz'ib'ab'il strato Dios, ix yawtan winh t'a skal heb' chonhab'. Ixlajwi yawtan winh, ix yalan heb' chonhab' chi' icha tik: --Masanil tas syal Jehová, ol ko k'anab'ajej, xchi heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot schik'il nok' winh, haton ix yak'kanem winh t'a yol juntzanh yet'tal chi', ix stzikanb'at winh t'a yib'anh heb' anima chi'. Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha jun chik' tik sch'oxani to tz'ochkan yopisio jun strato Jehová ix sb'o ket'ok tik, haton masanil tas ix yal t'ayonh, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'ex winh t'a lum witzal Sinaí chi'. Ajun winhaj Aarón, winhaj Nadab, winhaj Abiú yet' pax 70 heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' ix k'e yet' winh.
Hata' ix yil sDiosal heb' winh. Ha t'a yalanh yok, toxonhej skopopi icha k'e'en zafiro te wach' yilji, icha syaxil satcha'anh.
Malaj tas ix utaj heb' winh yuj yipalil Dios. Ix yil Dios heb' winh, ix wa heb' winh, ix yuk'an ha' heb' winh t'a yichanh.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --K'eanhkot t'a jolom witz b'aj ayinek' tik, tza tanhwan ta', hata' ol wak' chab' k'e'en k'e'en t'ayach, haton k'e'en b'aj tz'ib'ab'iloch juntzanh cheknab'il wu'uj, yik tz'och he k'ayb'ub'alok, xchi t'a winh.
Ix k'e winhaj Moisés t'a lum witz chi' yet' winhaj Josué winh skolwaj yet' winh.

Ayik manto b'atlaj winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' chi': --Kananhek t'a tik masanto ol onh emxulok. Ayek' winhaj Aarón yet' winhaj Hur heyet'ok. Tato ay tas he gana sb'o'i, a heb' winh tik ol b'oan t'ayex, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e heb' winh schawanhil. T'a elanhchamel ix och moynaj jun asun t'a lum witz chi'.
Haxo stzikikial Jehová ix jawi t'a yib'anh lum witzal Sinaí chi', wake' wal k'uhal ix och hoyan asun t'a lu'um. Haxo t'a yukil k'uhal ix awtajk'e winhaj Moisés yuj Jehová t'a skal asun chi'.
Ix sch'ox sb'a stzikikial Jehová t'a skal jun asun t'a lum witz chi', t'a yichanh heb' chonhab'. Ha stzikikial chi', lajan yilji icha junok k'ak' te ow stz'ab'at smasanil yuj.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Moisés t'a skal jun asun chi'. Ix k'e winh t'a slajwub'alxo sjolom lum witz chi'. 40 k'uhal yet' 40 ak'wal ix kan winh ta'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al t'a heb' etisraelal to syak' junok ofrenda heb' t'ayin. Ha jun ofrenda chi', tz'ik'jicha'anh t'a skal heb' to tz'el wal t'a sk'ol yak'ani.
Ha tastak ol ik'chajk'e wa'an chi', haton juntzanh tik: K'en oro, k'e'en plata, k'e'en bronce,
anh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, anh ch'al yaxmakinak, anh chak ch'al, anh ch'al lino yelxo wal wach', xil nok' chiwa ch'alb'il,
stz'umal nok' ch'ak kalnel uk'nak yet' chakchak, nok' tz'u'um te' lab'ab'i, pax te' acacia,
aceite sk'anji t'a candil, perfume, yaceite'al sat te' olivo sk'anji ayik sik'chajkanoch junok mach, ma junok tas wikok, incienso suk'uk'i sjab',
k'e'en kornalina yet' juntzanhxo k'e'en k'e'en te wach' yilji tz'och t'a k'apak schaleka winh sat sacerdote yet' t'a k'apak ayoch t'a snhi' sk'ol spichul winh.
Tze b'oan junok in kajnub', yik wach' tzin kajnaj t'a he kal.
Palta a b'aj ol in ek' kajan chi' yet' masanil tastak ol k'anchaj t'a yo'ol, yowalil ol he b'o icha wal yaj yechel ol in ch'ox t'ayach.
B'o'okab' junok kaxa, a te' acacia tz'och t'ay. Jun metro yet' 10 centímetro tz'aj sk'atul, 70 centímetro tz'aj sat, 70 centímetro pax tz'aj scha'anhil.
Tz'och k'e'en oro te wach' t'a yo'ol yet' t'a spatik, tz'och k'e'en t'a stitak t'a yib'anh b'aj tzalank'ei.
Sb'opax chanheok k'e'en argolla nab'a oro, tz'och t'a yok schanhil, chab' t'a junjun pak'anh.
Sb'ochajpaxoch sb'akhlab'il. Ha te' acacia tz'ochi, tz'ochpax k'e'en oro t'a spatik te'.
Tz'ekchajek' te' t'a yol juntzanh k'e'en argolla tz'och t'a spak'ultak te' kaxa chi', haton yet' juntzanh te' chi' syal sb'akhjik'e te' kaxa chi'.
Skan te' t'a yol k'e'en argolla ayoch t'a te' kaxa chi', maxtzak ik'chajel-laj te'.
Ha t'a yol te' kaxa chi' tzak'kanem k'e'en k'e'en b'aj ayoch in trato ol wak' t'ayach.

Sb'ochajpax smakul te' kaxa chi'. Haton t'a smakul te' chi' stzikjiek' chik' yik tz'ak'ji tup mul. Ha k'e'en oro te wach' tz'och t'ay, jun metro yet' 10 centímetro tz'aj sk'atul, 70 centímetro tz'aj sat.
Haxo t'a chab' stitak jun smakul chi', tz'och junjun yechel querubín, nab'a oro tz'aji, stenjib'o t'a k'e'en martillo.
Ha jun smakul chi' yet' juntzanh yechel querubín chi', junnhej tz'aji. Junjun juntzanh querubín chi' skan t'a junjun sti' jun smakul chi'.
T'anht'umb'a tz'aj juntzanh querubín chi', tz'em k'elan t'a yib'anh jun smakul te' kaxa chi'. Haxo sk'axil, syil-laj sb'a snhi' t'a yib'anh smakul chi'.
Ha k'e'en k'e'en b'aj ayoch in trato ol wak' chi' t'ayach, ha t'a yol te' kaxa chi' ol ak'kanem k'e'en, ichato chi' tzak'anoch smakul te' chi'.
Ha t'a skal juntzanh yechel querubín ay t'a yib'anh smakul te' kaxa chi', hata' ol in ch'ox in b'a t'ayach, ol wak' ojtakejel smasanil cheknab'il ol wak' a k'anab'ajej yet' heb' etisraelal.
Sb'ochajpax junok te' mexa, a te' acacia b'aj sb'o te'. 90 centímetro tz'aj sk'atul, 45 tz'aj sat, 65 tz'aj ste'el.
Tz'och k'e'en oro t'a te', sb'opax junok nab'a oro tzek' hoyan t'a spatik te' yok schanhil.
Sb'opaxk'e stitak te', tzek' hoyan t'a yib'anh, uke' centímetro sk'e'i, tz'och k'e'en oro t'ay.
Sb'opax chanheok argolla nab'a oro tz'och t'a schikintak schanhil.
Ha t'a slak'anil b'aj ayem stitak chi', hata' tz'och juntzanh k'e'en argolla chi'. Ha t'a yol k'e'en argolla chi' tzek' sb'akhlab'il te', yik syal yik'chajb'at te' mexa chi'.
Ha te' sb'akhlab'il te' mexa chi', ha t'a te' acacia b'aj sb'o te', tz'ochpax k'e'en oro t'a te'.
Sb'opax plato, niwak cuchara, xalu yet' uk'ab' b'aj schaji ofrenda ha' yaji. Nab'a oro tz'och t'a juntzanh tik smasanil.
Sb'ojiem jun mexa chi' t'a wichanh, tz'em ixim pan wik yaj t'a yib'anh.

Sb'ochajpax junok sb'akhnub'al candil, nab'a oro tz'aji. Ha t'a k'e'en martillo stenchaj b'o'ok. Ha sk'ojnub' b'aj tz'em b'akhan yet' ste'al yet' pax skopail, icha sfloral tz'ajochi, junnhej yaman tz'aji.
Ha t'a stz'eytak, oxox sk'ab' tz'elta.
Ha t'a junjun sk'ab' tz'elta t'a jun ste'al chi', yowalil ay oxe' sfloral icha sfloral te' almendro.
Hanheja' t'a jun ste'al chi', ay chanhe' sfloral icha sfloral te' almendro chi'.
Ha t'a yalanh b'aj ayelta junjun sk'ab' chi', skan junjun sfloral.
Ha juntzanh sfloral yet' sk'ab' chi', junnhej tz'aj yet' jun sb'akhnub'al chi', nab'a oro tz'aji, stenjib'o t'a k'e'en martillo.
Sb'ochajpax uke' candil, tz'ak'chajem t'a yet'tal yik syak' sakil k'inal t'a yichanh.
Ha k'e'en syamlab'il b'aj tz'ik'chajel stanhil k'apak b'aj tz'och sk'ak'al yet' k'e'en splato'al, nab'a oro tz'aji.
Tz'och oxeok arroba oro t'a jun b'akhnub' candil chi' yet' syamk'ab'il.
Scham wal hilani to icha yaj yechel tzin ch'ox t'ayach t'a jolom witz tik, icha chi' tz'aj sb'o'i.

Tza b'oanpax in kajnub' t'a lajunheok jenhan k'apak k'apak nab'a lino b'ayb'il te wach'. Sb'ojioch yechel querubín t'a k'apak yuj junok mach jelan sb'o'ani. Ha t'a anh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, anh ch'al yaxmakinak yet' t'a anh chak ch'al sb'ojioch yechel querubín chi'.
Masanil juntzanh k'apak chi', lajan tz'aji: 12 metro yet' nanhalxo tz'aj ste'el, chab' metro tz'aj sat.
Slajwi chi' stz'ischaj syam sb'a oyeok jenhan k'apak, junxonhej tz'aji. Hanheja' icha chi' tz'ajpax oyexo k'apak chi'. Chab' jenhan tz'ajkan k'apak.
Tz'ochpax xoyjab' ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak syamnub'ok t'a jun pak'anhok sti' jun jenhan k'apak b'ab'el. Hanheja' icha chi' tz'ajpax junxo jenhan k'apak schab'il chi'.
Ha t'a k'apak b'ab'el jenhan yet' pax t'a k'apak schab'il, yowalil sb'ochajoch xoyjab' 50-ok juntzanh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak chi', yik wach' junxonhej tz'aj schalan sb'a k'apak schab'il.
Sb'opax 50-ok syamnub'al nab'a oro, yik syal syamlan sb'a k'apak schab'il jenhan, icha chi' tz'aj sb'oel junok jenhan tz'och t'a yib'anh in kajnub'.
Sb'ochajpax uxluche'ok jenhan xil nok' chiwa jalb'il yik sb'at t'a yib'anh k'apak ayoch t'a yib'anh in kajnub' chi'.
Masanil juntzanh chi', lajannhej tz'aji, 13 metro yet' nanhalxo tz'aj ste'el, haxo sat chab' metro tz'aji.
Slajwi chi', stz'ischaj syam sb'a oyeok jenhan, junnhej jenhan tz'ajkani. Stz'ischajpax syam sb'a wakexo jenhan chi'. Ha jun swakil jenhan, nanhal spakchajemta t'a yichanh mantiado chi'.
Sb'ochajoch xoyjab' 50-ok syamnub'al t'a jun pak'anhok stitak jun b'ab'el jenhan, tz'ochpax 50-ok syamnub'al t'a jun pak'anhok sti' t'a jun schab'il jenhan.
Sb'opax 50-ok syamnub'al nab'a bronce, yik syal syamlan sb'a schab'il jenhan, yik junxonhej jenhan tz'ajkani.
Yujto huxluche' jenhan yaj xil nok' chiwa chi', yuj chi' ayto nanhalxo jenhan tz'emkan pakan t'a spatik yet' t'a yichanh.
Ha jun chi', ek'to jun metro ste'el t'a yichanh k'apak yalanh, nanhal metro ek'to t'a junjun stitak, yik smuschaj stitak k'apak aykan t'a yalanh chi'.
Sb'ojipax stz'umal nok' kalnel uk'nak t'a chakchak, yik sk'e t'a yib'anh jun jenhan xil nok' chiwa chi' yet' junokxo makan tz'u'um te' lab'ab'i yik tz'och t'a yib'anh jun chi'.
Sb'ochajpax juntzanh te' marco yik tz'och t'a spatik in kajnub', linhan tz'ajoch junjun te'. Masanil te', a te' acacia b'aj tz'elta te'.
Nanhal yo'il metro tz'aj ste'el junjun te', 65 centímetro tz'aj sat te'.
Skan chab'chab'ok yok te' b'aj tz'em linhan. Lajannhej tz'ajkan skal. Icha chi' tz'aj te' tz'och t'a spatik in kajnub' chi' smasanil.
Ayik sb'oel te' chi', 20 te' tz'och t'a stojolal sur,
sb'ojiem 40 sb'akhnub' yich te' nab'a plata tz'aji, chab'chab' tz'ajkan t'a yalanh junjun te', junjun t'a junjun yok te'.
Icha chi' tz'ajpax junxo pak'anh t'a stojolal norte, 20 pax te' sb'ojiochi.
Hanheja' 40 sb'akhnub' yich te' sb'oji, nab'a plata tz'aji, chab'chab' tz'emkan t'a yich junjun te'.
Haxo t'a junxo pak'anh yol schikin t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, wake' te' sb'ojiochi.
Sb'opax chab'okxo te', junjun te' tz'och t'a junjun yesquina'il jun pak'anh chi'.
Ha chab' te' marco chi', nub'ub'i tz'aj te', t'a yich masanto sk'ek'och b'aj syil-laj sb'a yuj junok argolla, haton te' chi' tz'och t'a chab' yesquina'il t'a jun pak'anh chi'.
Ha yuj chab'xo te' chi', wajxake' tz'aj te' marco chi' t'a smasanil yet' 16 sb'akhnub' yich te'. Chab'chab' sb'akhnub' yich junjun te'.
Sb'ochajpax oyeok te' regla tz'och t'a spatik te' marco t'a junok pak'anh in kajnub'. Ha te' acacia sb'ochaj regla'il chi'.
Sb'ochajpax oyeok te' tz'och t'a junxo pak'anh. Hanhejtona' sb'ochaj oyeok te' tz'och t'a jun pak'anh t'a spatik, t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u.
Ha te' regla tzek' t'a snanhal te' marco chi', sb'at te' t'a jun schikin masanto sk'axpajek'k'och te' t'a junxo schikin.
Slajwi chi', tz'och k'e'en oro t'a spatiktak te' marco chi', tz'ochpax k'e'en argolla nab'a oro b'aj tzek' te' regla chi'. Tz'ochpax k'e'en oro t'a te' regla chi'.
Sb'ochajk'e in kajnub' icha yaj yechel tzin ch'ox t'ayach t'a jolom witz tik.

Sb'ochajpax junok k'apak cortina nab'a lino b'ayb'il. Sb'ojioch yechel querubín t'a k'apak yuj junok mach jelan sb'o'ani. Ha t'a anh k'ik'mutz'inak ch'al, anh ch'al yaxmakinak yet' pax anh chak ch'al sb'ojioch yechel querubín chi'.

Slajwi chi', sk'e lokan k'apak t'a chanhe' te' oy ayk'e k'e'en gancho nab'a oro t'a schon. Ha te' oy chi' a te' acacia, yowalil tz'ochpax k'e'en oro t'a spatik te', tz'empax te' t'a yib'anh chanhe' sb'akhnub' yich nab'a plata.

Ha jun k'apak cortina chi' smakan snanhal jun lugar skuch Wik Yaji yet' junxo lugar skuch Ha Innhej Ay Wiko'. Sk'e lokan k'apak t'a yalanh b'aj ayoch k'e'en syamnub'al nab'a oro ayoch t'a yib'anh, haxo t'a spatikoch k'apak cortina chi' tz'ak'chajoch te' skaxa'il trato.
Slajwi chi', tza makan te' skaxa'il trato yet' smakul, tz'ochkan te' t'a jun lugar skuch Ha Innhej Ay Wiko'.
Ha t'a yichanhelta k'apak cortina chi', ha t'a ko wach' skan te' mexa yik ixim pan. Haxo pax t'a ko k'exanh skan jun b'akhnub' candil, k'elk'umb'a tz'aj yet' te' mexa chi'.

Haxo t'a sti' in kajnub' chi', hata' sb'ojioch junok k'apak cortina nab'a lino b'ayb'il. Yet' anh k'ik'mutz'inak ch'al, anh ch'al yaxmakinak, anh chak ch'al sb'ochaj yelwanub' yuj junok jelan sb'o'ani.

Sb'opax oye' te' oy t'a te' acacia, tz'och k'e'en oro t'a spatik te'. Hanhejtona' tz'ochpax k'e'en gancho nab'a oro t'a schon te' yik wach' sk'e lokan k'apak cortina chi'. Sb'ojipaxem oye' b'akhnub' yich nab'a bronce b'aj tz'em te' oy chi'.
Sb'ochajpax junok altar t'a te' chemte' nab'a acacia, lajannhej tz'aj yechel schanhil pak'anh. Chab' metro yet' 25 centímetro tz'aj junjun pak'anh, jun metro yet' 25 centímetro tz'aj scha'anhil.
Sb'ochajk'e junjun sch'a'ak t'a junjun schikintak. Ha juntzanh sch'a'ak chi' yaman tz'aj yet' jun altar chi', spichchaj te' t'a k'e'en bronce.

Masanil jantak syamk'ab'il altar chi', nab'a bronce'okabi: Haton yet'tal b'aj tz'ik'chajel k'e'en tik'ak'il ta'anh, k'e'en pala, k'e'en niwak uk'ab', k'e'en tenedor yet' pax yet'tal b'aj tz'em te tzak'ak'.
Sb'opax junok k'e'en malla nab'a bronce, tz'ochpax junjun argolla bronce t'a junjun yesquina'il k'e'en.
Tz'elk'och k'e'en yesquina'il chi' t'a spatiktak jun altar chi' t'a yalanh jun oyanoch t'a stitak. Ha k'e'en malla chi', t'a snanhal jun altar chi' sb'ojiem k'e'en.
Sb'opax juntzanhok sb'akhlab'il jun altar chi'. Ha te' acacia tz'ochi, tz'ochpax bronce t'a spatik te'.
Ha te' sb'akhlab'il chi', yowalil tzek' te' t'a yol k'e'en argolla ayoch t'a schab'il pak'anh yik wach' sb'akhjib'ati.
Ha jun altar chi', olan tz'ajkan yo'ol, icha yechel ix in ch'ox t'ayach t'a jolom witz tik.

Sb'ochajpax k'apak cortina lino te wach' b'ayb'il, yik tz'och hoyan smakulok yamak'il ay t'a spatiktak in kajnub' chi'. Ha t'a jun pak'anh t'a stojolal sur, 45 metro tz'ajb'at t'inhan k'apak cortina chi'.
Tz'och 20 te' oy, 20 pax sb'akhnub'al yich nab'a bronce, haxo t'a schon junjun te' oy chi', tz'em jun k'e'en nab'a plata ayoch juntzanh argolla t'ay.

Icha pax chi' t'a stojolal norte, yowalil tz'ochpax k'apak cortina t'a sk'atul chi' smasanil. 45 metro tz'aji, 20 pax te' yoyal tz'ochi yet' 20 sb'akhnub'al yich nab'a bronce, tz'em jun k'e'en nab'a plata, ayoch juntzanh argolla t'ay t'a schon junjun te' oy chi'.
Haxo t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, a k'apak cortina tz'och t'ay, 22 metro yet' nanhalxo tz'aj sat yet' lajunhe' yoyal yet' pax lajunhe' sb'akhnub'al yich.
Haxo pax t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a jun amak' chi', 22 metro yet' nanhalxo sat. Tz'ochpax k'apak cortina t'ay.
Ha t'a jun pak'anh sti' amak' chi', ay uke' metro k'apak cortina tz'ochi yet' oxe' yoyal yet' pax oxe' sb'akhnub'al yich.
Hanheja' t'a junxo pak'anh sti', ay pax uke' metro k'apak cortina tz'ochi, ay oxe' oy yet' oxe' sb'akhnub'al yich.

Haxo t'a sti' amak' chi', hata' sb'ojioch junok k'apak cortina nab'a lino b'ayb'il, nanhal sb'alunhil metro sat k'apak. Sb'oji yelwanub' k'apak yuj junok jelan sb'o'ani. Ha t'a anh k'ik'mutz'inak ch'al, anh ch'al yaxmakinak, anh chak ch'al sb'ochaj yelwanub' chi'.
Masanil te' oy t'a spatik yichanh amak' chi', tz'em k'e'en k'e'en nab'a plata ayoch argolla t'ay t'a schon te'. Haxo pax sb'akhnub'al yich te', nab'a bronce.

Ha jun amak' chi', 45 metro sk'atul, 22 metro yet' nanhalxo sat, lajannhej schapak'anhil. Haxo pax k'apak cortina ayk'e t'a cha'anh, chab' metro yet' 25 centímetro ste'el k'apak. Ha k'apak cortina chi', haton lino wach' b'ayb'il. Haxo sb'akhnub' yich te oy chi', nab'a bronce.
Masanil yestaca'il in kajnub' chi' yet' estaca ayoch t'a amak' chi', nab'a bronce tz'aji.
Al t'a heb' etisraelal to syik'kot aceite heb', haton aceite wach' tz'el t'a sat te' olivo, yik wach' aynhej yaceite'al juntzanh candil.

Ha winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal ayoch t'a yib'anh sb'oanoch sk'ak'al candil chi', yik wach' kopanel sk'ak'al t'a wichanh tzek' ak'wal t'a yol mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a t'a yichanhelta k'apak cortina ayoch yenhulok te' skaxa'il in trato. Ha jun tik, junelnhej ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal a ex israel ex tik yet' pax t'a heb' eyinhtilal.

Ix yalanpax Jehová icha tik: Awtej winh uk'tak aj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal, haton winhaj Nadab, winhaj Abiú, winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar. Tza sik'el heb' winh t'a skal heb' etisraelal, yik wach' tz'och heb' winh sacerdote'al t'ayin.
Sb'ochaj spichul winh uk'tak aj Aarón. Haton junok pichul yiknhej yopisio winh yaji, yik wach' tz'aj yilji winh, yik scheklajpaxeli to niwan yelk'och winh.
Al t'a heb' te ay sjelanil, haton juntzanh heb' ix wak' sjelanil t'a b'o'oj k'apak, yik sb'o'an spichul winhaj Aarón chi' heb', yik ol och winh sacerdote'al t'ayin.

Ha juntzanh pichul sb'o chi', haton juntzanh tik: Ha k'apak smakul snhi' sk'o'ol yet' k'apak chaleka. Sb'opax jun pichul jukan yet' junxo pichul yelxo wal te jukan ol och t'a yo'ol, tz'och yelwanub'. Sb'opax sk'oxal sjolom sb'ak'chajochi yet' stzek'ul snanhal. Yuj chi', b'ochajokab' pichul to yiknhej yopisio winhaj Aarón chi'. Sb'ochajpax spichul heb' yuninal winh chi', yik wach' tz'och heb' t'a yopisio t'a sacerdote'al t'ayin.
Ayik sb'ochaj juntzanh pichul chi', tz'och anh lino b'ayb'il, yowalil tz'och k'e'en oro icha ch'al t'a skal yet' lana chak ch'al.
Ha jun chaleka chi', a anh lino b'ayb'il sb'ochaj yuj junok jelan sch'alwi, tz'och oro icha ch'al t'a skal yet' lana ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, yaxmakinak yet' chakchak.
Tz'ek' b'ak'an sk'ab' t'a sjolom sjenhjab' yik syil-laj sb'a k'apak yichanh yet' k'apak spatik.

Sb'opax jun stzek'ul yik stzek'jioch jun chaleka chi', junnhej tz'aj yet'ok. Ha jun stzek'ul chi', a anh lino b'ayb'il b'aj sb'oji. Tz'och k'e'en oro icha ch'al t'a skal yet' lana ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, yaxmakinak yet' chakchak.
Tzak' b'o chab'ok kotak pachanh k'e'en kornalina te wach'. Ha t'a k'e'en tz'och sb'i heb' yuninal winhaj Israel.
Stzolal tz'aj yochi icha ix aj yalji heb', wake' tz'och t'a junjun k'e'en.
Ha mach tz'ak'anoch juntzanh b'i chi' t'a k'e'en, haton junok toxonton smunlaj t'a b'o'oj k'e'en, te wach' tz'aj sb'o'i. Icha yajoch sletra'il junok sello, icha wal chi' tz'ajoch b'i chi' t'a k'e'en.

Ha t'a k'apak sjolom sjenhjab' jun chaleka chi' tz'ak'jioch k'e'en. Ha yopisio juntzanh k'e'en chi' yik snachajkot heb' yinhtilal Israel. Icha chi' tz'aj yik'anek' sb'i heb' israel chi' winhaj Aarón t'a sjolom sjenhjab' ayik tz'ochk'och winh t'a wichanh yik tzin na'ankot heb'.
Sb'ochajpax chab' syamlab'il k'e'en chi', nab'a oro tz'och t'ay.
Sb'ochajpax chab' cadena nab'a oro k'otzotzi tz'aj spach'uch'aji, tz'och t'a juntzanh syamlab'il chi'.

Haxo k'apak yik snhi' sk'o'ol, tz'och yopisio yik snachajel tas in gana, lajan wal tzutej icha wal tz'aj sb'o chaleka chi'. Ha anh lino b'ayb'il tz'och t'ay, haton anh b'ob'il yuj junok jelan sch'alwi. Tz'och k'e'en oro icha ch'al t'a skal yet' lana ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, yaxmakinak yet' chakchak.
Cha pakanh tz'aji, lajannhej sat stitak schanhil, 22 centímetro junjun stitak chi'.
Tz'och k'e'en k'e'en te' wach' yilji t'a k'apak snhi' sk'o'ol chi', chanh tzol tz'ajoch k'e'en. Ha t'a b'ab'el tzol, tz'och junok k'e'en rubí, junok k'e'en crisólito yet' junok k'e'en esmeralda.
Haxo t'a schab'il tzol, tz'och junok k'e'en granate, junok k'e'en zafiro yet' junok k'e'en jade.
Haxo pax t'a yoxil tzol, tz'och junok k'e'en jacinto, junok k'e'en ágata yet' junok k'e'en amatista.
Haxo pax t'a schanhil tzol, tz'och junok k'e'en topacio, junok k'e'en kornalina yet' pax junok k'e'en jaspe. Masanil juntzanh k'e'en chi', oronhej syamlab'il tz'ochi.

Yowalil lajchawe' juntzanh k'e'en chi' sb'o'i, yujto lajchawe' sb'i heb' yinhtilal Israel. Ha t'a junjun k'e'en k'e'en chi', hata' tz'och sb'i junjun makan heb', icha yajoch sletra'il junok sello, icha wal chi' tz'aj yoch b'i chi' t'a k'e'en.
Ha juntzanh k'e'en cadena oro pach'uch'ab'il toxo ix b'inaji, haton k'e'en tz'och yopisio t'a k'apak snhi' sk'o'ol.
Sb'ochajpax chab' argolla nab'a oro, tz'och t'a chab' schikin k'apak snhi' sk'ol chi' t'a yib'anh.
Tz'och k'e'en cadena oro chi' schab'il t'a chab' argolla chi'.
Tz'och chab' snhi' k'e'en cadena chi' t'a k'e'en syamlab'il k'e'en k'e'en ayoch t'a sjolom sjenhjab' k'apak chaleka, yik skan k'apak snhi' sk'ol chi' t'a yichanh.
Sb'opax chab' argolla nab'a oro, tz'och t'a chab' schikin k'apak smakul snhi' sk'ol chi' t'a yalanh, junnhej skan yet' jun chaleka chi'.

Sb'ochajpax chab' argolla oro, tz'och t'a snhitak k'apak tzek' t'a sjolom sjenhjab' k'apak chaleka t'a yichanh. Junnhej skan k'e'en yet' b'aj tz'emk'och stz'isul sti' k'apak chi', palta t'a yib'anhk'eta b'aj tzek' stzek'ul snanhal k'apak chaleka, haton jun tzek'ul te wach' yilji.

Icha chi' schalan sb'a k'e'en argolla yik k'apak snhi' sk'o'ol yet' k'e'en yik k'apak chaleka chi'. Ha junok anh ch'al pach'uch'ab'il k'ik'mutz'inak tz'och sch'anhalok yik syam sb'a, yik wach' a k'apak snhi' sk'ol chi' skan t'a yib'anhk'eta stzek'ul snanhal k'apak chaleka chi', yik max yaktej sb'a k'apak.

Yuj chi', ayik tz'och winhaj Aarón chi' t'a yol in kajnub' t'a wichanh yet'nak sb'i heb' yinhtilal Israel winh, yik tzin nakot heb' t'a masanil tiempo, yujto ayoch sb'i heb' t'a k'apak smakul snhi' sk'o'ol. Ha yopisio k'apak smakul snhi' sk'ol chi', yik tz'ojtakajeli tas snib'ej in k'o'ol.

Tzak'paxoch k'e'en Urim yet' k'e'en Tumim t'a yol k'apak smakul snhi' sk'ol chi', yuj chi' yet'nak k'e'en winhaj Aarón t'a snhi' sk'o'ol ayik tz'och winh t'a wichanh. Icha chi' tz'aj yik'anb'at juntzanh chi' winh t'a wichanh, yik syal snachajeli tas snib'ej in k'o'ol sk'ulej heb' etchonhab'.
Ha junok k'apak pichul jukan k'ik'mutz'inak, a tzak' b'ojok, yik ol yak'och winhaj Aarón chi' t'a yol k'apak chaleka.
Skan yolanil t'a snanhal b'aj sk'e sjolom winh. Ha t'a stitak b'aj tz'olji sjaj k'apak chi', hata' tz'och junok k'apak stz'ulilok sti', yik wach' max nhik'chaji.

Ha jun k'apak pichul jukan k'ik'mutz'inak chi', tz'och yelwanub' k'apak t'a masanil stitak t'a yoktak. Icha sat te' granado yilji yelwanub' k'apak stitak tz'och chi'. Sb'oji yelwanub' k'apak chi' t'a lana ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak yet' lana ch'al yaxmakinak yet' pax lana ch'al chakchak. Tz'ochpax yunetak campana nab'a oro t'a skal yechel sat te' granado t'a smasanil stitak chi'.

Ayik tz'och winhaj Aarón t'a wichanh t'a in kajnub', yowalil ayoch jun k'apak chi' yuj winh yik sk'anh juntzanh yunetak campana ayoch t'a stitak k'apak chi', ayik tz'och winh yet' pax yik tz'elta winh, yik wach' max cham winh.
Tzak'an b'ojok junok k'e'en oro jaylechinak yelwanub'ok, tz'och juntzanh lolonel tik t'a k'e'en, icha junok sello: Yiknhej Jehová Yaji, xchi.
Tz'och jun k'e'en oro jaylechinak chi' t'a snanhal sat sk'ox winhaj Aarón chi', stzek'chajoch k'e'en yet' junok ch'al b'ayb'il k'ik'mutz'inak.

Yet'nakokab'nhej k'e'en winhaj Aarón t'a snanhal sat yik tzin cha yofrenda heb' etchonhab' syak' t'ayin a in Jehová in tik, wach'chom manh ichaok t'a smojal syutej heb' yak'ani, palta yuj jun k'e'en chi', tzin cha yofrenda heb' chi'.

Tzak' b'ojok junokxo k'apak pichul yelxo wal te jukan. Ha lino wach' tz'och t'ay, lino pax junok k'ox b'ayb'il sb'o'i. Hanheja' k'apak tzek'ul, wach' tz'aj yochpax stz'ib'ul k'apak yuj junok jelan stz'isani.
Tzak'pax b'ojok spichul heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón chi', haton sjukan pichul heb', stzek'ul heb' yet' sk'ox heb'. Yik wach' yilji heb', yik niwan pax yelk'och heb'.
Icha chi' tzutej ak'anoch spichul winh uk'tak aj Aarón chi' yet' heb' yuninal. Slajwi chi' tzak'ank'e aceite t'a sjolom heb', yik tz'ochkan yopisio heb' t'a sacerdote'al t'ayin.
Tzak'anpax b'ojok yol swex heb', tz'emk'och t'a xub' heb', sk'epaxk'och t'a snanhal heb', yik wach' tz'aj smuschaj sniwanil heb'. Lino k'apak tz'och t'a yol swex heb' chi'

Syak'och k'apak yolwex chi' winhaj Aarón chi' yet' heb' yuninal ayik tz'och heb' t'a yol mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, ma ayik tz'och heb' t'a slak'anil altar t'a yol mantiado chi' ayik ayoch heb' t'a yopisio, yik wach' max och smul heb' yik max cham heb'. Ha jun tik, ley tz'ajkan t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a yinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo.

Ix yalanxi Jehová: Ayik scha'anel yich yopisio winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal t'a sacerdote'al t'ayin, haton juntzanh tik tza b'o yuj heb': Tzik'kot junok nok' kelem wakax yet' chawanhok nok' ch'ak kalnel malaj jab'ok spalta'il.
Yet' ixim harina yik trigo te wach', malaj yich sb'at t'a skal, haton t'a ixim tzak' b'ojok ixim pan yet' k'oxox pan kalab'il yet' aceite yet' pax k'oxox pan jay sb'onhchajoch aceite t'ay.
Slajwi chi' tz'em ixim t'a yol junok yune' mo'och, tzik'anb'at t'a in kajnub' yet' nok' kelem wakax yet' pax chawanh nok' ch'ak kalnel chi'.
Slajwi chi', tzik'anb'at winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal t'a yichanh mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a. Hata' sb'ikel sb'a heb'.

Slajwi chi', tzik'anpaxb'at k'apak pichul yik sacerdote'al. Tzak'anoch k'apak t'a winhaj Aarón chi', haton k'apak pichul yelxo wal te jukan yet' junxo k'apak jukan, k'apak chaleka yet' k'apak smakul snhi' sk'o'ol, tzak'anoch stzek'ul snanhal jun chaleka chi'.
Slajwi chi', tza b'ak'anoch sk'ox winh t'a sjolom. Ha t'a snanhal sat sk'ox winh chi' tzak'och jun oro jay lechinak, haton sch'oxan yechel to wik yaj winh.
Slajwi chi' tzik'ankot aceite sk'anchaji ayik sik'chajel junok mach tz'ochkan wikok. Tzak'ank'e t'a sjolom winhaj Aarón chi' yik tz'ochkan winh sacerdote'al.
Slajwi chi', sjapax heb' yuninal winh chi' t'a a tz'ey, tzak'anoch spichul heb' jukan.
Tza b'oanoch stzek'ul winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal, tza b'oank'e sk'ox heb'. Ichaton chi' tz'aj yochkan yopisio heb' t'a masanil tiempo.
Slajwi chi', tzik'anb'at nok' kelem wakax t'a yichanh mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, yik wach' syak'k'e sk'ab' winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal t'a sjolom nok'.
Ha t'a yichanh mantiado chi' tza milcham nok' t'a wichanh.
Tzik'ank'eta jab'ok schik'il nok' yet' yiximal a k'ab', tza sukanoch t'a sch'ak altar ayk'e t'a schikintak, haxo masanil chik' skan chi', tza tob'kanek' t'a yichtak altar chi'.
Haxo masanil xepu' ayoch t'a sch'anhtza' nok' yet' t'a yib'anh seyub' nok' yet' pax t'a stut nok', tz'ik'eli tza nhusantz'a t'a yib'anh altar.
Haxo nok' chib'ej chi' yet' stz'umal nok', stza' nok', masanil juntzanh chi' tza nhustz'a t'a spatikel campamento, yujto a jun nok' chi' silab' yaj yik tz'ak'ji tup mul.
Slajwi chi', tzik'ankot junok nok' ch'ak kalnel, syak'ank'e sk'ab' winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal chi' t'a sjolom nok'.
Tza milancham nok', tza tzikanoch schik'il nok' t'a schanhil pak'anh altar.
Slajwi chi', tza kotak xikanb'at nok', smaxchajel nok' yol sk'o'ol, nok' yok, junnhej tz'aj yet' nok' kotak xikab'il chi' yet' pax nok' sjolom.
Tza nhusantz'a nok' silab'il t'a yib'anh altar t'a wichanh yuj wik'jicha'anh, haton jun silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil, sumumi sjab' swab'i.
Slajwi chi', tzik'ankot junxo nok' kalnel, syak'ank'e sk'ab' winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal t'a sjolom nok',

tza milancham nok'. Tzik'ank'e jab'ok schik'il nok', tza sukanek' t'a sjayil schikin winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal. Haton t'a schikin heb' t'a swach'. Tza sukpaxek' jab'ok t'a smam sk'ab' heb' yet' t'a smam yok heb' t'a swach'. Slajwi chi' tza tzikankanem masanil schik'il nok' ch'ak kalnel chi' t'a spatiktak altar chi'.

Haxo schik'il nok' kalnel ayoch t'a yib'anh altar chi' tzik'k'e jab'ok, tza tzikanb'at t'a yib'anh winhaj Aarón yet' t'a spichul winh yet' t'a yib'anh heb' yuninal winh yet' pax t'a spatiktak spichul heb'. Icha pax chi' tz'utaj aceite sk'anchaji yik sik'chaj junok mach tz'ochkan wikok. Icha wal chi' tz'aj sik'chajkanel winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal yet' spichul heb'.

Slajwi chi', tzik'anel xepu' ayoch t'a snhe nok' ch'ak kalnel chi', t'a nok' sch'anhtza' yet' t'a yib'anh seyub' nok', tzik'anpaxkot chab' nok' stut yet' pax xepu' ayoch t'ay yet' pax nok' sb'ak'chil xub' t'a swach' yujto a jun nok' ch'ak kalnel chi', haton nok' sk'anchaji yik tz'ochkan heb' sacerdote t'a yopisio.
Tzik'anpaxk'eta ixim pan malaj yich, haton ixim ayem t'a yol mo'och t'a wichanh, junok ixim pan setan setan yaji, junok ixim kalab'il yet' aceite yet' junok ixim k'oxox.
Masanil juntzanh chi' tzak'och t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal, sb'akhchajoch t'a wichanh.

Slajwi chi', tzik'anek' t'a yol sk'ab' heb', tza nhusantz'a t'a yib'anh altar chi'. Junnhej tz'aj stz'a yet' nok' ch'ak kalnel wan stz'a silab'il, sumumi sjab' swab'i. Snhusjitz'a jun ofrenda chi' yuj wik'jicha'anh.
Ha nok' ch'ak kalnel sk'anchaji ayik tz'och winhaj Aarón t'a yopisio, tzik'kanel snhi' sk'ol nok'. Tza b'akhank'e t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik, yujto ik tz'ajkan jun makan nok' chib'ej chi'.
Tza pojanel nok' snhi' sk'ol yet' nok' xub' ix a b'akhk'e t'a wichanh, haton yik nok' ix och yopisio ayik ix ochkan winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal t'a sacerdote'al.
Ha chab' makan nok' chib'ej chi', yik winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal tz'ajkani, haton ofrenda syak' heb' eyetisraelal. Haton chab' makan nok' chi' syak' heb' t'ayin yofrenda'ok yik junk'olal.

Ha spichul winhaj Aarón syak'och t'a yopisio, skannhej t'a heb' yinhtilal winh. Ha junok yinhtilal winh skan t'a yopisio, ayik tz'och t'a yol mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, yuj in yak'an serwil t'a yol jun lugar Ha Innhej Ay Wiko', anhej juntzanh pichul chi' syak'och heb' t'a uke' k'uhal ayik tz'ochkan heb' sacerdote'al.
Tzik'anpaxb'at nok' kalnel ix b'inaji yik tz'ochkan yopisio heb'. Ha t'a jun lugar sik'b'ilpaxeli, hata' tza tz'anh nok'.
Ha winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal schi'an nok' chib'ej chi', swa'anpax juntzanh ixim pan ayem t'a yol jun yune' mo'och chi' t'a yichanh mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.

Haton heb' schi'an nok' ix ak'ji yik tz'ak'ji tup schukal heb', haton yik ix sik'chajel heb' yet' scha'ankan yopisio heb' t'a sacerdote'al, palta malaj junok ch'ok anima'il syal schi'an juntzanh chi', yujto wik yaji.
Tato ayto nok' chib'ej chi' yet' ixim pan chi' skan t'a jun k'u chi', tza nhuskantz'aok. Malaj junokxo mach syal schi'ani ma swa'ani, yujto wik yaji.
Masanil juntzanh tik tza b'o t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal icha wal tz'aj walan t'ayach tik. Uke' k'uhal syik' yuj ak'ankanoch yopisio heb' chi'.
Junjun nok' kelem wakax tzak' silab'il t'a junjun k'u, yik tz'ak'ji lajwok smul heb'. Icha chi' tz'aj a sakb'itan altar t'a wichanh, tza sukanpaxoch aceite t'a yib'anh yik tz'ochkan yopisio.

Uke' k'uhal tzak' silab' t'a yib'anh altar chi', yik tz'ak'ji lajwok mul. Icha wal chi' tz'aj yochkan jun altar chi' wikok, tz'och t'a yopisio. Yalnhej tastak tz'och tennaj t'a jun altar chi', wikxo tz'ajkani.
Junjun k'u yowalil snhusji chawanh nok' kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal silab'il t'a yib'anh altar.
Jun nok' tza nhustz'a t'a k'inhib'alil, junxo nok' tza nhustz'a t'a yemk'uhalil.
Tzak' chanheok libra harina te wach' yet' nok' stz'a t'a k'inhib'alil chi', tza kalej ixim harina chi' yet' junok litro aceite yik sat te' olivo, tza sekanem junok litro wino ofrenda'il.
Hanheja' icha chi' tzutejpax junxo nok' kalnel chi' t'a yemk'uhalil, ixim harina yet' wino ofrenda'il. Ha juntzanh ofrenda snhusjitz'a chi', te sumumi sjab' swab'i.
Ha juntzanh silab' chi', ol snhusnhejtz'a heb' t'a wichanh t'a masanil tiempo t'a stojolal sti' mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, ayik tzin lolon heyet'ok.
Hata' ol in ch'ox in b'a t'a heb' etisraelal, yuj chi' wik ol ajkan jun mantiado chi', yuj in tzikikial.
Ha in wal tzin sik'kanoch jun mantiado chi' wikok yet' yaltaril. Tzin sik'paxkanel winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal chi' yik tz'ochkan heb' sacerdote'al t'ayin.
Ol in kajnaj t'a skal heb' etisraelal, yujto he Diosal in.
Icha wal chi' ol aj snachajel yuj heb' to a in ton Jehová in sDiosal in heb' het'ok, a in ix ex wik'elta t'a Egipto yik tzin kajnaj t'a he kal, a in Jehová he Diosal in tik, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová: Ak' b'ojok junok altar b'aj stz'a incienso. Ha te' acacia tz'och t'ay.
Ha sk'atul 45 centímetro tz'aji, 45 centímetro tz'ajpax sat, haxo ste'el, 90 centímetro tz'aji. Hanheja' sb'ok'e sch'ak altar chi' t'a junjun schikintak, yaman tz'aj yet' altar chi'.
Tz'och k'e'en oro yelxo wal wach' t'a altar chi': T'a yib'anh yet' t'a spatiktak schanhil pak'anh yet' t'a sch'a'ak chi', sk'epax tzalan k'e'en oro chi' t'a yib'anh stitak.
Ha t'a yalanh stitak chi', hata' tz'och chab'chab'ok argolla nab'a oro t'a schab'il pak'anh. Ha t'a yo'ol chi' tzek' te' sb'akhlab'il yik syal sb'akhchaji.
Ha te' b'akhlab' chi', a te' acacia tz'ochi, tz'och k'e'en oro t'a spatik te'.
Tzak'em jun altar chi' t'a yichanhelta k'apak cortina ayoch yenhulok skaxa'il in trato, haton te' kaxa ay smakul b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul. Hata' ol in ch'ox in b'a t'ayex.
Ha winhaj Aarón ol nhusantz'a incienso sumumi sjab' t'a yib'anh altar chi', junjun k'inhib'alil ayik sb'ochajoch candil.
Snhusanpax winh a tz'emxikan k'u, haton t'a yora'il yoch sk'ak'al candil. Ha jun tik ol ujoknhej t'a wichanh ayik ol b'eynhejb'at tiempo.
Malaj junok komon incienso ol nhusjoktz'a t'a yib'anh jun altar chi', malaj pax junok silab', ofrenda t'a ixim trigo, ma ofrenda t'a yik sekchajem wino ol snhuschaj t'ay.

Anhej junel t'a yol ab'il stzikoch chik' winhaj Aarón t'a sch'ak altar chi', haton schik'il nok' silab' smiljicham yuj yak'ji lajwok mul. Junjun ab'il tzuji jun tik t'a masanil tiempo. Ha jun altar chi', wik yaji, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Ayik ol ik'ancha'anh sb'isul heb' etchonhab' israel chi', junjun heb' ol stup t'ayin yuj sk'inal, yik malaj junok ilya te ow ol jawok t'a yib'anh heb' to scham heb' yuj, yuj b'aj sb'ischaj chi'.
Masanil heb' stz'ib'chaj chi', yowalil nanhal siclo k'e'en plata syak' heb' yik stupan heb' t'ayin, icha k'e'en siclo sk'anchaj t'a in kajnub', haton 20 gera.
Masanil heb' stz'ib'chaj sb'i chi', haton heb' 20 ab'il sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, haton heb' chi' tz'ak'an jun b'aj stupchaj chi' t'ayin.
Ayik stupan heb' chi' t'ayin yuj sk'inal, wach'chom heb' b'eyum, ma heb' meb'a' lajannhej tz'aj yak'an heb'. Nanhal siclo syak' junjun heb'.

Ichato chi' smolchaj masanil k'e'en plata syak' heb' anima chi' stojolok yuj sk'inal. Ha t'a mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a tz'och yopisio k'e'en. Ha yuj chi', ol ex in nakoti, haton yuj tas tzeyak' yuj he k 'inal chi', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

Ak' b'ojok junok k'e'en niwan palangana yet' sb'akhnub' yich, nab'a bronce tz'aji. Ha t'a skal snanhal altar yet' mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a skan k'e'en. Sb'ut'chaj k'e'en yet' ha ha'. Hata' syik'k'eta ha' winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal yik sb'ikan sk'ab' heb' yet' yok.
Ayik tz'och heb' t'a yol mantiado, ma ayik sk'och heb' t'a altar yik snhusan yofrenda t'a wichanh, yowalil sb'ik sk'ab' heb' yet' yok, yik max cham heb'.
Ha jun tik, ley tz'ajkan t'a yib'anh winhaj Aarón yet' yinhtilal, ayik ol b'eynhejb'at tiempo, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Sik'chajokab'el juntzanhok awb'en te' manhxo jantakok swach'il sjab': Lajchaweok libra stzatajil te' mirra te wach', wakeok libra canela, wakeok libra te' cálamo yelxo wal wach',

yet' pax lajchaweok libra te' casia. Ha echlab' sk'anchaj t'a juntzanh chi', haton icha echlab' sk'anchaj t'a in kajnub'. Skalaj juntzanh chi' yet' nanhalok schanhil litro aceite yik te' olivo, icha wal tz'aj sb'o'an junok b'o'um perfume. Icha chi' tz'aj a b'oan aceite sk'anchaji a sik'chajel junok mach ma junok tas to wik tz'ajkani.
Sukchajoch aceite chi' t'a mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, t'a te' kaxa yik trato,
t'a te' mexa yet' t'a syamk'ab'il t'a sb'akhnub' candil yet' syamk'ab'il, t'a altar yik incienso,
t'a altar b'aj stz'a silab' yet' syamk'ab'il yet' pax t'a jun k'e'en niwan palangana yet' sb'akhnub'al.
Icha chi' tz'aj a sik'ankanoch masanil juntzanh chi' yik wach' wik tz'ajkani. Masanil tastak tz'och tennaj t'ay, wikxo tz'ajkani.
Ha jun aceite chi' tza sukpaxoch t'a winhaj Aarón yet' pax t'a heb' yuninal winh. Icha chi' tz'aj sik'chajkanoch heb' sacerdote'al t'ayin.
Tzalan t'a masanil heb' etisraelal: Ayik ol b'eynhejb'at tiempo, haton jun aceite tik ol k'anchaj t'a tastak to wik ol ajkanok.
Manh komonok sukchajoch t'a junok komon anima. Manh komonok sb'oji junokxo makan aceite lajan yet' jun tik. Ha jun tik wik tz'ajkani, yuj chi' manh komonok tze yama'.
Tato ay junok mach sb'o'an junokxo makan aceite lajan yet' jun tik, ma sukoch t'a junok komon anima, a jun chi' yowalil tz'ik'jikanel t'a skal heb' yetchonhab', xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Ik'chajokab'kot masanil juntzanh tastak chi', lajannhej ol aj yechlab'il: Stzatajil te' estacte, sjoxal nok' mik' skuch uña, stzatajil te' gálbano te wach' sjab' yet' pax stzatajil te' incienso yelxo wal te wach'.
Ha yet' juntzanh chi' tzak' b'ojok incienso. Wach' tz'aj skalaji, icha wal tz'aj sb'oji yuj junok b'o'um perfume. Wach' tz'aj sb'at yatz'amil, malajokab' spalta'il, yujto wik yaji.
Chok' tz'aj stenjipoj jab'ok, tzak'anoch t'a yol mantiado t'a yichanh te' skaxa'il in trato b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a t'ayex. Ha jun incienso chi', niwanokab' yelk'och t'a yol he sat.
Manh he b'o junokxo icha wal jun ix he b'o tik. Tze nakoti to a innhej ay wiko'.
Tato ay junokxo mach sb'o'an t'a yol yiko', yik syab' sjab', a jun chi' tojolnhej yik'jikanel t'a skal heb' yetchonhab', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Ab'i, ha t'a skal yinhtilal winhaj Judá ix in sik'kanel winhaj Bezaleel, yuninal winhaj Uri, yixchikin winhaj Hur.
Toxo ix wak'och Wespíritu t'a winh, yik jelan sna'anel winh, yik ol yal sb'oank'e yalnhej tastak winh.
Ol sna'anelta winh sb'o'an yechel jantak munlajel ol b'o'ok, icha t'a k'e'en oro, t'a k'e'en plata yet' t'a k'e'en bronce,
yet' pax sb'o'an k'e'en k'e'en winh wach' yilji, sb'o'an te te' t'a yalnhej tas munlajelal.

Haxo winhaj Aholiab, yuninal winhaj Ahisamac, yinhtilal winhaj Dan, a winh ol kolwaj yet' winhaj Bezaleel chi'. Masanil heb' aytaxon sjelanil, ix in wach' ak'ej sjelanil heb' yik a heb' ol b'oan masanil tastak swal tik t'ayach:
Haton k'apak mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, te' skaxa'il in trato yet' smakul b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul, masanil syamk'ab'il t'a yol mantiado chi',
te' mexa yet' jantak syamk'ab'il, jun sb'akhnub' candil nab'a oro yet' syamk'ab'il, jun altar b'aj snhuschaj incienso,
jun altar b'aj stz'a silab' yet' syamk'ab'il, jun niwan palangana yet' sb'akhnub' yich,
k'apak pichul jalb'il niwan yelk'ochi, haton spichul winhaj sacerdote Aarón yet' pax spichul heb' yuninal winh, haton pichul sk'an heb' t'a yopisio.

Sb'opax aceite heb' sk'anchaji ayik tz'ochkan junok mach, ma junok tas wikok. Sb'opax incienso manhxo jantakok swach'il sk'anchaj t'a in kajnub'. Ha juntzanh chi', yowalil sb'o heb' icha wal ix aj walan t'ayach, xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':

Al t'a heb' etchonhab' to yowalil sk'anab'ajej jun sk'uhal ik'oj ip heb', yujto wik yaji. Yujto a jun k'u chi' yechel in trato yajkanoch t'a ko kal heyet'ok t'a masanil tiempo yik wach' tzeyojtakejeli to a in Jehová in tik ix ex in sik'kanel wikok.
Niwanokab' yelk'och jun sk'uhal ik'oj ip chi' t'a yol he sat. Ha mach max k'anab'ajan jun k'uhal ik'oj ip chi', yowalil schami. Yalnhej mach smunlaj t'a jun k'u chi', yowalil schami.
Wakenhej k'uhal tzex munlaji, haxo t'a yukil k'uhal, sk'uhal ik'oj ip, wiknhej yaji. Yalnhej mach smunlaj t'a jun k'u chi', tojolnhej schami.

Yuj chi', yowalil tze k'anab'ajej jun k'uhal ik'oj ip chi'. Ha jun chi' yechel in trato tz'ajkan t'a masanil tiempo t'a ko kal heyet'ok, yujto a in Jehová in t'a wake' k'uhal in b'onak satcha'anh yet' sat lu'um tik, haxo t'a yukil k'uhal wochnak wa'an in munlaji, wik'annak wip, xchi Jehová.
Ayik ix lajwi slolon Jehová yet' winhaj Moisés t'a jolom witz Sinaí, ix yak'an chab' pachanh k'e'en t'a winh, b'aj tz'ib'ab'iloch strato, to a wal Dios ix tz'ib'ani.

Haxo yik ix yilan heb' chonhab' israel to a winhaj Moisés chi' hanheja' max emxul-laj winh b'aj ayek' heb' chi', ix smolb'an sb'a heb' smasanil, ix yalan heb' t'a winhaj Aarón: --Ha tikne'ik, ko gana to tza b'o juntzanhok ko diosal tzonh kuchb'ani, yujto a winhaj Moisés, winh ix onh ik'anelta t'a Egipto, manh kojtakok tas ix ik'an winh, xchi heb' chonhab' chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Aarón chi' t'a heb': --Ha tikne'ik, molb'ejekkot masanil k'e'en uchikin nab'a oro yik heb' ix eyetb'eyum yet' yik heb' eyuninal, heb' ix eyisil, tzeyik'ankot t'ayin, xchi winh.
Masanil anima ix yik'el yuchikin, ix yik'ankot heb' t'a winhaj Aarón chi'.

Ix scha'anek' winh, ix yak'an ulax k'e'en winh t'a skal te' k'ak', ix yak'anem winh t'a yol jun smoldeal, ix b'o jun yechel jun kelem wakax. Ix ochnhej ijan winh swach' b'oan jun yechel wakax chi'. Ix yalan heb' chonhab' chi' smasanil: --Ex ketchonhab' israel, a jun ko diosal tik ix onh ik'anelta t'a Egipto, xchi heb'.
Ayik ix yilan jun chi' winhaj Aarón chi', ix sb'oank'e jun altar winh t'a yichanh jun yechel wakax chi', te cha'anh ix yal winh: --Ha k'ik'an skak'och junok niwan k'inh t'a yichanh Jehová, xchi winh.

Haxo ix k'inhib'i t'a junxo k'u, ix smolb'an sb'a anima smasanil, ix snhusan juntzanh silab' heb' yet' silab' yik junk'olal. Ixlajwi chi' ix em k'ojjab' heb', ix wa heb', ix yuk'an ha' heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e b'ulnaj heb' schanhalwi yet' sk'ulan chukal t'a yichanh sdiosal chi'.
Yuj chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ixik, emanhxi yujto a heb' a chonhab' ix ik'elta t'a Egipto, toxo ix sjuel sb'a heb'.

Yelxo wal t'a elanhchamel ix yik'el sb'a heb' t'a tas ix wala'. T'a elanhchamel ix sb'o jun yechel kelem wakax heb', syak'anem sb'a heb' ejmelal t'ay. Syak'an silab' heb', syalan heb': Ex ketchonhab' israel, a wal jun ko diosal tik ix onh ik'anelta t'a Egipto, xchi heb'.
Toxo ix wila'' to a juntzanh anima tik, yelxo wal pit spensar heb'.
Ha tikne'ik manhxo ach tewok t'ayin yuj heb', skot wal wowal t'a juntzanh anima tik. Ol in satel heb' smasanil, anhej het'ok ol in b'o jun niwan nación yet' heb' inhtilal, xchi t'a winh.

Haxo winhaj Moisés chi', ix och ijan winh sk'anan niwank'olal t'a Jehová sDiosal yuj heb' schonhab', ix yalan winh: --Mamin Jehová, ¿tas wal yuj skot yowal a k'ol t'a yib'anh a chonhab' to a ach ix ik'elta t'a Egipto yet' ipalil?

¿Tas wal yuj ol a cha ach yal heb' aj Egipto chukal? Ol am yal heb' icha tik: Tob'an chuk spensar Dios t'a heb', yuj chi' ix yik'el heb' t'a tik, sb'at smilancham heb' t'a jolomtak witz, satjiel heb' yuj t'a sat lum lum tik, xcham heb'. Yuj chi' komonok max te kot yowal a k'ol t'a yib'anh heb', mokab' ak'och yahelal t'a yib'anh heb'.

Komonok tza nakot heb' a chekab', haton winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Israel. Ha loknak a b'i ak'annak a ti' t'a heb', alannak icha tik: Ol wik'cha'anh he b'isul yet' eyuninal. Lajan ol aj sb'isul heb' icha k'e'en k'anal t'a satcha'anh. Hanheja' jun lum lum tik, toxo ix wala' to ol wak' t'a eyinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo, xa chinak t'a heb', xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Yuj chi' ix sna'an Jehová to manhxo ol satel-laj schonhab' chi'.
Ix meltzajemta winhaj Moisés t'a jolom witz chi', yet'nakxo chab' pachanh k'e'en winh b'aj tz'ib'ab'iloch cheknab'il yuj Jehová, t'a schab'il pak'anh k'e'en.
Ha wal Jehová ixb'o'an k'e'en k'e'en chi' schab'il, ix stz'ib'anoch letra chi' t'a k'e'en.
Haxo yik ix yab'an winhaj Josué yel yaw heb' anima, ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha wal skab'an yel yaw heb' anima chi', icha wal to ayoch owal t'a yol campamento, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha juntzanh aw tz'och skab' chi', manh awok yik tzalajk'olal yik tz'ak'ji ganar junok owal, manh awokpax yik kusk'olal yik tz'ak'ji ganar anima yuj heb' ajk'o'ol, palta b'it tz'och swab'i, xchi winh.

Haxo yik ix jawi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a slak'anil campamento chi', ix yilanoch jun yechel kelem wakax chi' winh, haxo heb' anima wan schanhalwi heb'. Ix te kot yowal winh, ix syumanel k'e'en k'e'en b'aj tz'ib'ab'iloch cheknab'il chi' winh, yuj chi' ix pojb'at k'e'en t'a yich witz chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at stzak'anelta jun yechel wakax chi' winh, ix syumanoch winh t'a skal k'ak'. Ixlajwi chi' ix smak'anpoj winh, chok'xonhej ix aji, ix yak'anem winh t'a skal ha ha', ix schekan winh yuk' heb' anima chi'.
Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Aarón chi': --¿Tas yuj ach montaj yuj juntzanh anima tik ix a kuchb'an heb' sk'ulan jun niwan chukal tik? xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Aarón chi': --Mamin, mokab' kot owal t'ayin, ojtak wal sik'lab'il to a jun chonhab' tik, sgananhej heb' sk'ulan chukal.
Ha heb' ix halan t'ayin: B'o junok ko diosal tzonh kuchb'ani, yujto a winhaj Moisés ix onh ik'anelta t'a Egipto, ma chekel tas ix ik'an winh, max jaxlaj winh, xchi heb' t'ayin.

Yuj chi' ix walan t'a heb': Machtak ex ay k'e'en oro t'ayex, ma k'e'en uchikin, ik'ekeli, tzeyik'ankoti, xin chi t'a heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot heb' t'ayin, ix wak'an ulax t'a kal k'ak', haxo ix aji ix komon elta jun yechel wakax tik, xchi winh t'a winh.
