Ix nachajel yuj winhaj Moisés chi' to a heb' anima chi', b'ekanxonhej sk'ol heb' yak'an k'ixwelal sb'a t'a yichanh heb' chonhab' ayoch ajk'olal t'a heb', haxo winhaj Aarón chi' maj skachoch wa'an jab'ok heb' winh.

Yuj wal chi' ix och tek'tek' winhaj Moisés chi' t'a sti' campamento chi', ix yalan winh: --Ha tikne'ik a mach syal sk'ol syak'och sb'a t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová, kotokab' t'a in tz'ey tik, xchi winh. Masanil heb' yetlevita'il winh, ix snitzkot sb'a heb' t'a stz'ey winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanpax winh t'a heb': --Ix schek Jehová ko Diosal wal t'ayex to junjun ex tzeyik'b'at eyespada, tzex b'at t'a campamento, tzex ek' t'a kaltak mantiado, tze milancham heb' eyuk'tak, heb' eyamigo yet' heb' kajan t'a he lak'anil, xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix sk'anab'ajej cheknab'il heb' winh levita ix yak' winh. Yuj chi', ay am oxeok mil anima ix smilcham heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha tikne'ik ix eyak'och he b'a t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová, ina to a ex ix he milcham eyuninal yet' eyuk'tak. Yuj wal chi', ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a eyib'anh, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb' anima: --Te niwan he mul ix ochi. Ha tikne'ik tik tzin b'atxi t'a jolom witz b'aj ayek' Jehová. Hata' ol in lolon yet'ok, talaj ol yak' lajwok he mul chi' t'a eyib'anh, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh t'a jolom witz b'aj ayek' Jehová chi'. Ix yalan winh: --Wal yel Mamin, te niwan smul jun chonhab' tik ix och t'a ichanh, ix sb'o jun sdiosal heb' oro yik syak'em sb'a heb' t'ay.

Yuj wal chi' tzin tewi t'ayach to tzak' lajwok smul heb' chi'. Tato max ak' niwank'olal smul heb' chi' jun, tza suksat in b'i t'a yol ch'anh libro b'aj tz'ib'ab'il sb'i heb' to ikxo yaji, xchi winh t'a Jehová.
Haxo ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh: --Ha heb' tz'och smul t'ayin, haton heb' chi' tzin suksat sb'i t'a yol ch'anh libro chi'.
Yuj chi' ixik, tzik'anb'at heb' chonhab' chi' t'a jun lugar ix wal t'ayach. Ha jun wángel ol b'ab'laj eyu'uj, palta ol k'och sk'uhal yik ol wak'anoch syahelal heb' anima tik yuj smul, xchi.
Ixlajwi chi', a Jehová ix ak'ankot jun niwan ilya to smilwaj t'a yib'anh heb' chonhab' israel chi', yujto ix yak'och sb'a heb' sb'o'an jun yechel wakax, haton jun ix sb'o winhaj Aarón chi'.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha tikne'ik elanh t'a tik yet' heb' chonhab' ix ik'elta t'a Egipto, tzik'anb'at heb' t'a sat lum lum walnak t'a winhaj Abraham, t'a winhaj Isaac yet' t'a winhaj Jacob to ol wak' t'a yinhtilal heb' winh.

Ha in ol in chek b'ab'laj jun wángel t'a eyichanh. A' ol ex kuchb'anb'atok. Ha juntzanh chonhab'il anima, haton heb' cananeo, heb' amorreo, heb' hitita, heb' ferezeo, heb' heveo yet' heb' jebuseo, ol wik'el heb' t'a sat lu'um chi'.
Ixikek t'a jun lum te yax sat chi', palta manh ol in b'atlaj t'a he kal, yujto te pit ex, ay smay tzex in satel t'a yoltak b'e, xchi Jehová.
Ayik ix yab'an heb' anima jun lolonel kuseltak yalji chi', ix och heb' t'a ilk'olal, manhxalaj mach ix yak'och yuchikin yet' stonh.

Yujto a Jehová ix halan t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Al t'a heb' etisraelal tik: Ha ex tik te pit ex. Tato tzin k'och t'a he kal junok rato, ay smay tzex in sateli. Ha tikne'ik ik'ekel eyuchikin chi' yet' he tonh t'a he jaj chi', ol wilani tas ol ex wutok, xa chi, xchi t'a winh.
Yuj wal chi', atax ix el heb' t'a yich witz Horeb, manhxo junok heb' ix yak'och stonh yet' yuchikin.

Ix yak' b'ochajk'e jun mantiado winhaj Moisés t'a stib'at campamento. Ix yak'an winh skuch jun mantiado chi': T'a B'aj Sch'ox Sb'a Jehová. Tato ay junok mach sb'at sk'anb'ej junok tas t'a Jehová, yowalil sb'at t'a jun mantiado chi'.
Ayik sb'at winhaj Moisés t'a mantiado chi', tz'elta linhan heb' anima smasanil t'a stitak smantiado, sb'at k'elan heb' t'a winh masanto tz'ochkan winh t'a yol mantiado chi'.
Ayik tz'och winh, tz'emul moynaj jun asun t'a sti' mantiado chi' yakb'an slolon Jehová yet' winh.
Ha syilan heb' anima chi' yemul moynaj jun asun chi', tz'em nhojan heb' smasanil ejmelal t'a Jehová.

K'elk'umb'a wal tz'aj Jehová slolon yet' winhaj Moisés chi', icha wal tz'aj ko lolon yet' junok ko wach'k'o'ol. Slajwi slolon winh yet' Jehová chi', sjax winh t'a campamento. Palta haxo winh skolwaj yet' winhaj Moisés chi', haton winhaj Josué kelem winak, yuninal winhaj Nun, skannhej winh t'a yol mantiado chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a Jehová: --Mamin Jehová, a ach ix al t'ayin to a in tzin kuchb'ej jun a chonhab' tik, palta maj al-laj t'ayin mach ol a chek kolwaj wet'ok. Ix halani to ojtak in to ay a tzalajk'olal wet'ok halani.

Yuj chi', tato yel icha chi', ak' wojtakejeli tas nab'il u'uj, yik cham tzach wojtakejeli, ol wak'annhej tzalajb'ok a k'o'ol. Ojtak wal to a jun chonhab' tzak'kanoch t'a yol in k'ab' tik to a chonhab' yaji, xchi winh.
--Ha in wal lak'an ol in b'at het'ok, ol ex wak' kajnaj t'a junk'olal t'a lum lum chi', xchi Jehová t'a winh.
Yuj wal chi', ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi': --Yel wal Mamin, tato max ach b'at ket'ok, wach' to max onh ik'el t'a tik.

Tato max ach b'at ket' tikne'ik, ¿tas wal tz'aj yojtakajeli, tato ay a tzalajk'olal wet'ok yet' t'a heb' a chonhab' tik? Tato ayachnhejoch ket'ok jun, ol cheklajelok to a chonhab' ton kaji, sik'b'il onh el u'uj t'a skal masanil chonhab', xchi winh.
--Ha juntzanh lolonel tzal tik ol in k'ulej, yujto te ay in tzalajk'olal het'ok, wojtak wal a pensar sik'lab'il, xchi Jehová t'a winh.
--Mamin, tzin tewi wal t'ayach to tza ch'ox sniwanil elk'och t'ayin, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winh: --Masanil in wach'k'olal ol in ch'ox t'ayach. Ha wal t'a ichanh ol walel in wach'il to a in ton Jehová in, ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'a heb' b'aj syal in k'ol swak'a', ol ok' in k'o'ol t'a heb' b'aj syal in k'o'ol.
Palta swal t'ayach to manh ol yal-laj och k'elan t'a in sat, yujto malaj junok mach syal yilan in sat. Tato tz'och k'elan junok mach t'ayin, elanhchamel schami.
Ina t'a in lak'anil ay jun lugar b'aj ol yal a k'ekan linhan t'a yib'anh jun niwan k'e'en.
Ayik ol ek'b'at in tzikikial ta', ol ach wak'anoch t'a yol spojelal k'e'en k'e'en chi', ol ach in makchankanoch yet' in k'ab' yakb'an tzin ek'kanb'ati.
Ayik ol lajwok wek'kani, ol wik'anel in k'ab', haxonhej in patik ol yal hilani, haxo in sat manh wal jab'ok ol yal hilani, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha tikne'ik a hachxo ol a tzey chab'ok k'e'en k'e'en, icha wal k'e'en ix wak' t'ayach t'a sb'ab'elal, haton k'e'en ix a mak'pojok. Ol in tz'ib'anxioch t'a k'e'en, icha wal tas ix in tz'ib'ejoch t'a k'e'en b'ab'el chi'.
Tza b'oan a b'a t'a k'inhib'alil k'ik'an, tzach jawi t'a wichanh t'a jolom witz tik.
Malaj junok mach syal sk'eta het'ok, malaj junok mach syal yek' t'a spatiktak lum witz tik. Max yalpaxlaj yek' nok' kalnel yet' nok' wakax wa'el t'a yichtak lu'um, xchi t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi, ix stzeyan chab' k'e'en k'e'en winh icha k'e'en ix scha' t'a sb'ab'elal t'a Jehová. Haxo t'a k'inhib'alil t'a junxo k'u, ix yik'anb'at k'e'en winh, ix b'at winh t'a jolom witz Sinaí, icha wal ix yutej Jehová yalan t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix emul Jehová t'a stz'ey winh t'a skal asun t'a jolom witz chi', ix yalan sb'i t'a winh.

Ix ek'b'at Jehová t'a yichanh winh, te cha'anh ix yal icha tik: --Ha in ton Jehová in. Jehová in b'i. Te wach' in k'o'ol, tz'ok' in k'ol t'a anima. Manh elanhchamelok skot wowal. Te niwan tzin xajanej heb' anima, swak'nhejelk'och tas swala'.

Ha tas wach' walnakkan t'a heb' he mam eyicham, ol wak'nhejelk'och t'ayex a ex yinhtilexkan heb' tik t'a masanil tiempo. Swak'an niwank'olal he chukal he mul yet' he pital. Palta max ek'b'atlaj wak'an syahelal junok mach yuj smul b'aj junelnhej pit syutej sb'a t'ayin, swak'nhejkan yahelal t'a yib'anh yuninal yet' yixchikin, masanto t'a schanhil makan yinhtilal, xchi Jehová.
T'a elanhchamel ix em nhojan winhaj Moisés chi', ix emk'och snanhal sat winh t'a sat lu'um t'a yichanh Jehová chi', ix yalan winh icha tik:

--Mamin Wajalil, tato yel tzach tzalaj wet'ok, tzach b'atnhej ket'ok, wach'chom a jun chonhab' tik te pit, palta ak' niwank'olal ko chukal tz'och t'a ichanh, tzonh a cha'ankan a chonhab'ok, xchi winh.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Cha'ab' tas ol wala': Ha tikne'ik, tzin b'okan jun in trato tik t'a yichanh masanil heb' etchonhab'. Ol in b'o tastak te satub'tak to mantalaj b'aj tzuji t'a junokxo nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ol yil masanil heb' etchonhab' heb' ajun tik het'ok tastak ol in k'ulej eyu'uj, to satub'tak yilji.
k'anab'ajejek masanil tas swalkan tik t'ayex. Ha in ol wik'el heb' amorreo, heb' cananeo, heb' hitita, heb' ferezeo, heb' heveo yet' heb' jebuseo t'a eyichanh.
Ayik ol ex k'och t'a sat lum lum chi', malajokab' b'ak'inh tze b'o junok he trato yet' heb' anima ta'. Tato skan heb' t'a he kal, yel ol ex yixtejel heb'.
Ha wal tas ol he k'ulej to ol he mak'poj yaltar heb' yet' yechel sdiosal heb'. Tze ch'akanel te te' yechel sdiosal heb' skuchan Asera.
Manh ex lesalwok t'a junok komon Dios, yujto a in Jehová in, yelxo wal te ow in t'a juntzanh chi'. Yelxo wal ste kot wowal t'ayex tato tzex och ejmelal t'a junok ch'ok diosal.

Manh he b'olaj junok he trato yet' heb' anima ayek' t'a sat lum chi'. Tato tze b'o he trato chi' yet' heb' haxo yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a sdiosal chi', syak'an silab' heb' t'ay, tzex yawtej heb', tze wa'an tas syak' heb' silab'ok chi'.

Talaj syik'laj sb'a yisil heb' yet' heb' eyuninal, haxo yik tz'em nhojan heb' ix t'a sdiosal chi', skuchb'ajem nhojan heb' eyuninal chi' yuj heb' ix t'a juntzanh komon Dios chi'. Tato icha chi' manhxalaj tz'aj welk'och t'a yol sat heb' eyuninal chi'.
Manh he b'o junok he diosal yet' k'e'en k'e'en sb'ochaj t'a molde.

Tze yak'och k'inh yik ixim pan malaj yich. Uke' k'uhal tze wa jun pan chi', icha wal ix aj wak'an he k'ayb'ej. Ha stiempo'al, chekel yajkani, haton uj Abib, yujto ha t'a jun uj chi' elnakexkot t'a Egipto.
Masanil heb' b'ab'el winak unin, wik yaj heb'. Wikpax sb'ab'el yune' nok' he wakax, yune' nok' he kalnel yet' yune' nok' he chiwa tato winak.

Haxo pax sb'ab'el yune' nok' he b'uru, syal yak'ji junok yune' kalnel sk'exulok nok'. Tato malaj junok sk'exul nok' tzeyak'a', yowalil smak'ji k'ichaj sjaj nok'. Hanheja' pax yuj he b'ab'el winak unin, yowalil tzeyak' junok nok' yune' kalnel sk'exulok. Malaj junok mach sja t'ayin t'a k'inh tato malaj jab'ok yofrenda yet'nak.
T'a wake' k'uhal tzex munlaji, haxo t'a yukil k'uhal tzeyik'an eyip, wach'chom stiempo'al munlajel, ma stiempo'al smolchajk'e sat eyawb'en, yowalil tzeyik' eyip.
Tzeyak'och k'inh yik sb'ab'el sat ixim he trigo sk'anb'i, haton k'inh Pentecostés. Tzeyak'anpaxoch junxo k'inh yik slajwik'e ixim yik lajwub' ab'il.
Masanil heb' winak, yowalil oxel sjawi heb' t'a wichanh t'a yol junjun ab'il t'a juntzanh k'inh tik, a in Jehová he Diosal in tik swala'.
Ol wik'el masanil juntzanhxo nación t'a eyichanh, ol wak' lewanb'ok he lu'um. Malaj mach syal yik'anek' lum he lu'um chi', yakb'an ayek' heb' winak t'a wichanh oxel t'a yol ab'il.

Ayik tzeyak'an he silab' t'ayin, manh eyak' schik'il nok' nok' yet' ixim pan ayb'at yich t'a skal. Ha nok' silab' yik jun k'inh yik tze na'ankoti ayik ex wik'annakelta t'a Egipto, tato ayto nok' skani, manh he sik'kanb'at t'a junxo k'u.
Ha sb'ab'el sat eyawb'en yowalil tzeyik'kot t'a in kajnub'. Manh he tz'anh nok' yunetak chiwa t'a skal yal yim snun, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': Tz'ib'ej masanil juntzanh lolonel tik, yujto a ayoch yichb'anelok in trato ix wak' het'ok yet' pax heb' etchonhab', xchi.

Ha winhaj Moisés chi', 40 k'uhal yet' 40 ak'wal ix ek' winh yet' Jehová t'a jolom witz Sinaí. Malaj wal jab'ok tas ix swa winh, malaj pax jab'ok tas ix yuk'ej winh t'a jun pekti' chi'. Ix stz'ib'anoch slolonelal strato Jehová yet' heb' chonhab' israel t'a k'e'en k'e'en, haton lajunhe' cheknab'il.

Ixlajwi chi, ix emixta winhaj Moisés chi' t'a jolom witz Sinaí chi', yet'nakxopax chab' pachanh k'e'en k'e'en winh, haton k'e'en b'aj tz'ib'ab'iloch cheknab'il chi'. Manh yojtakok winh tato toxonhej swe'ei yilji sat, yujto ix lolon winh yet' Jehová.
Haxo ix yilan winhaj Aarón yet' masanil heb' yetchonhab' to toxonhej swe'ei yilji sat winh, ix te xiwk'e heb' smasanil sk'och t'a stz'ey winh.
Ix yawtankot heb' anima chi' winh, ichato chi' ix snitzanoch sb'a winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' t'a stz'ey winh, ix lolon winh t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix snitzankot sb'a masanil heb' chonhab', ix och ijan winh yalan masanil cheknab'il ix yak' Jehová t'a winh, haton juntzanh ix b'at schaemta winh t'a jolom witz Sinaí chi'.
Ha ix lajwi slolon winh t'a heb' anima chi', ix smakan sat winh t'a jun k'apak.
Haxo yik tz'och winh yik slolon yet' Jehová, syik'el jun k'apak chi' winh. Haxo tz'elxul winh, syalanxi winh t'a heb' chonhab' tas cheknab'ilal schek Jehová chi' yal t'a heb'.

Ayik wan slolon winh t'a heb' chi', syilan heb' to we'ei yilji sat winh. Slajwi yalan scheknab'il Jehová winh t'a heb', smakanxi sat winh t'a jun k'apak chi'. Hato yik tz'och winh lolonel t'a yichanh Jehová, syik'anxiel winh.
Ix smolb'ankot masanil heb' chonhab' israel winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: Ix yak' juntzanh cheknab'il tik Jehová t'ayin, to ol he k'anab'ajej.
Wake' k'uhal tzex munlaji, haxo yukil k'uhal, yikxo Jehová yaji. E masanil t'a jun k'u chi' tzeyik' eyip, tzeyik'ancha'anh Jehová. Ha mach smunlaj t'a jun k'u chi' yowalil schami.
Wach'chom he k'ak', max yal-laj eyak'anoch t'a jun k'uhal chi' yalnhej b'aj kajan ex, xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a masanil heb' chonhab' israel icha tik: Ha juntzanh tik ix yal Jehová:
Tzeyak' junok ofrenda t'ay. Ha mach tz'el wal t'a sk'ol yak'ani, syal yik'ankot k'e'en oro, k'e'en plata yet' k'e'en bronce,
anh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, anh yaxmakinak, anh chak ch'al, anh lino te wach' yet' xil nok' chiwa b'ayb'il.
Syalpax eyik'ankot stz'umal nok' ch'ak kalnel uk'nak yet' chakchak, nok' tz'u'um te lab'ab'i yet' pax te' acacia.
Tzeyik'paxkot yaceite'al sat te' olivo tz'em t'a yol candil, perfume sb'at t'a skal aceite tz'ak'jioch t'a junok tz'ochkan yikok Jehová, sb'atpax t'a skal incienso suk'uk'i sjab'.
Tzeyik'paxkot k'e'en kornalina yet' juntzanh k'e'en k'e'en yelxo wal wach' yilji tz'och yelwanub'ok schaleka winh sat sacerdote, tz'ochpax yelwanub' jun smakul snhi' sk'o'ol winh.
Masanil heb' winh winak jelan sb'o'an tastak wach' yilji, kotokab' heb' winh, yik sb'o'an tas heb' winh ix schek Jehová sb'o'i:
Haton mantiado skajnub' Jehová yet' pax juntzanh tz'och t'a yib'anh yet' pax sganchoal, smarcoal, sregla'il, yoyal yet' sb'akhnub'al yich.
Sb'opax te' skaxa'il trato, sregla'il tz'och sb'akhlab'ilok, smakul b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul, junok cortina tz'och smakulok,
te' mexa yet' regla tz'och sb'akhlab'ilok yet' pax syamk'ab'il, ixim pan tz'ak'jioch t'a yichanh Jehová.
Sb'opax sb'akhnub'al candil yet' masanil syamk'ab'il yet' pax uke' candil yet' aceite tz'em t'a yol juntzanh candil chi'.
Sb'ojipax altar yik incienso, regla tz'och sb'akhlab'ilok, aceite sk'anchaji yik tz'och t'a junok tz'ochkan yikok Jehová, incienso suk'uk'i sjab', k'apak cortina yik smakul sti' skajnub' Jehová.
Sb'opax junok altar b'aj stz'a silab', smalla'il jun altar chi' nab'a bronce yet' sregla'il yet' masanil syamk'ab'il. Sb'o jun palangana yet' sb'akhnub'al.
Sb'opax k'apak cortina tzek' hoyan t'a spatik yamak'il skajnub' Jehová chi' yet' yoyal yet' pax sb'akhnub'al yich yet' k'apak cortina tz'och smakulok sti' amak' chi'.
Sb'o yestaca'il yet' sch'anhal syamanem t'a spatiktak jun skajnub' Jehová chi' yet' t'a yamak'il.

Sb'opax k'apak pichul jalb'il syak'och heb' sacerdote t'a yol skajnub' Jehová. Haton pichul syak'och winhaj sacerdote Aarón to yiknhej yopisio winh yaji yet' pax spichul heb' yuninal winh, haton syak'och heb' a tz'och heb' t'a yopisio, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ixlajwi yalan masanil juntzanh chi' winhaj Moisés chi', ix b'at heb' smasanil t'a yoltak smantiado.
Ha heb' ix el wal t'a sk'o'ol, ix laj yak' silab' heb' yik sb'oji skajnub' Jehová, haton b'aj sch'ox sb'a yet' masanil tas tz'och yopisio yet' k'apak pichul yik yopisio heb' sacerdote.

Ix laj jawi heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix yet' silab' t'a Jehová, hato syala' jantak ix el t'a sk'ol heb' yak'ani, ix ul yak'an heb' t'a winhaj Moisés chi'. Ix yik'ankot k'e'en yelwanub' pichul heb', k'e'en kolk'ab', k'e'en tonh, k'e'en uchikin yet' juntzanhokxo nab'a oro. Ix yak'an heb' t'a Jehová.

Masanil heb' ay ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak t'ay, ch'al yaxmakinak, chak ch'al, lino te wach', xil nok' chiwa b'ayb'il, stz'umal nok' ch'ak kalnel uk'nak yet' chakchak yet' pax nok' tz'u'um te lab'ab'i, ix laj yik'kot heb' t'a Jehová.
Ay pax mach ix el t'a sk'o'ol yik'ankot k'e'en plata yet' k'e'en bronce yofrenda'ok t'a Jehová. Ha heb' ay te' acacia t'ay, ix yik'paxkot te' heb', yik sk'anchaj te' t'a skajnub' Dios.
Haxo heb' ix ix syal sb'o'an anh ch'al, ix yik'kot ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak heb' ix, ch'al yaxmakinak, chak ch'al yet' lino te wach'.
Ay heb' ix ix jelan ix el wal t'a sk'o'ol, ix och ijan heb' ix sb'o'an xil nok' chiwa t'a ch'alil.

Haxo heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab', ix yik'kot k'e'en kornalina heb' yet' pax juntzanhxo k'e'en k'e'en te wach' yik tz'och yelwanub'ok schaleka winh sat sacerdote yet' yochpax yelwanub'ok jun smakul snhi' sk'o'ol winh.
Ix yik'paxkot perfume heb', aceite sk'anchaj t'a candil, aceite sk'anchaj t'a junok tz'ochkan yikok Jehová yet' incienso suk'uk'i sjab'.
Masanil heb' chonhab' israel, heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix to ix el wal t'a sk'o'ol, ix yak' skolwal heb' t'a masanil jun munlajel ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yal winhaj Moisés t'a masanil heb' yetchonhab': Ha Jehová toxo ix sik'anel winhaj Bezaleel, yuninal winhaj Uri, yixchikin winhaj Hur, t'a yinhtilal Judá.
Ix yak'anoch Yespíritu Dios chi' t'a winh yik syak'an sjelanil spensar winh yet' yojtakanel winh yik syalpax snachajel yuj winh
sb'o'an yechel tas sb'o'o, icha t'a k'e'en oro, k'e'en plata yet' k'e'en bronce.
Ix ak'jipax sjelanil winh yik sb'oanpax k'e'en k'e'en yelxo wal wach', yik sb'oanpaxem yechel te te' yelxo wal wach' tz'aji yet' yoch yelwanub' te'.
Ix yak'an sjelanil Jehová t'a winh yet' t'a winhaj Aholiab, yuninal winhaj Ahisamac, t'a yinhtilal Dan, yik sk'ayb'an juntzanhxo heb' skolwaj yet' heb'.

Ix ak'ji sjelanil heb' yuj Jehová, yik sb'o'an masanil tastak heb' to yelxo wal wach' yilji: Yik sb'o'an yechel, yik sb'oanoch yelwanub' yet' anh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, anh ch'al yaxmakinak, anh chak ch'al yet' lino ch'al te wach'. Ix ak'ji sjelanil heb' sb'o'an junok tas wach' yet' sch'oxan yechel junokxo yalnhej tas munlajelal.

Yuj chi' a winhaj Bezaleel, winhaj Aholiab yet' pax juntzanhxo heb' winh winak ix ak'ji sjelanil yuj Jehová sb'o'an tastak wach' yilji, a heb' winh ol b'oan masanil tas tz'och yopisio t'a skajnub' Jehová icha ix aj yalani, xchi winhaj Moisés.

Haxo winhaj Moisés ix awtankot winhaj Bezaleel yet' winhaj Aholiab chi' yet' pax masanil heb' winh ix ak'ji sjelanil spensar yuj Jehová yik sb'o'an yalnhej tastak wach' yilji, haton heb' tz'el t'a sk'ol skolwaj t'a jun munlajel chi'.

Ha heb' winh chi' ix cha'an masanil ofrenda ix yik'kot heb' chonhab' israel t'a winhaj Moisés, yik tz'el yich munlajel yuj sb'o skajnub' Dios. Haxo heb' tz'el wal t'a sk'ol yak'an yofrenda, junjun k'inhib'al syik'ankot yofrenda heb' chi'.
Haxo heb' winh munlajwum chi', ix yaktejkan smunlajel heb' winh, ix b'at heb' winh yal t'a winhaj Moisés chi':
Toxo ix ek' yib'anh yik'ankot yofrenda heb' anima, manh ol lajwoklaj masanil tas ix yik'kot heb' tik t'a munlajel ix yal Jehová to sb'o'i, xchi heb' winh.

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Moisés to icha chi', ix yalanel winh t'a skal anima t'a campamento to maxtzak yik'kotlaj yofrenda heb' yuj sb'o skajnub' Dios. Icha chi' ix aj swanaj yik'ankot yofrenda heb' chi',
yujto toxo ix tz'akwi jantak tas ol och t'a skajnub' Dios, aytopax tas olto kanok.

Ha t'a skal heb' munlajwum chi', hata' ay heb' jelan spensar sb'oank'e skajnub' Dios. Lajunhe' jenhan k'apak lino b'ayb'il sch'alil ix sb'o heb'. T'a anh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, anh ch'al yaxmakinak yet' pax anh chak ch'al ix sb'o'okh yechel querubín heb' t'a junjun jenhan lino chi'.
Ha junjun jenhan chi', 12 metro ste'el yet' nanhalxo, chab' metro sat. Lajannhej ix aj yechel smasanil.
Oye' jenhan k'apak ix tz'ischaj yam sb'a yik junxonhej jenhan tz'aji. Hanheja' icha chi' ix aj stz'ischaj syam sb'a oyexo jenhan.
Ixlajwi chi', ix tz'ischajoch xoyjab' anh k'ik'mutz'inak ch'al t'a sti' k'apak b'ab'el jenhan chi' yik syamnub'alok. Hanheja' icha chi' ix aj yochpax t'a sti' junxo schab'il jenhan chi'.
Ix och xoyjab' 50 k'ik'mutz'inak ch'al t'a jun pak'anh sti', junjun jenhan k'apak lajannhej ix aj schalan sb'a k'apak.
Ix b'opax 50 k'e'en syamnub'al nab'a oro yik syal yil-lan sb'a k'apak chab' jenhan chi' yik wach' junxonhej tz'ajkan k'apak.
Ix b'oxi huxluche' jenhan xil nok' chiwa, yik a tz'och t'a yib'anh skajnub' Dios.
Ay 13 metro ste'el yet' nanhalxo yet' chab' metro sat. Lajannhej ix aj yechel smasanil.
Ix tz'ischaj yam sb'a oye' jenhan yik junxonhej tz'aji. Ix tz'ischajpax syam sb'a wakexo, yik junxonhej pax jenhan tz'aji.
Ix och xoyjab' 50 syamnub'al t'a jun pak'anh sti' jun b'ab'el jenhan. Ix ochpax 50 syamnub'al t'a sti' junxo schab'il jenhan chi'.
Ix b'opax 50 syamnub' nab'a bronce, yik syil-laj sb'a chab' jenhan chi', yik junxonhej jenhan tz'aji.

Ix b'ojipax stz'umal nok' ch'ak kalnel uk'nak yet' chakchak, yik tz'em t'a yib'anh jun jenhan xil nok' chiwa chi' yet' junxo makan tz'u'um te lab'ab'i yik tz'em t'a yib'anh jun jenhan stz'umal nok' ch'ak kalnel chi'.
Ix sb'opax juntzanh te' marco heb', yik tz'och t'a spatik skajnub' Dios, linhan tz'ajoch junjun te'. Masanil te', a te' acacia b'aj ix el te'.
Nanhal yo'il metro ste'el junjun te' marco chi', haxo slewanil sat te', 70 centímetro.
Ix kan chab'chab' yok junjun te' marco chi' yik tz'em linhan. Lajannhej ix ajkan skal yok te' chi'. Icha chi' ix aj te' marco chi' smasanil tz'och t'a spatik skajnub' Dios chi'.
Ay 20 te' ix sb'o heb' yik tz'och t'a stojolal sur.
Ix b'oji 40 k'e'en plata sb'akhnub'ok yich te' 20 chi' yuj heb', chab'chab' k'e'en t'a yich junjun te', junjun k'e'en t'a junjun yok te'.
Hanhejtona' ix b'oji 20-xo te' marco chi' yik tz'och t'a jun pak'anhxo, haton t'a stojolal norte.
Hanheja' 40 k'e'en plata ix b'o sb'akhnub'ok yich te', yik chab'chab' k'e'en tz'och t'a yich junjun te'.
Haxo yik jun pak'anh yol schikin t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, wake' te' marco chi' ix b'oji.
Ix sb'opax chab' te' marco chi' heb' yik tz'och te' t'a junjun yesquina'il jun pak'anh chi'.
Ha chab' te' marco chi', nub'ub'i ix aj te', t'a yich masanto sk'ek'och b'aj syil-laj sb'a yuj junok argolla, haton te' chi' ix och t'a chab' yesquina'il.
Wajxake' te' marco ix b'oi yik tz'och t'a jun schikin chi' yet' 16 sb'akhnub'al yich nab'a plata, chab'chab' sb'akhnub'al yich junjun te'.
Ix sb'oanpax oye' te' regla heb' t'a te' acacia, te' tz'och t'a spatik te' marco t'a junok pak'anh kajnub' chi'.
Oye' pax te' yik tz'och t'a junxo pak'anh yet' oye' pax te' yik tz'och t'a junxo pak'anh t'a yol schikin t'a spatik, t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u.
Ha te' regla tz'och chi', ha t'a snanhal te' marco chi' tzek' junok te' masanto sk'axpajek'k'och te' t'a junxo schikin.
Ix och k'e'en oro t'a spatiktak te' marco chi'. Ix b'opax k'e'en argolla nab'a oro b'aj tzek' te' regla chi'. Ix ochpax k'e'en oro t'a spatiktak te' regla chi'.

Ix sb'opax jun k'apak cortina heb' yet' anh lino. Ix b'ojioch yechel querubín t'a k'apak yuj junok jelan sb'o'ani. Ha t'a anh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, anh yaxmakinak yet' anh chak ch'al ix b'ojioch yechel querubín chi'.

Ix sb'o'an chanhe' te oy heb' t'a te' acacia, ix yak'och k'e'en oro heb' t'a spatik te'. Ix b'opax chanhe' sb'akhnub'al yich te', nab'a plata ix aji. Ix yak'anoch k'e'en gancho nab'a oro heb' t'a schon te' yik sk'e lokan k'apak cortina chi'.

Ix sb'oanpax jun k'apak cortina heb' yik tz'och smakulok mantiado chi'. Ha jun k'apak cortina chi' t'a anh lino ch'al ix sb'o heb'. Yet' anh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, anh ch'al yaxmakinak yet' anh chak ch'al, ix b'ochajoch stz'ib'ul yuj junok jelan sb'o'ani.
Ix b'ojipax oye' te' oy, ix em k'e'en oro t'a schon te' yet' pax sganchoal. Ix b'opax oye' sb'akhnub'al yich te', nab'a bronce ix aji.
Ix sb'o'an te' skaxa'il strato Dios winhaj Bezaleel. Ha te' acacia ix och t'ay. Jun metro yet' 10 centímetro ix aj sk'atul, 70 centímetro ix aj sat. Hanheja' 70 centímetro ix ajpax scha'anhil.
Ix och k'e'en oro t'a yo'ol yet' t'a spatik yet' t'a stitak tzalank'ei.
Ix b'opax chanhe' argolla nab'a oro tz'och t'a yok schanhil, chab'chab' t'a junjun pak'anh.
Ix b'opax juntzanh te sb'akhlab'il t'a te' acacia, ix ochpax k'e'en oro t'a spatiktak te'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ekchajek' te' t'a yol k'e'en argolla chi', yik wach' syal sb'akhchaj te'.
Ix b'opax jun smakul nab'a oro b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul, jun metro yet' 10 centímetro sk'atul, 70 centímetro sat.
Ay chab' yechel querubín nab'a oro tenb'il t'a k'e'en martillo ix och t'a yib'anh jun smakul chi'.
Junnhej ix aj jun smakul chi' yet' chab' yechel querubín chi', junjun ix kan t'a stitak jun smakul chi',
t'anht'umb'a ix aji. Ix em k'elan juntzanh querubín chi' t'a yib'anh smakul te' skaxa'il trato chi', haxo sk'axil, syil-laj sb'a snhi' t'a yib'anh, ichato yenhul yaji.
Ix sb'opax jun te' mexa winhaj Bezaleel chi'. Hanheja' te' acacia ix och t'a te'. 90 centímetro ix aj sk'atul, 45 centímetro ix aj sat, 70 ix ajk'e ste'el.
Ix och k'e'en oro t'a te', ix b'opax jun tzek' hoyan t'a spatik yok te' schanhil, nab'a oro ix aji.
Ix b'opax k'e stitak ix ek' hoyan t'a yib'anh, uke' centímetro ix ajk'ei, ix och oro t'ay.
Ix b'opax chanhe' argolla nab'a oro, ix och t'a te' yok schanhil t'a yesquina'il.
Ix och juntzanh argolla chi' t'a slak'anil b'aj ayem stitak chi'. Ha t'a yol juntzanh chi' ix ek' te' sb'akhlab'il yik syal yik'chajb'at te' mexa chi'.
Ha te' sb'akhlab'il chi', haton te' acacia, ix ochpax k'e'en oro t'a spatiktak te'.
Ix b'ochajpax syamk'ab'il nab'a oro sk'anchaj t'a jun mexa chi', haton juntzanh tik: K'en plato, niwak cuchara, xalu yet' uk'ab' b'aj schaji ofrenda ha' yaji.
Ix sb'opax jun sb'akhnub' candil winhaj Bezaleel chi', nab'a oro ix aji, ix tenchaj t'a k'e'en martillo. Ha sk'ojnub' b'aj tz'em b'akhan, ste'al yet' skopail icha sfloral, junnhej yaman ix aji.
Oxox sk'ab' ix elta t'a stz'eytak.
Junjun juntzanh sk'ab' ayelta t'a ste'al chi', ay oxe' sfloral icha yik te' almendro.
Ha jun ste'al chi', ay pax chanhe' sfloral icha yik te' almendro chi'.
Ha t'a yalanh b'aj ayelta chab'chab' sk'ab' chi', ay junjun sfloral.
Ha juntzanh sfloral yet' sk'ab' chi', junnhej ix aj yet' sb'akhnub'al chi'. Ha jun chi', nab'a oro ix aji, tenb'il t'a k'e'en martillo.
Ix b'opax uke' candil, hanhejtona' ix b'opax k'e'en k'e'en tz'ik'anel stanhil k'apak b'aj tz'och sk'ak'al yet' splato'al. Nab'a oro ix aj smasanil.
Ha jantak k'e'en oro ix och t'a jun b'akhnub' candil chi' yet' syamk'ab'il, oxe' arroba ix ochi.

Ix sb'oanpax jun altar yik incienso winhaj Bezaleel chi' t'a te' acacia. Lajannhej ix aj t'a schanhil pak'anh, 45 centímetro ix aji, haxo pax ste'el, 90 centímetro ix ajk'ei. Ix b'opax juntzanh sch'a'ak t'a junjun yesquina'il, yaman ix aj yet' jun altar chi'.
Ix och k'e'en oro yelxo wal wach' t'a yib'anh yet' t'a spatiktak schanhil pak'anh yet' t'a sch'a'ak chi'. Ix k'epax tzalan k'e'en oro chi' t'a yib'anh stitak.
Ha t'a yalanh stitak chi', hata' ix och chab'chab' argolla nab'a oro t'a schab'il pak'anh. Ix ek' te' sb'akhlab'il t'a yo'ol yik syal sb'akhchaji.
Ha te' sb'akhlab'il ix och chi', haton te' acacia, ix ochpax k'e'en oro t'a te'.
Ix b'ojipax aceite sk'anchaji yik sik'chajel junok mach, ma junok tas tz'ochkan yikok Dios. Ix b'opax incienso te wach', icha tz'aj sb'o'an heb' b'o'um perfume.

Ix sb'oanpax jun altar winhaj Bezaleel chi', haton jun b'aj stz'a silab'. T'a te' acacia ix sb'o winh. Lajannhej ix aj yechel schanhil pak'anh, chab' metro yet' 25 centímetro junjun pak'anh. Jun metro yet' 25 centímetro ix ajk'e scha'anhil.
Ix b'ojipaxk'e chanhe' sch'a'ak t'a schikintak schanhil, yaman ix aj yet' jun altar chi'. Ix pichchaj te' t'a k'e'en bronce.
Masanil syamk'ab'il jun altar chi', nab'a bronce ix aji: Haton yet'tal b'aj tz'ik'chajel k'e'en ta'anh, k'e'en pala, k'e'en niwak uk'ab', k'e'en tenedor yet' yet'tal te' tzak'ak'.
Ix b'ojipax jun k'e'en malla nab'a bronce, ix ak'jioch k'e'en t'a yalanh sti' t'a yo'ol. T'a snanhal jun altar chi' ix och k'e'en.
Ix b'opax chanhe' argolla nab'a bronce, ix och t'a junjun yesquina'il k'e'en malla chi'. Ix elk'och k'e'en t'a spatik jun altar chi', ha t'a yol k'e'en tzek' te' sb'akhlab'il.
Ix b'opax sb'akhlab'il jun altar chi' t'a te' acacia, ix ochpax k'e'en bronce t'a spatiktak te'.
Ix ekchajek' te' t'a yol k'e'en argolla ayoch t'a stz'eytak jun altar chi' yik syal sb'akhchaji. Ha jun altar chi', chemte' ix och t'ay, ix kan yolanil t'a yo'ol.
Ha yet' k'e'en nen nab'a bronce sk'an heb' ix ix ayoch yilumalok sti' k'apak mantiado, a yet' k'e'en ix sb'o jun niwan palangana winhaj Bezaleel yet' sb'akhnub'al yich.
Ix sb'opax k'apak cortina winhaj Bezaleel yik tz'och smakulok spatiktak amak' t'a skajnub' Dios. Ha t'a stojolal sur, ix och 45 metro k'apak cortina chi', haton ch'al lino b'ayb'il ayoch t'a k'apak.
Ix b'opax 20 yoyal yet' 20 pax sb'akhnub'al yich nab'a bronce. Haxo t'a schon te' ix em juntzanh k'e'en k'e'en nab'a plata yet' yargollail.
Ix b'opax k'apak cortina yik stojolal norte, 45 metro k'apak yet' 20 oy yet' pax sb'akhnub'al yich nab'a bronce yet' k'e'en ayem t'a schon yoyal nab'a plata yet' yargollail.
Ix b'opax k'apak cortina yik stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, 22 metro yet' nanhalxo sat k'apak yet' lajunhe' yoyal yet' pax sb'akhnub'al yich yet' k'e'en ayem t'a schon yoyal nab'a plata yet' yargollail.
Hanhejtona' t'a stojolal b'aj sk'eul k'u, 22 metro yet' nanhalxo sat, ix b'opax k'apak cortina yik tz'och t'ay.
Ha t'a jun pak'anh b'aj tzonh ochi, ay uke' metro k'apak cortina ayochi yet' oxe' yoyal yet' pax sb'akhnub'al yich.
Haxo pax t'a junxo pak'anh, ay pax uke' metro k'apak yet' oxe' yoyal yet' pax sb'akhnub'al yich.
Masanil juntzanh k'apak cortina chi', ch'al lino b'ayb'il ayoch t'a k'apak.
Masanil pax sb'akhnub'al yich oy chi', nab'a bronce ix aji. Haxo k'e'en ayem t'a schon oy chi' nab'a plata yet' yargollail.

Ha k'apak cortina ix och smakulok sti' amak' chi', nanhal sb'alunhil metro sat k'apak, haxo ste'el k'apak, chab' metro yet' 25 centímetro. B'ob'ilpaxoch yelwanub' k'apak, jalb'il t'a anh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, anh ch'al yaxmakinak, anh chak ch'al yet' pax lino ch'al b'ayb'il. Lajannhej yet' masanil k'apak ayoch t'a amak'.
Ay chanhe' yoyal yet' chanhe' sb'akhnub'al yich nab'a bronce, haxo k'e'en ayem t'a schon yoyal, nab'a plata yet' yargollail.
Masanil yestaca'il skajnub' Dios chi' yet' yik k'apak cortina ayoch t'a spatiktak amak', nab'a bronce.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Moisés chi' to sb'o slista'il jantak k'e'en oro, k'e'en plata yet' k'e'en bronce ix och t'a skajnub' Jehová, haton b'aj sik'chaj skaxa'il trato. Ha heb' levita ixb'o'an slista'il chi'. Ha winhaj Itamar yuninal winhaj Aarón ix kuchb'an heb'.
Ha winhaj Bezaleel, yuninal winhaj Uri, yixchikin winhaj Hur, yinhtilal Judá ixb'o'an masanil tastak ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés to sb'o'i.

Haxo winhaj Aholiab yuninal winhaj Ahisamac, yinhtilal Dan ix kolwaj yet' winhaj Bezaleel chi'. Ha winhaj Aholiab chi' tenum k'e'en winh, jalum k'apak winh, syalpax sb'oanoch yelwanub' yet' anh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak winh, anh ch'al yaxmakinak, anh chak ch'al yet' anh lino ch'al te wach'.

Masanil k'e'en oro ix k'anchaji yik ix b'o skajnub' Dios, t'a ofrenda'il ix aj smoljiem k'e'en. Ha k'e'en oro chi', 21 quintal yet' 95 libraxo k'e'en, icha yalil k'e'en echlab' sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' Dios.
Haxo k'e'en plata ix molchajemi, a ix ik'chajk'e wa'an sb'isul heb' anima, 75 quintal yet' chab'xo arroba k'e'en, icha yalil k'e'en echlab' sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' Dios.

Masanil heb' winak ix tz'ib'chaji, heb' 20 ab'ilxo sk'inal, 603 mil yet' 550 heb' t'a smasanil. Junjun heb' chi' nanhal siclo plata ix yak' heb', icha yalil k'e'en echlab' sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' Dios.

Ha k'e'en plata ix och t'a sb'akhnub'al yich smarcoal yet' sb'akhnub'ok yoyal b'aj tz'och k'apak cortina, 75 quintal k'e'en t'a smasanil. Masanil juntzanh k'e'en plata chi' ix och t'a cien sb'akhnub'al chi', syalelk'ochi 75 libra ix och t'a junjun.
Ha yet' chab'xo arroba plata chi' ix sb'o k'e'en gancho winhaj Bezaleel ix och t'a te' oy yet' smakul sjolom oy chi' yet' k'e'en argolla.
Masanil k'e'en bronce ix ak'chaj ofrenda'il t'a Jehová, ay am 53 quintal yet' lajunhexo libra k'e'en.

Ha t'a k'e'en bronce chi' ix b'o sb'akhnub'al yich yoyal b'aj ix kan sti' mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Dios. Hanhejtona' t'a k'e'en ix b'o jun altar nab'a bronce yet' pax smalla'il. Nab'a bronce smasanil syamk'ab'il jun altar chi',
yet' pax sb'akhnub'al yich yoyal smakul spatiktak amak' yet' yestaca'il oyanoch t'a skajnub' Dios yet' yestaca'il spatiktak yamak'il kajnub' chi'.

Ha spichul heb' winh sacerdote sk'an t'a yopisio t'a skajnub' Dios, jalb'il t'a lana ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, t'a ch'al yaxmakinak yet' t'a chak ch'al. Ix b'opax spichul winhaj Aarón yiknhej yopisio yaji, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés.
Ayik ix b'o schaleka winhaj Aarón chi', ix och oro ch'al t'ay, lana ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, yaxmakinak, chakchak yet' anh lino ch'al b'ayb'il.

Ix sten k'e'en oro heb', te jay ix aji. Ixlajwi chi' ix skotak polan k'e'en heb', icha anh ch'al ix aj k'e'en yik syal sjalanb'at heb' t'a skal juntzanhxo ch'al chi', haton sb'oji yuj heb' wach' sb'o'ani.
Ix sb'o'an k'apak tzek' b'ak'an heb' t'a sjolom sjenhjab' jun chaleka chi', yik schalaj sb'a k'apak yichanh yet' k'apak spatik.

Ix sb'oanoch jun tzek'ul heb' t'a jun chaleka chi', anhejpaxa' ix och oro ch'al t'ay, lana ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, yaxmakinak yet' chakchak yet' pax anh lino ch'al b'ayb'il, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés.
Ix yak'anoch k'e'en kornalina heb' t'a syamnub'al nab'a oro. Ayoch sb'i heb' yuninal winhaj Israel t'a k'e'en, icha yajoch sletra'il junok sello.
Ix yak'anoch k'e'en winhaj Bezaleel t'a sjolom sjenhjab' jun chaleka chi', yik snajikot heb' yuninal winhaj Israel chi', icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés.

Haxo pax k'apak smakul snhi' sk'ol winh, ix b'ojioch stz'ib'ul yuj junok jelan sb'o'ani, icha yik k'apak chaleka: Ayoch oro ch'al t'ay yet' lana ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, yaxmakinak, chakchak yet' pax lino ch'al b'ayb'il.
Cha pakanh ix aji, lajannhej ix aj stitak schanhil ayik pakb'ilxo. 22 centímetro junjun stitak chi'.
Ha jun chi', chanh tzol ix aj yoch k'e'en k'e'en te wach' yilji t'ay. Ha t'a jun b'ab'el tzol, ayoch k'e'en rubí, k'e'en crisólito yet' k'e'en esmeralda.
Haxo t'a schab'il tzol, ayoch k'e'en granate, k'e'en zafiro yet' k'e'en jade.
Haxo t'a yoxil tzol, ayoch k'e'en jacinto, k'e'en ágata yet' k'e'en amatista.
Haxo t'a schanhil tzol, ayoch k'e'en topacio, k'e'en kornalina yet' k'e'en jaspe. Haxo k'e'en oro ayoch syamlab'ilok juntzanh k'e'en chi'.
Lajchawe' k'e'en, haton lajchawe' sb'i heb' yuninal winhaj Israel. Junjun sb'i heb' lajchawanh chi' ayoch t'a k'e'en, icha yajoch sletra'il junok sello.
Ha t'a k'apak smakul snhi' sk'ol chi' ix b'ojioch juntzanh cadena nab'a oro pach'uch'ab'il.
Ix b'ojipax chab' syamlab'il t'a k'e'en oro yet' chab' argolla nab'a oro. Ix och chab' argolla chi' t'a chab' schikin k'apak smakul snhi' sk'ol chi' t'a yib'anh.
Ix ochpax chab' cadena oro t'a chab' argolla chi'.
Ha snhi' chab' cadena chi' ix och t'a chab' syamlab'il nab'a oro, ix och t'a chab' sjolom sjenhjab' k'apak chaleka t'a yichanh.
Ix b'opax chab'xo argolla nab'a oro, ix och t'a yol chab' schikin k'apak smakul snhi' sk'ol chi' t'a yalanh, junnhej ix aj yet' k'apak chaleka.

Ix b'oji chab'xo argolla nab'a oro, ix och t'a snhitak k'apak tzek' t'a sjolom sjenhjab' k'apak chaleka, tz'emk'och t'a yichanh. Junnhej ix kan yet' b'aj tz'emk'och stz'isul yet' t'a yib'anhk'eta b'aj tzek' stzek'ul k'apak chaleka chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', junxonhej ix ajem k'e'en argolla ayoch t'a k'apak yet' k'e'en ayoch t'a k'apak smakul snhi' sk'ol chi'. Ix b'o icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés.
Ha jun k'apak pichul jukan ayoch t'a yol k'apak chaleka chi', ix jalchaj b'o k'apak yet' ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak.
Ix kan yolanil sjaj k'apak t'a snanhal, ix och stz'ulil sti' t'a sjaj chi' yik max nhik'chaji.
Ix och yelwanub' k'apak t'a stitak t'a yoktak, icha yechel sat te' granado, ix b'oji yet' lana ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, yaxmakinak, chakchak yet' pax lino ch'al b'ayb'il.
Ix b'ochajpax yunetak campana, nab'a oro ix aji. Ix och t'a skal yechel sat te' granado ayoch t'a yoktak k'apak pichul chi',

syalelk'ochi, jun yechel sat te' granado chi', jun yune' campana, t'a stzolal ix ajochi, icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés. Haton k'apak pichul jukan chi' sk'an winhaj Aarón ayik tz'och winh t'a yopisio.
Ha k'apak spichul winhaj Aarón yelxo wal te jukan k'apak yet' k'apak yik heb' yuninal winh, nab'a lino ch'al jalb'il yuj junok jalum k'apak, a ix och t'ay.
Hanheja' ix b'ojipax k'apak k'ox sb'ak'chaji yet' pax juntzanhxo sk'oxal yet' k'apak yolwex. Lino ch'al b'ayb'il ix och t'a juntzanh chi' smasanil.

Hanheja' t'a jun tzek'ul, lino ch'al b'ayb'il ix och t'ay, ix b'ojioch yelwanub' yuj junok jelan sb'o'ani. T'a anh lana ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, yaxmakinak yet' chakchak ix b'ojioch yelwanub' chi', icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés.
Ix sb'oanpax jun yelwanub' nab'a oro heb', sch'oxnab'il yopisio t'a sat sacerdote'al, ix och juntzanh lolonel tik t'ay icha sello: Yiknhej Jehová yaji, xchi.
Ixlajwi chi', ix och jun lana ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak t'ay, yik syal stzek'jioch jun yelwanub' chi' t'a snanhal sat k'apak k'ox sb'ak'chajochi, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés.
Icha chi' ix aj sb'ochajk'e skajnub' Dios b'aj sch'ox sb'a. Icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi', icha wal chi' ix aj sb'o'an heb' israel chi'.
Masanil syamk'ab'il skajnub' Dios ix yik'kot heb' t'a winhaj Moisés chi', haton tik: Syamnub'al, smarcoal, sregla'il, yoyal yet' pax sb'akhlab'il yich.

Ix yik'anpaxkot te' kaxa chi' heb' yet' te' regla tz'och sb'akhlab'ilok yet' smakul b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul,
te' mexa yet' syamk'ab'il yet' ixim pan tz'och t'a yichanh Jehová.
Ix yik'anpaxkot jun sb'akhnub' candil nab'a oro heb' yet' pax candil ayoch t'a yib'anh t'a stzolal yet' masanil syamk'ab'il yet' aceite yik tz'och sk'ak'al candil chi'.

Ix yik'anpaxkot jun altar nab'a oro heb' yet' pax aceite sk'anchaji ayik sik'chajel junok mach, ma junok tas tz'ochkan yikok Dios yet' incienso suk'uk'i sjab', jun k'apak cortina yik smakul sti' mantiado,
jun altar bronce yet' smalla'il to bronce paxi, sregla'il tz'och sb'akhlab'ilok, syamk'ab'il, jun palangana yet' pax sb'akhnub' yich.

Ix yik'anpaxkot k'apak cortina heb', haton k'apak tz'och t'a spatiktak amak' yet' yoyal yet' pax sb'akhnub' yich, k'apak cortina tz'och t'a sti' amak' yet' pax sch'anhal, yestaca'il t'a spatiktak amak' chi' yet' masanil yamk'ab' sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' Jehová b'aj sch'ox sb'a.

Ix yik'anpaxkot k'apak pichul heb', haton k'apak sk'an heb' sacerdote t'a yopisio t'a yol skajnub' Dios, haton pichul yik yopisio winhaj sacerdote Aarón yet' spichul heb' yuninal winh syak'och t'a yopisio chi'.
Masanil ix sb'o heb' israel icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés.
Ayik ix yilan winhaj Moisés chi' to icha chi' ix aj sb'oel yuj heb', ix yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés, ix yalan t'a winh icha tik:
T'a b'ab'el k'uhal yik b'ab'el uj, hata' sb'ok'e in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.
Slajwi chi', tz'ak'chajoch te' skaxa'il trato t'a yo'ol chi', tz'ak'chajoch k'apak cortina smakulok.
Tz'ak'chajpaxoch te' mexa yet' tas tz'em t'a yib'anh yet' sb'akhnub' candil, tz'ochpax sk'ak'al candil chi'.
Ha t'a yichanh skaxa'il trato tz'och altar oro b'aj stz'a incienso, slokb'ajk'e k'apak cortina t'a sti' mantiado chi'.
Sb'ochajpaxem jun altar b'aj stz'a silab' t'a yichanhelta sti' mantiado chi'.
Tz'ak'chajem jun niwan palangana t'a skal mantiado yet' altar, tz'ak'ji b'ut'jok yet' ha ha'.
Slajwi chi', sb'ochajoch k'apak cortina smakulok spatiktak yamak'il, haxo k'apak tz'och t'a sti' yamak'il chi' sk'epax lokan k'apak.

Tzik'ankot aceite sk'anchaji a sik'chajel junok mach, ma junok tas. Tza sekanem t'a yib'anh in kajnub' yet' t'a masanil tastak ayoch t'a yo'ol. Icha chi' tz'aj yochkan masanil syamk'ab'il t'a yopisio, yik wach' wikxo tz'ajkani.
Tza sekanpaxem aceite chi' t'a yib'anh altar b'aj stz'a silab' yet' masanil syamk'ab'il. Icha chi' tz'aj yochkan t'a yopisio, yuj chi' a jun altar chi' wikxo tz'ajkani.
Tza sekanpaxem aceite chi' t'a yib'anh jun niwan palangana yet' sb'akhnub'al yich yik wach' wikxo tz'ajkani.
Slajwi chi', tzik'anb'at winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal t'a sti' mantiado chi', tza chekan sb'ik sb'a heb' ta'.
Slajwi chi', tzak'anoch spichul winhaj Aarón chi' yik yopisio. Tzak'anoch aceite t'a winh yik tz'ochkan yopisio winh t'a sacerdote'al t'ayin.
Sjapax heb' yuninal winh chi' t'a a tz'ey, tzak'anoch spichul heb'.

Tzak'anpaxoch aceite t'a heb' icha tzutej winhaj Aarón chi', yik wach' tz'ochkan heb' sacerdote'al t'ayin. Tz'ak'jioch aceite chi' t'a heb' yik skan jun opisio chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb', ol b'eynhejb'at t'a yinhtilal heb' t'a masanil tiempo, xchi Jehová.
Icha ix aj yalan Jehová, icha wal chi' ix aj sb'o'an winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ayik ix scha'anel yich yik schab'il ab'il yelta heb' t'a Egipto, t'a wal sb'ab'el k'uhal yik b'ab'el uj ix b'ojik'e skajnub' Dios.
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' to tz'ak'jiem k'e'en sb'akhnub'al yich, ix ak'jiem te' marco t'a yib'anh k'e'en, ix ak'jipaxoch sregla'il, ix ik'jik'e wa'an te' oy t'a yib'anh sb'akhnub'al ayxoem chi'.
Ix ak'jib'at jenhan k'apak mantiado t'a yib'anh skajnub' Dios chi', ix ak'jib'at juntzanhxo t'a yib'anh mantiado icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ixlajwi chi, ix yak'anem chab' pachanh k'e'en k'e'en winhaj Moisés chi' t'a yol skaxa'il trato, haton k'e'en b'aj tz'ib'ab'iloch lajunhe' cheknab'il. Ix yak'anoch te' sb'akhlab'il te' kaxa chi' winh, ix yak'anpaxem smakul te' winh, haton b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ik'jib'at te' t'a yol skajnub' Dios, ix ak'jioch k'apak cortina t'a snanhal yol skajnub' chi', yik tz'och smakulok te' kaxa chi', icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winh.
Ix ak'jipaxoch te' mexa t'a ko wach' t'a yol mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Dios.
Wach' ix aj yak'jiem ixim pan t'a sat te' mexa t'a yichanh Jehová, icha ix aj yalan t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix ak'jipaxoch k'e'en sb'akhnub' candil t'a ko k'exanh t'a yichanh mexa t'a yol mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Dios.
Ix ak'jioch sk'ak'al candil t'a yichanh Jehová, icha ix aj yalan t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix ak'jipaxoch altar oro t'a yichanhelta k'apak cortina chi'.
Ix snhusantz'a incienso winhaj Moisés chi' t'a yib'anh altar chi', icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ak'chajoch k'apak cortina smakulok b'aj tz'och heb' sacerdote t'a yol kajnub' chi'.
Ix ak'chajem altar b'aj snhusjitz'a silab' t'a yichanhelta sti' mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová. Ixlajwi chi' ix snhusantz'a nok' silab' winhaj Moisés chi' yet' ixim harina icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
Ix ak'jioch k'e'en niwan palangana t'a skal mantiado yet' altar. Ix ak'ji b'ut'jok k'e'en t'a ha ha' yik sb'ik sk'ab' heb' yet' yok.
Ha t'a ha ha' chi' ix sb'ik sk'ab' winhaj Moisés chi' yet' yok. Hanheja' pax winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal sb'ik sk'ab' heb' yet' yok,
ayik tz'och heb' t'a yol mantiado. Sb'ikpax sk'ab' heb' yet' yok chi' ayik tz'och heb' t'a altar, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.

T'a slajwub'alxo ix b'ochajoch yamak'il spatik yichanh skajnub' Dios yet' altar. Ixlajwi chi' ix ak'chajoch k'apak k'apak smakulok t'a sti' amak' chi'. Icha wal chi' ix aj sb'okanel masanil tas ix alchaj t'a winhaj Moisés chi' yuj Jehová.
Ayik ix lajwi sb'oel smasanil, ix emul asun t'a yib'anh mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová, ix em stzikikial t'a yib'anh skajnub' chi' yet' t'a yo'ol.
Yuj chi' maj yal-laj yoch winhaj Moisés t'a yo'ol chi', yujto ayek' jun asun chi' t'a yib'anh, makb'il yo'ol chi' yuj stzikikial Jehová.
Ayik sk'e wa'an asun chi' t'a yib'anh skajnub' Jehová chi' syik'ank'e wa'an smantiado heb' israel, sb'eyb'at heb'.
Tato max k'e wa'an asun chi' jun, max yik'k'elaj wa'an scampamento heb', hato sk'e wa'an ichato chi' sb'at heb'.
Yalnhej b'ajtil ayek' heb' israel t'a yol b'e, syil wal jun asun chi' heb' t'a yib'anh skajnub' Jehová t'a k'uhalil, haxo t'ak'walil ayoch sk'ak'al asun chi' syil heb'.
